Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 11:
Yayin shennitnassech leakkum asur bahanaya. vehashshote mimmennu kol shehu loke min hattora. vechen haochel kol shehu mittikrovet akkum mibbasar o mipperot afillu mayim umelach haochel mehen kol shehu loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 38)</small> "asher chelev zevachemo yochelu yishtu yen nesicham yakumu" vegomer: 
Yayin shennitnassech lah kezevach shekkarev lah vechevan sheissur ze mishshum akkum hu en lo shiur shenneemar baavodat kochavim umazzalot <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem": 
Yen haakkum sheen anu yodin im nitnassech o lo nitnassech vehu hannikra setam yenam asur bahanaa kemo yayin shennitnassech. vedavar ze miggezerot sofrim hu. vehashshote missetam yenam reviit makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vechol yayin sheyyigga bo haakkum hare ze asur shemma nissech oto shemmachshevet haakkum laavodat kochavim. ha lamadta sheyyen yisrael shennaga bo haakkum dino kistam yenam shehu asur bahanaya: 
Akkum shennaga beyayin shello bechavvana vechen tinok akkum shennaga beyayin asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. hallokeach avadim min haakkum umalu vetavlu miyyad en menassechin veyayin shennagu bo muttar bishtiyya veaf al pi sheadayin lo nahagu bedate yisrael velo paska akkum mippihem: 
Bene hashshefachot haakkum shennoldu birshut yisrael umalu vaadayin lo tavlu haggedolim osrin hayyayin kesheyyiggeu bo vehakketannim enan osrin: 
Ger toshav vehu shekkibbel alav sheva mitzvot kemo shebbearnu yeno asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. umeyachadin etzlo yayin veen mafkidin etzlo yayin. vechen kol akkum sheeno oved akkum kegon ellu hayyishmeelim yenan asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya. vechen horu kol haggeonim. aval otam haovdim akkum setam yenam asur bahanaya: 
Kol makom shenneemar beinyan ze shehayyayin asur im haya akkum shenneesar hayyayin biglalo oved akkum hare hu asur bahanaya. veim eno oved akkum hare hu asur bishtiyya bilvad. vechol makom shenneemar akkum setam hare ze oved akkum: 
En mitnassech leakkum ella yayin sherauy lehakeriv al gabbe hammizbeach umippene ze kesheggazru al setam yenam vegazru al kol yayin sheyyigga bo sheyyihye asur bahanaya lo gazru ella al hayyayin harauy lehitnassech. lefichach yayin mevushshal shel yisrael shennaga bo haakkum eno asur umuttar lishtot im haakkum bechos echad. aval yayin mazug veyayin shehitchil lehachamitz veefshar sheyyishte im naga bo neesar: 
Horu geone hammaarav sheim nitarev beyen yisrael meat devash o meat seor hoil veeno rauy lammizbeach hare hu kimvushshal o keshechar veeno mitnassech umuttar lishtoto im haakkum: 
Meematay yeaser yen haakkum mishsheyyidroch veyimmashech hayyayin af al pi shello yarad labbor ella adayin hu baggat hare ze asur. lefichach en dorchin im haakkum baggat shemma yigga beyado vinassech. vaafillu haya kafut. veen lokchin mimmennu gat derucha veaf al pi sheadayin hayyayin meorav im hachartzannim vezaggin velo yarad labbor: 
Akkum sheddarach hayyayin velo naga bo vahare yisrael omed al gabbav veyisrael hu shekkenaso bechavit hare ze asur bishtiyya: 
Hachometz shel akkum asur bahanaya mippene shennaasa yen nesech kodem sheyyachmitz. akkum shehaya dores anavim bechavit af al pi shehayyayin tzaf al gabbe yadav en choshshin mishshum yen nesech. haya ochel min hassallim vehotir kisa uchesatayim uzerakan baggat af al pi shehayyayin miggitto al haanavim en ose yen nesech: 
Hachartzannim vehazzaggin shel akkum asurim kol 12 chodesh. uleachar 12 chodesh kevar yavshu velo nishara bahen lachluchit umuttarin baachila. vechen shemarim shel yayin sheyyavshu leachar shenem asar chodesh muttarin shehare lo nishar bahen reach yayin vahare hen keafar vechaadama: 
Nodot haakkum vekankenehen shehichnisu bahen haakkum yenam asur litten letochan yayin ad sheyyeyashshenan shenem asar chodesh o ad sheyyachaziran laur ad sheyyitrappe hazzefet shealehen o sheyyechammu o ad sheyyitten letochan mayim shelosha yamim meet leet umeare hammayim umachalif mayim acherim kol meet leet shalosh peamim bishloshet hayyamim. ben shehayu hakkelim shellahen ben shehayu shel yisrael veshaalu otan vehichnisu bahen yenam. veim natan letocham yayin kodem sheyyetaher otan hare ze asur bishtiyya: 
Umuttar litten letochan shechar o tzir o mureyas miyyad veen tzarich lichlum. umuttar litten hayyayin letochan achar shennoten hatztzir o hammureyas shehammelach sorfan: 
Hallokeach kelim chadashim sheenam mezuppatim min haakkum noten letochan yayin miyyad veeno choshesh shemma natnu bahen yen nesech. veim hayu mezuppatin medichan veaf al pi shehen chadashim. vechen keli shennatnu bo yen nesech veen machniso lekiyyum kegon keli shechosef bo o hammashpech vechayyotze bah meshachshecho bemayim vedayyo: 
Vechen kos shel cheres sheshshata bo haakkum asur lishtot bo. hedicho paam rishona usheniyya ushelishit muttar shekkevar halchu tzichtzuche hayyayin shebbo. vehu shehaya metzuppe baavar kederech shehayyotzrin osin o shehaya mezuppat. aval shel cheres tzarich hadacha: 
Kele cheres hashshoim baavar shennishtammeshu bahen beyen nesech im hayu levanim o adummim o shechorim muttarin. veim hayu yerukkin asurin mippene shehen bolim. veim yesh bahem makom megulle shel cheres ben levanim ben yerukkim asurim mippene shehem bolin. veyerae li sheen haddavar ella beshekkansu bahem lekiyyum. aval lo kansu bahem lekiyyum medichan umuttarin vaafillu hem shel cheres: 
Gat shel even veshel etz sheddarach bahen haakkum o gat shel even shezzippetah haakkum af al pi shello darach bah medichan bemayim uveefer arba peamim vedorech bahen. veim hayta bahem lachluchit makdim haefer lammayim. veim lav makdim hammayim: 
Gat shel even mezuppefet sheddarach bah haakkum. o gat shel etz zefuta af al pi shello darach bah tzarich liklof et hazzefet. veim yishshenah shenem asar chodesh o natan bah mayim shelosha yamim meet leet eno tzarich liklof. lo tihye haggat chamura yeter min hakkankannim. lo neemar yiklof ella lehattirah miyyad: 
Gat shel cheres af al pi shekkalaf et hazzefet asur lidroch bah miyyad ad sheyyachem otah beesh ad sheyyirpe hazzefet. veim yishshenah shenem asar chodesh o natan bah mayim shelosha yamim mutteret kemo shebbearnu: 
Meshammeret shel yayin shel akkum im hayta shel sear medichah umeshammer bah. veim hayta shel tzemer medichah bemayim uveefer arba peamim umedichah ad shettinnagev umeshammer bah. veim hayta shel shesh meyashshenah 12 chodesh. veim yesh bahen kesharim mattiran. vechen kele chelef vehutzim vechayyotze bahen mikkefifot sheddorchin bahen yayin im hayu tefurin bachavalim medichan. veim hayu achuzot zo besibbuch kashe medichan beefer uvemayim arba peamim umenaggevan umishtammesh bahen. veim hayu tefurot befishtan meyashshenan shenem asar chodesh. veim yesh bahen kesharim mattiran: 
Kele haggat sheddarach bahen haakkum yen nesech ketzad metaharin otan kede sheyyidroch bahen hayyisrael. haddappin vehaadashim vehallulavin medichan. haakalin. shel nesarin veshel bitzbutz menaggevan. shel shifa veshel gemi meyashshenan shenem asar chodesh. veim ratza letaharan miyyad magilan berotchin o choltan beme zetim o mannichan tachat tzinnor shemmemav mekullachin o bemayan shemmemav rodfin shetem esre shaot veachar kach yutteru: 
Bizman shehayta eretz yisrael kullah leyisrael hayu lokchin hayyayin mikkol adam miyyisrael veen choshshin lo. uvechutza laaretz lo hayu lokchin ella meadam shehuchzak bechashrut. uvazzeman hazze en lokchin yayin bechol makom ella meadam shehuchzak bechashrut. vechen habbasar vehaggevina vachatichat dag sheen bah siman kemo shebbearnu: 
Hammitareach etzel baal habbayit bechol makom uvechol zeman vehevi lo yayin o basar o gevina vachatichat dag hare ze muttar veeno tzarich lishl alav af al pi sheeno makkiro ella yodea shehu yehudi bilvad. veim huchzak sheeno kasher velo medakdek bidvarim ellu asur lehitareach etzlo. veim avar venitareach etzlo eno ochel basar velo shote yayin al piv ad sheyyaid lo adam kasher alehem:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 12:
Ketzad hi hannegia shioser bah haakkum hayyayin. hu sheyyigga bayyayin atzmo ben beyado ben bishar evarav sheddarkan lenassech bahen vishachshech. aval im pashat yado lechavit vetafsu et yado kodem sheyyotziah velo yenidah ufatchu hechavit millematta ad sheyyatza hayyayin veyarad lematta miyyado lo neesar hayyayin. vechen im achaz keli patuach shel yayin veshichshecho af al pi shello higbiah hakkeli velo naga bayyayin neesar hayyayin: 
Natal keli shel yayin vehigbiho veyatzak hayyayin af al pi shello shichshech neesar shehare ba hayyayin mikkocho. higbiah velo shichshech velo naga muttar: 
Akkum shehaya ochez hakkeli bakkarka veyisrael yatzak letocho yayin hayyayin muttar. veim nidned haakkum hakkeli neesar hayyayin: 
Keli satum muttar letaltelo haakkum mimmakom lemakom veaf al pi shehayyayin mitnadned sheen ze derech hannissuch. heevir nod shel yayin mimmakom lemakom vehu ochez pi hannod beyado. ben shehaya hannod male o chaser muttar. veaf al pi shehayyayin mitnadned. heevir keli cheres patuach male yayin asur shemma naga bo. veim haya chaser muttar ella im ken shichshecho: 
Akkum shennaga beyayin velo nitkavven laze hare hayyayin muttar bahanaya bilvad. ketzad. kegon shennafal al nod shel yayin o shehoshit yado lechavit al menat shehi shemen venimtzet yayin: 
Ba hayyayin mikkocho shel akkum belo kavvana hoil velo naga bayyayin hare ze muttar bishtiyya. ketzad. kegon shehigbiah keli shel yayin veyatzak lichli acher vehu medamme shehu shechar o shemen hare ze muttar: 
Nichnas haakkum levayit o lachanut levakkesh yayin ufashat yado keshehu mechappes venaga bayyayin asur shehare leyayin nitkavven veen ze nogea belo kavvana: 
Chavit shennisdeka learkah vekadam haakkum vechibbeka kede shello yitpardu hacharasim hare ze muttar bahanaya. aval im nisdeka lerachbah vetafas bassedek haelyon kede shello yippol hare ze muttar bishtiyya shehare en hayyayin al kocho shel akkum: 
Akkum shennafal levor shel yayin veheeluhu mishsham met. o shemmadad habbor sheyyesh bo hayyayin bekane. o shehittiz et hazzevuv vehatztzira mealav bekane. o shehaya metappeach al pi hechavit harotachat kede shettanuach harticha. o shennatal chavit uzerakah bachamato labbor. hare ze muttar bahanaya bilvad. veim ala haakkum chay hayyayin asur bahanaya: 
Chavit shehaya nekev betziddah venishmat happekak min hannekev vehinniach haakkum etzbao bimkom hannekev kede shello yetze hayyayin kol hayyayin shemmerosh hechavit ad hannekev asur. veshettachat hannekev muttar bishtiyya: 
Meneket kefufa sheosin otah mimmattechet o mizzechuchit vechayyotze bahem. shehinniach roshah letoch hayyayin shebbechavit veharosh haacher chutz lechavit umatzatz hayyayin vehitchil hayyayin lered kederech sheosin tamid. uva haakkum vehinniach etzbao al pi hammeneket umana hayyayin millered neesar kol hayyayin shebbechavit. shehakkol haya yotze venigrar lule yado venimtza hakkol keva mikkocho: 
Hameare yayin letoch keli sheyyesh bo yen akkum neesar kol hayyayin shebbakkeli haelyon. shehare haammud hannitztzok mechabber ben hayyayin shebbakkeli haelyon uven hayyayin shebbakkeli hattachton. lefichach hammoded leakkum letoch keli shebbeyado yenappetz nefitza o yizrok zerika kede shello yihye nitztzok chibbur veyeesor alav ma sheyyishshaer bakkeli haelyon: 
Mashpech shemmadad bo leakkum im yesh biktze hammashpech akkavat yayin lo yimdod bo leyisrael ad sheyyedichennu vinaggev. veim lo hediach hare ze asur: 
Keli sheyyesh lo kemin shene chotamin yotzin mimmennu kemo hakkelim shennotlin bahem layyadayim shehaya male yayin beyad yisrael vehaya yisrael motzetz veshote mechotem ze vehaakkum motzetz veshote min hachotem hashsheni hare ze muttar. vehu sheyyakdim hayyisreeli veyifsok vaadayin haakkum shote. shemmishsheyyifsok haakkum yachazor hayyayin sheyyishshaer bachotem lakkeli veyeesor kol ma sheyyishshaer bo shehare ba hayyayin mikkocho: 
Akkum shemmatzatz hayyayin min hechavit bemeneket asar kol hayyayin shebbah. shekkesheyyippasek yachazor hayyayin sheala bammeneket bimtzitzato veyippol lechavit veyeesor hakkol: 
Akkum shehaya maavir im yisrael kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom vehu holech acharehen leshamran afillu hifligu mimmennu kede mil hare ellu muttarot. sheemato alehen veomer atta yetze lefanenu veyire otanu. veim amar lahem lechu vaani avo acharechem im nitallemu meenav kede sheyyiftechu pi hakkad veyachzeru veyagifu otah vetigov hare hayyayin kullo asur bishtiyya. im pachot mikken muttar: 
Vechen hammeniach akkum bachanuto af al pi shehu yotze venichnas kol hayyom kullo hayyayin muttar. veim modio shehu maflig veshaha kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetigov hayyayin asur bishtiyya. vechen hammeniach yeno bekaron o bisfina im haakkum venichnas lair laasot tzerachav hayyayin muttar. veim hodian shehu maflig veshaha kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetigov hayyayin asur bishtiyya. vechol haddevarim haellu bechaviyyot setumot. aval biftuchot afillu lo shaha meachar shehodian shehu maflig hayyayin asur: 
Yisrael shehaya ochel im haakkum vehinniach yayin patuach al hashshulchan veyayin patuach al haddulpeki veyatza. sheal hashshulchan asur vesheal haddulpeki muttar. veim amar lo mezog ushete kol hayyayin happatuach shebbabbayit asur: 
Haya shote im haakkum veshama kol tefilla bevet hakkeneset veyatza af hayyayin happatuach muttar. shehannachri omer atta yizkor hayyayin veyavo bimhera veyimtza oti nogea beyeno ulefi ze eno zaz mimmekomo veen neesar ella ma shellefanav bilvad: 
Akkum veyisrael shehayu darin bechatzer achat veyatzu shenehem bevehala lirot chatan o hesped. vechazar haakkum vesagar happetach veachar kach yisrael hare hayyayin happatuach shebbevet yisrael behettero. shello sagar haakkum ella al daat shekkevar nichnas hayyisreeli leveto velo nishar adam bachutz vechimdumme lo shehu kedamo: 
Yayin shel yisrael veshel akkum bevayit echad vehayu chaviyyot petuchot venichnas haakkum labbayit venaal haddelet baado neesar kol hayyayin. veim yesh challon baddelet shemmistakkel mimmennu haomed achore happetach veroe kenegdo kol hechaviyyot shekkeneged hachallon muttarot. veshemmin hatztzedadin asurot shehare mefached min haroe oto: 
Vechen im shaag ari vechayyotze bo uvarach haakkum venechba ben hechaviyyot happetuchot hayyayin muttar shehu omer shemma yisrael acher nechba kan vehu roe oti kesheegga: 
Otzar shel yayin shehayu chaviyyotav petuchot veyesh leakkum chaviyyot acherot beoto happundak. venimtza haakkum omed ben chaviyyot yisrael happetuchot. im nivhal keshennimtza venitpas alav kegannav hayyayin muttar bishtiyya shemmippachdo veyirato en lo penay lenassech. veim lo nitpas kegannav ella hare hu boteach sham hayyayin asur. vetinok hannimtza ben hechaviyyot ben kach uven kach kol hayyayin muttar: 
Gedud shennichnas lammedina derech shalom kol hechaviyyot happetuchot shebbachanuyot asurot usetumot muttarot. uvishat milchama im pashat haggedud bammedina veavar ellu veellu muttarot sheen penay lenassech: 
Akkum shennimtza omed betzad habbor shel yayin im yesh lo milve al oto hayyayin hare ze asur mippene shellibbo gas bo sholeach yado umenassech. veim en lo alav milve hayyayin muttar bishtiyya: 
Zona akkum bimsibba shel yisrael hayyayin muttar sheematan aleha velo tigga. aval zona yisreelit bimsibbat akkum yenah shellefaneha becheleha asur mippene shehen nogin bo shello middatah: 
Akkum hannimtza bevet haggat im yesh sham lachluchit yayin kede livlol hakkaf ad shettivlol hakkaf lechaf sheniyya tzarich lehadiach kol bet haggat vinaggev. veim lav mediach bilvad vezo harechaka yetera: 
Chavit shetztzafa bannahar im nimtzet keneged ir sherubbah yisrael mutteret bahanaya. keneged ir sherubbah akkum asura: 
Makom shehayu rov mochre hayyayin bo yisreelim venimtzeu bo kelim gedolim meleim yayin vehem kelim shedderech hammochrin levaddam lichnos bahem hayyayin hare ellu muttarin bahanaya. chavit sheppetachuha gannavim im rov gannave hair yisrael hayyayin muttar bishtiyya veim lav asur:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 13:
Halokeach bayit o shessachar bayit bachatzero shel akkum umilleahu yayin im haya hayyisreeli dar beotah chatzer af al pi shehappetach patuach hayyayin muttar. mippene shehaakkum mefached tamid veomer atta yikkanes leveto pitom veyimtza oti betoch beto. veim haya dar bechatzer acheret lo yetze ad sheyyisgor habbayit veyihye hammafteach vehachotam beyado. veeno choshesh shemma yezayyef haakkum mafteach habbayit: 
Yatza velo sagar happetach o shessagar vehinniach hammafteach beyad akkum hare hayyayin asur bishtiyya. shemma nichnas haakkum venissech. shehare en hayyisreeli sham. veim amar lo echoz li mafteach ze ad sheavo hayyayin muttar shello masar lo shemirat habbayit ella shemirat hammafteach: 
Akkum shessachar yisrael lidroch lo yeno betohora kede sheyyihye muttar leyisrael veyikkachuhu mimmennu vehaya hayyayin beveto shel akkum. im haya yisirael ze sheshshomer hayyayin dar beotah chatzer hayyayin muttar. veaf al pi shehappetach patuach vehashshomer nichnas veyotze. veim haya hashshomer dar bechatzer acheret hayyayin asur. veaf al pi shehammafteach vehachotam beyad yisrael. shekkevan shehayyayin shel akkum uvirshuto eno mefached lezayyef ulehikkanes labbayit veyomar vihi ma im yedu bo lo yikchu mimmenni: 
Afillu katav haakkum leyisrael shennitkabbel mimmennu hammaot limkor lo bahen yayin hoil veen hayyisreeli yachol lehotzio mershut haakkum ad sheyyitten lo hammaot hare hu shel akkum veasur. ella im haya hashshomer dar sham bechatzer. veen hashshomer tzarich lihyot yoshev umeshammer tamid ella nichnas veyotze kemo shebbearnu. ben birshut baal hayyayin ben birshut akkum acher: 
Haya yayin ze hattahor shel akkum munnach birshut harabbim o bevayit happatuach lirshut harabbim veyisrael holchim veshavim muttar. sheadayin lo nichnas birshut haakkum: 
Veashpa vechallon vedekel af al pi sheen bo perot hare ellu kirshut harabbim. vechavit yayin sham veakkum hannimtza sham eno osrah. uvayit happatuach lesham hare hu kefatuach lirshut harabbim: 
Chatzer hachaluka bimsifim veakkum betzad ze veyisrael betzad acher. vechen shene gaggin shehaya gag yisrael lemala vegag haakkum lematta. o shehayu ze betzad ze veyesh benehen mesifim. af al pi sheyyad haakkum maggaat lechelek yisrael eno choshesh mishshum yen nesech velo mishshum tohorot: 
Muttar leyisrael lehafekid yeno bichli satum beyad akkum vehu sheyyihye lo bo shene simanin. veze hu hannikra chotam betoch chotam. ketzad. satam hechavit bichli sheeno mehuddak kederech shessotmin kol adam vetach betit hare ze chotam echad. haya keli mehuddak vetach alav millemala hare ze chotam betoch chotam. vechen im tzar pi hannod hare ze chotam echad. hafach pi hannod letocho vetzar alav hare ze chotam betoch chotam. vechen kol shinnuy shemmeshanne middevarim sheen derech kol adam hare hen kechotam echad vehatticha o hakkeshira chotam sheni: 
Veim hifkid beyad akkum bechotam echad hare ze asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya vehu sheyyeyached lo keren zavit: 
Yayin mevushshal vehashshechar o yayin sheervo im devarim acherim kegon devash veshemen vechen hachometz vehaggevina vehechalav vechol sheissuro middivre sofrim shehifkido beyad akkum eno tzarich shene chotamot ella chotam echad bilvad dayyo. aval hayyayin vehabbasar vachatichat dag sheen bah siman shehifkidan beyad akkum tzerichin shene chotamot: 
Yerae li shekkol makom sheamarnu beinyan ze beyayin shellanu shehu asur bishtiyya umuttar bahanaya mippene tzad negia shennaga bo haakkum keshehaya haakkum oved akkum. aval im haya issuro biglal akkum sheeno oved akkum kegon yishmeeli shennaga bayyayin shellanu shello bechavvana o shettippach al pi hechavit hare ze muttar bishtiyya. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Aval hammafkid yayin beyad ger toshav o sheshshelacho immo vehiflig o sheheniach beto patuach bachatzar ger toshav hare ze asur bishtiyya. shekkol chashash shel chilluf veziyyuf yerae li shekkol haakkum shavim bo hoil venaasa hayyayin birshutan neesar bishtiyya al kol panim: 
Yesh devarim sheen bahem issur nissuch kelal veasru otam chachamim kede leharechik min hannissuch. veellu hen. lo yimzog haakkum hammayim letoch hayyayin shebbeyad yisrael shemma yavo litztzok hayyayin letoch hammayim. velo yolich haakkum anavim laggat shemma yavo lidroch o ligga. velo yesayyea leyisrael beshaa shemmerik mikkeli lichli shemma yanniach hakkeli beyad haakkum venimtza hayyayin ba mikkocho. veim siyyea o mazag hammayim o hevi anavim muttar: 
Vechen muttar sheyyariach haakkum bechavit shel yayin shellanu. umuttar leyisrael lehariach bechavit shel yen nesech veen baze shem issur sheen hareach kelum lefi sheen bo mammash: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol davar shehu asur bahanaya im avar umachru damav muttarin chutz meakkum umeshammesheha vetikrovet shellah veyayin shennitnassech lah. vehechmiru chachamim bistam yenam lihyot damav asurin kidme yayin shennitnassech leakkum. lefichach akkum shessachar et yisrael laasot immo beyayin secharo asur: 
Vechen hassocher et hachamor lehavi alav yayin o shessachar sefina lehavi bah yayin secharan asur. im maot natnu lo yolichen leyam hammelach. veim natnu lo bischaro kesut o kelim o perot hare ze yisrof otan veyikbor haefer kede shello lehanot bo: 
Sachar laakkum chamor lirkov alav vehinniach alav login shel yayin secharo muttar. secharo leshabber kadde yen nesech secharo muttar vetavo alav beracha mippene shemmemaet betifla: 
Hassocher et happoel veamar lo haaver li mea chaviyyot shel shechar bemea perutot venimtza achat mehen yayin secharo kullo asur: 
Amar lo haaver li chavit bifruta chavit bifruta veheevir venimtza benehen chaviyyot shel yayin. sechar chaviyyot shel yayin asur ushear secharo muttar: 
Ummene yisrael sheshshalach lahem akkum chavit shel yayin bischaran muttar sheyyomru lo ten lanu et dameha. veim mishshennichnesa lirshutan asur: 
Yisrael shehaya noshe beakkum mane. halach haakkum umachar avoda zara veyen nesech vehevi lo demehen hare ze muttar. veim amar lo kodem sheyyimkor hameten li ad sheemkor avoda zara o yen nesech sheyyesh li veavi lecha. af al pi shehu setam yeno. umachar vehevi lo hare ze asur. mippene shehayyisreeli rotze bekiyyumo kede sheyyifra mimmennu chovo: 
Vechen ger veakkum shehayu shuttafin uvau lachalok. en hagger yachol lomar laakkum tol atta avoda zara vaani maot. atta yayin vaani perot shehare rotze bekiyyuman kede sheyyittol kenegdan. aval ger veakkum sheyyarshu et avihen akkum yachol lomar lo tol atta avoda zara vaani maot. atta yayin vaani shemen. kal hu shehekellu birushshat hagger kede shello yachazor lesuro. veim mishshebbau lirshut hagger asur: 
Yisrael shemmachar yeno leakkum pasak ad shello madad lo damav muttarin. shemmishsheppasak samcha dato umishshemmashach kana veyen nesech eno naase ad sheyyigga bo. nimtza bishat mechira haya muttar. madad lo ad shello pasak haddamim damav asurin. shehare lo samcha dato af al pi shemmashach venimtza keshennaga adayin lo samcha dato likkach veneesar hayyayin bingiato vahare ze kemocher setam yenam: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshemmadad hayyisreeli lechelav. aval im madad lichli haakkum o lichli yisrael shebbeyad haakkum tzarich likkach et haddamim veachar kach yimdod. veim madad velo lakach damim af al pi sheppasak damav asurim shemmishsheyaggia lakkeli neesar kistam yenam: 
Hannoten dinar lechenvani akkum veamar lefoalo haakkum lech ushete veechol min hachenvani vaani mechashshev lo hare ze choshesh shemma yishte yayin. shezze kemi shekkana lo yen nesech vehishkahu. ucheneged ze bishviit asur kegon shennatan dinar lechenvani yisrael am haaretz veamar lefoalo hayyisreeli lech veechol vaani mechashshev lo. veim achal happoel davar sheeno meessar asur: 
Aval im amar lahem ichlu ushetu bedinar ze. o sheamar lahem ichlu ushetu alay min hachenvani vaani porea af al pi shennishtabed hoil velo nityached shibudo hare ze muttar veeno choshesh lo mishshum yen nesech velo mishshum sheviit velo mishshum maaser: 
Melech shehaya mechallek yeno laam velokeach mehen damav kefi ma sheyyirtze. al yomar adam leakkum he lecha matayim zuz vehikkanes tachtay beotzar hammelech kede sheyyikkach akkum hayyayin shekkatvu beshem yisrael veyitten haakkum haddamim lammelech. aval omer lo he lecha matayim zuz umalleteni min haotzar: 
Akkum shennaga beyeno shel yisrael leanso muttar limkor oto yayin leoto haakkum sheasaro levaddo. shekkevan shennitkavven ze haakkum lehazziko veleesor yeno hare ze kemo sheshshevaro o serafo shechayyav leshallem. venimtzeu haddamim shellokeach mimmennu deme hahezzek velo deme hammechira:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 14: Kol issure maachalot shebbattora shiuran bichzayit benoni ben lemalkot ben lecharet ben lemita bide shamayim. uchevar bearnu shekkol hamechuyyav karet o mita bide shamayim al maachol loke:

Veshiur ze im kol hashshiurin halacha lemoshe missinay hem. veasur min hattora leechol kol shehu middavar haasur. aval eno loke ella al kezayit. veim achal kol shehu pachot mikkashshiur makkin oto makkat mardut:

Kezayit sheamarnu chutz mishshel ben hashshinnayim. aval ma shel ben hachanichayim mitztaref lema shebbala shehare nehena gerono mikkezayit. afillu achal kachatzi zayit vehekio vechazar veachal oto chatzi zayit atzmo sheheki chayyav. sheen hachiyyuv ella al hanaat haggaron bichzayit middavar haasur:

Kezayit chelev o nevela o piggul o notar vechayyotze bahen shehinnicho bachamma venitmaet. haochlo patur. chazar vehinnicho baggeshamim venitpach chayyavin alav karet o malkot. haya pachot mikkezayit mibbattechilla venitpach veamad al kezayit asur veen lokin alav:

Kevar bearnu shekkol issurin shebbattora en mitztarfin ze im ze lichzayit. chutz mibbesar nevela im besar terefa veissure nazir sheyyitbaaru bimkoman. vachameshet mine tevua ukemachin shellahen vehabbetzekot shellahen hakkol mitztarfim lichzayit ben leissur chametz befesach. ben leissur chadash millifne haomer. ben leissure maaser sheni uterumot:

Yerae li shekkol hachayyav bitruma umaasrot mitztaref lichzayit betevel mippene shehu shem echad. ha lema ze dome lenivlat hashshor venivlat hasse venivlat hatztzevi shehen mitztarfin lichzayit kemo shebbearnu:

Haochel achila gedola middavar asur en mechayyevin oto malkot o karet al kol kezayit uchezayit ella chiyyuv echad lechol haachila. veim hayu haedim matrim bo bishat achila al kol kezayit uchezayit chayyav al kol hateraa vehateraa veaf al pi shehi achila achat velo hifsik:

Haochel kisora o kechardal meechad mikkol maachalot haasurim veshaha meat vechazar veachal kechardal. vechen ad shehishlim kezayit. ben beshogeg ben bemezid. im shaha mittechilla vead sof kede achilat shalosh betzim yitztaref hakkol vahare hu chayyav karet o malkot o karban kemo sheachal kezayit bevat achat. veim shaha yeter mizze mittechilla vead sof af al pi shello shaha benehen ella achal kechardal achar kechardal hoil velo hishlim kezayit ella beyeter mikkede achilat peras enan mitztarfin ufatur:

Vechen hashshote reviit shel setam yenam meat meat. o shehimcha et hechametz befesach o et hachelev ugemao meat meat. o sheshshata min haddam meat meat. im shaha mittechilla vead sof kede shetiyyat reviit mitztarfin. veim lav en mitztarfin:

Kol hoochalin haasurin eno chayyav alehem ad sheyyochal otan derech hanaa chutz mibbasar bechalav vechile hakkerem lefi shello neemar bahen achila ella hotzi issur achilatan belashon acheret bilshon bishshul uvilshon hekdesh leesor otan vaafillu shello kederech hanaya:

Ketzad. hare shehimcha et hachelev ugemao keshehu cham ad shennichva gerono mimmennu o sheachal chelev chay. o sheerev devarim marim kegon rosh velaana letoch yen nesech o letoch kedera shel nevela vaachalan keshehen marin. o sheachal ochel haasur achar shehisriach vehivish uvatal meochel adam hare ze patur. veim erev davar mar betoch kedera shel basar bechalav o beyen kile hakkerem vaachalo chayyav:

Haochel maachol mimmaachalot haasurot derech sechok o kemitassek. af al pi shello nitkavven leguf haachila. hoil venehena chayyav kemi shemmitkavven leatzmah shel achila. vahanaya habbaa lo leadam beal karcho beissur mikkol haissurin im nitkavven asur veim lo nitkavven muttar:
Haochel maachol asur leteavon o mippene haraav chayyav. veim haya toe bammidbar veen lo ma yochal ella devar issur hare ze muttar mippene sakkanat nefashot:

Ubbara shehericha maachol asur kegon besar kodesh o besar chazir. maachilin otah min hammarak. im nityashsheva datah mutav. veim lav maachilin otah pachot mikkashshiur. veim lo nityashsheva datah maachilin otah ad shettityashshev datah:
Vechen hachole sheheriach davar sheyyesh bo chometz vechayyotze bo middevarim shemmeararin et hannefesh dino keubbara:

Mi sheachazo bulmos maachilin oto devarim haasurim miyyad ad sheyyeoru enav. veen mechazzerin al davar hammuttar ella memaharin bannimtza. umaachilin oto hakkal hakkal techilla. im heiru enav dayyo. veim lav maachilin oto hechamur:

Ketzad. hayu lefanenu tevel unevela maachilin oto nevela techilla shehattevel bemita. nevela usefiche sheviit maachilin oto sefiche sheviit sheasurin middivre sofrim kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot shemitta. tevel usheviit maachilin oto sheviit. tevel uteruma im i efshar letakken hattevel maachilin oto tevel sheeno kadosh kitruma. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kevar bearnu sheen issur chal al issur ella im hayu shene haissurin bain keachat o shehaya issur mosif o issur kolel. lefichach yesh ochel kezayit echad veloke alav chamesh malkiyyot. vehu shehitru bo bachamishsha issurin shennitkabbetzu bo. ketzad. kegon tame sheachal kezayit chelev shennotar min hammukdashim beyom hakkippurim loke mishshum ochel chelev. umishshum ochel notar. umishshum ochel beyom hakkippurim. umishshum tame sheachal kodesh. umishshum shennehena min hakkodesh umaal:

Velamma chal kan issur al issur. shebbehema zo haya chelbah asur baachila umuttar bahanaya. hikdishah neesar chelbah bahanaya umittoch shennosaf bo issur hanaya nosaf alav issur kadashim. vaadayin haya chelev ze muttar legavoah veasur lehedyot. naasa notar mittoch shennosaf bo issur legavoah neesar lehedyot. vehaochel hazze haya muttar bivsar habbehema veasur bechelbah. nitma neesar af bivsarah nosaf lo issur al hachelev. ba yom hakkippurim kalal kol hoochalin. umittoch shenneesar af bechullin nosaf issuro bechelev ze. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 15: Davar asur shennitarev bedavar muttar min besheeno mino benoten taam. umin bemino shei efshar laamod al taamo yibbatel berov:

Ketzad. chelev hakkelayot shennafal letoch haggerisin venimmoach hakkol. toamin et haggerisin. im lo nimtza bahen taam chelev hare ellu muttarin. veim nimtza bahem taam chelev vehaya bahen mammasho hare ellu asurin min hattora. nimtza bahen taamo velo haya bahen mammasho hare ellu asurin middivre sofrim:

Ketzad hu mammasho. kegon shehaya min hachelev kezayit bechol shalosh betzim min hattaarovet. im achal min haggerisin haellu keshalosh betzim hoil veyesh bahen kezayit min hachelev loke shehare taam haissur umammasho kayyam. aval pachot mishshalosh betzim makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem. vechen im lo haya battaarovet kezayit bechol shalosh betzim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam chelev veachal kol hakkedera eno loke ella makkat mardut:

Nafal chelev kelayot lechelev haalya venimmoach hakkol. im haya chelev haalya kishnayim bechelev hakkelayot hare hakkol muttar min hattora. afillu chatichat nevela shennitarva bishte chatichot shel shechuta hakkol muttar min hattora. aval middivre sofrim hakkol asur ad sheyovad davar haasur meotzem miuto velo yihye davar chashuv sheeno omedet kemo sheyyitbaer:
Uvechamma yitarev davar haasur veyovad beotzem miuto. kashshiur shennatnu bo chachamim. yesh davar sheshshiuro beshishshim. veyesh sheshshiuro bemea. veyesh sheshshiuro bematayim:

Nimtzeta lamed shekkol issurin shebbattora. ben issure malkot. ben issure karet. ben issure hanaya. shennitarvu bammaachol hammuttar min besheeno mino benoten taam. min bemino shei efshar laamod al hattaam shiuro beshishshim o bemea o bematayim. chutz miyyen nesech mippene chumrat avoda zara. vechutz mittevel shehare efshar letakkeno. umippene ze osrin beminan bechol shehen. veshello beminan benoten taam kishar kol haissurin:

Ketzad. tippat yen nesech shennaflu aleha kamma chaviyyot shel yayin hakkol asur kemo sheyyitbaer. vechen kos shel yen tevel shennitarev bechavit hakkol tevel ad sheyyafrish terumot umaasrot haruyin letaarovet kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Perot sheviit af al pi sheim nitarvu beminan bechol shehu veshello beminan benoten taam enan bichlal issure tora sheen otah hattaarovet asura. ella chayyav leechol kol hattaarovet bikdushshat sheviit kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Chametz befesach af al pi shehu meissure tora eno bichlalot ellu. lefi sheen hattaarovet asura leolam shehare leachar happesach tihye kol hattaarovet mutteret kemo shebbearnu. lefichach oser bechol shehu ben bemino ben shello bemino:

Vehu haddin litvua chadasha shennitarva bishana millifne haomer oseret bechol shehu. shehare yesh lah mattirin shelleachar haomer yuttar hakkol. vechen kol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin vaafillu haya issuro middivrehem kegon issur muktze venolad beyom tov lo natnu bo chachamim shiur ella afillu echad bechamma alafim eno batel. shehare yesh derech sheyyuttar bah kegon hekdesh umaaser sheni vechayyotze bahen:
Aval haarla vechile hakkerem vechelev vedam vechayyotze bahen vechen terumot natnu chachamim bahen shiur sheen bahen derech hetter lechol adam:

Yerae li sheafillu davar sheyyesh lo mattirin im nitarev besheeno mino velo natan taam muttar. lo yihye ze sheyyesh lo mattirin chamur mittevel shehare efshar letakkeno veaf al pi ken shello bemino benoten taam kemo shebbearnu. veal titma al chametz befesach shehattora amra <small>(Shemot 12 20)</small> "kol machmetzet lo tochelu" lefichach hechmiru bo kemo shebbearnu:

Veellu hen hashshiurin shennatnu chachamim. hatteruma uterumat maaser vehachalla vehabbikkurim olin beechad umea vetzarich leharim umitztarfin ze im ze. vechen perusa shel lechem happanim letoch perusot shel chullin olin beechad umea. ketzad. sea kemach meechad meellu. o sea mikkullam shennafla lemea sea kemach shel chullin venitarev hakkol. merim min hakkol sea achat keneged sea shennafla vehashshear muttar lechol adam. nafla lefachot mimmea naase hakkol medumma:

Haarla vechile hakkerem olin beechad umatayim umitztarfin ze im ze veeno tzarich leharim. ketzad. reviit shel yen arla o kile hakkerem o shehayta harviit mitztarefet mishshenehem shennafla letoch matayim reviiyyot shel yayin hakkol muttar veeno tzarich leharim kelum. nafla lefachot mimmatayim hakkol asur bahanaya:

Velamma tzarich leharim hatteruma velo yarim arla vechile hakkerem. shehatteruma mamon kohanim. lefichach kol teruma sheen hakkohanim makpidin aleha kegon terumat hakkelisin vehacharuvin useorin shebbeedom eno tzarich leharim:

Velamma kaflu shiur arla vechile hakkerem mippene shehen asurin bahanaya. velamma samchu al shiur mea bitrumot shehare terumat maaser echad mimmea umekaddesh hakkol shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 29)</small> "et mikdesho mimmennu" amru chachamim davar sheatta merim mimmennu im chazar letocho mekaddesho:

Shear issurin shebbattora kullan kegon besar shekatzim uremasim vechelev vedam vechayyotze bahen shiuran beshishshim. ketzad. kezayit chelev kelayot shennafal letoch shishshim kezayit mechelev haalya hakkol muttar. nafal lefachot mishshishshim hakkol asur. vechen im nafal kisora chelev tzarich sheyyihye sham kemo shishshim seora. vechen bishar issurin. vechen shumman shel gid hannashe shennafal likdera shel basar meshaarin oto beshishshim. veen shumman haggid min hamminyan. veaf al pi sheshshumman gid hannashe middivrehem kemo shebbearnu. hoil vegid hannashe beriyya bifne atzmah hechmiru bo keissure tora. vehaggid atzmo en meshaarin bo veeno oser sheen baggidim benoten taam:
Aval kechal shenitbashshel im habbasar beshishshim uchechal min hamminyan. hoil vehakkechal middivrehem kemo shebbearnu hekellu beshiuro:

Betza shennimtza bah efroach shennishleka im betzim hammuttarot im hayta im shishshim veachat vehi hare hen muttarot. hayta im shishshim bilvad neesru hakkol mippene shehi beriyya bifne atzmah asu hekker bah vehosifu beshiurah:
Aval betzat of tame shennishleka im betze of tahor lo asra otam. veim taraf ellu im ellu. o shennitarva betzat of tame o betzat terefa im betzim acherot shiuran beshishshim:

Uminnayin samchu chachamim al shiur shishshim. shehare hammuram meel nazir vehi hazzeroa echad mishshishshim mishshear haayil vehi mitbashshelet immo veenah oseret oto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 6 19)</small> "velakach hakkohen et hazzeroa beshela min haayil":

Min bemino vedavar acher shennitarvu kegon kedera shehaya bah chelev alya ugerisin venafal letochah chelev hakkelayot venimcha hakkol venaasa guf echad. roin et chelev haalya veet haggerisin keillu hen guf echad umeshaarin chelev hakkelayot bigrisin uvealyya. im haya echad mishshishshim muttar. shehare i efshar kan laamod al hattaam:
Vehu haddin latterumot shennitarvu leshaaran bemea. vechile hakkerem o arla leshaer otan bematayim:

Keshemmeshaarin bechol haissurin ben beshishshim ben bemea ben bematayim. meshaarin bammarak uvattavlin uvechol sheyyesh bakkedera uvema shebbala kedera meachar shennafal haissur lefi omed haddaat. shehare i efshar laamod al ma shebbala betzimtzum:

Asur levattel issurin shel tora lechattechilla. veim bittel hare ze muttar. veaf al pi chen kansu oto chachamim veasru hakkol. veyerae li shekkevan shehu kenas en osrin taarovet zo ella al ze haover shebbittel haissur. aval laacherim hakkol muttar:

Ketzad. hare shennafla sea shel arla letoch mea sea shehare neesar hakkol. lo yavi mea sea acherot vitzaref kede shettaale beechad umatayim. veim avar veasa ken hakkol muttar. aval beissur shel divrehem mevattelin haissur lechattechilla:
Ketzad. chalav shennafal likdera sheyyesh bah besar of venatan taam bakkedera marbe alav besar of acher ad sheyyibbatel hattaam. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kevar bearnu sheim natan davar haasur taamo bedavar hammuttar neesar hakkol. bamme devarim amurim beshehishbicho. aval im pagam ze haasur lammuttar vehifsid taamo hare ze muttar. vehu sheyyihye pogem mittechilla vead sof. aval im pagam battechilla vesofo lehashebiach. o hishbiach battechilla af al pi shessofo lifgom hare ze asur:
Umi yitom et hattaarovet. im haya hameorav terumot im hachullin toem otan hakkohen. im haya taam hatteruma nikkar hakkol medumma. uvehilchot terumot yitbaer din hamedumma:

Veim haya basar bechalav o yen nesech veyen arla vechile hakkerem shennaflu lidvash. o besar shekatzim uremasim shennitbashshel im hayyarak vechayyotze bahen. toem otan haakkum vesomchin al piv. im amar en bo taam o sheamar yesh bo taam umittaam ra hu vahare pegamo hakkol muttar. vehu shello yihye sofo lehashebiach kemo shebbearnu. veim en sham akkum litom meshaarin oto beshiuro beshishshim o bammea o bematayim:

Achbar shennafal leshechar o lechometz meshaarin oto beshishshim. sheanu choshshin shemma taamo bashshechar uvachometz mashbiach. aval im nafal leyayin o leshemen o lidvash muttar vaafillu natan taam mippene shettaamo pogem. shekkol ellu tzerichin lihyotan mevussamim veze masrichan umafsid taaman:

Gedi shetztzelao bechelbo asur leechol afillu miktze azno. shehachelev nivla beevarav vehu mashbicho venoten bo taam. lefichach im haya kachush velo haya bo chelev kelayot velo chelev kerev ella meat keechad mishshishshim kolef veochel ad shemmaggia lachelev. vechen yarech shetztzelaah begid hannashe shebbah kolef veochel ad shehu maggia laggid umashlicho. vechen behema shetztzelaah shelema velo hesir lo chutin velo kerumot haasurot kolef veochel. vechevan sheyyaggia ledavar asur chotcho umashlicho sheen baggidim benoten taam kede leshaer bahen:

En tzolin besar shechuta im besar nevela o behema temea betannur echad. veaf al pi sheen nogin ze baze. veim tzelaan hare ze muttar. vaafillu hayta haasura shemena harebe vehammutteret raza shehareach eno oser. veeno oser ella taamo shel issur:

Besar nevela maliach shennivlal immo besar shechuta hare ze neesar. mippene shettamtzit hannevela nivlaat beguf besar hashshechuta vei efshar laamod kan lo al hattaam velo al hashshiur. vechen besar dag tame maliach shennivlal immo dag tafel tahor neesar mippene tziro. aval im haya hammaliach tahor vehattafel dag tame lo neesar hammaliach [af al pi] shehattafel bolea min hammaliach [ eno bolea kol kach sheyyachzor veyiflot]. dag tame shekkevasho im dag tahor hakkol asur ella im ken haya hattame echad mimmatayim min hattahor:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 16: Kol hashshiurim haellu shennatnu chachamim ledavar haasur shennitarev bemino hammuttar beshello haya haddavar haasur mechammetz o metabbel. o davar chashuv shehu omed kemot shehu velo nitarev venidma bedavar hammuttar. aval im haya mechammetz o metabbel o davar chashuv oser bechol shehu:

Ketzad. seor shel chittin shel teruma shennafal letoch issat chittin shel chullin veyesh bo kede lechammetz hare haissa kullah medumma. vechen tavlin shel teruma shennaflu likderat chullin veyesh bahen kede letabbel vehen mimmin hachullin hakkol medumma. veaf al pi shehasseor o hattavlin echad meelef. vechen seor shel kile hakkerem letoch haissa o tavlin shel arla letoch hakkedera hakkol asur bahanaya:

Davar chashuv shehu oser bemino bechol shehu shiva devarim veellu hen. egoze perech. verimmone bedan. vechaviyyot setumot. vachalafot teradin. vekilche keruv. udelaat yevanit. vechikkarot shel baal habbayit:

Ketzad. rimmon echad merimmone bedan shehaya arla venitarev bechamma alafim rimmonim hakkol asur bahanaya. vechen chavit setuma shel yen arla o shel kile hakkerem shennitarva bechamma alafim chaviyyot setumot hakkol asurim bahanaya. vechen shear hashshiva devarim:

Vechen chaticha shel nevela o shel besar behema o chayya o of o dag hattemein shennitarva bechamma alafim chatichot hakkol asur ad sheyyagbiah otah chaticha. veachar kach yeshaer hashshear beshishshim. sheim lo higbihah hare haddavar haasur omed velo nishtanna vehachaticha chashuva etzlo shehare mitkabbed bah lifne haorchin:

Vehu haddin bachaticha shel basar bechalav o shel chullin shennishchatu baazara shehare hen asurim middivrehen bahanaya kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot shechita osrin bechol shehen ad sheyyagbiah otan. vechen gid hannashe shennitbashshel im haggidin o im habbasar bizman shemmakkiro magbiho vehashshear muttar sheen baggidim benoten taam. veim eno makkiro hakkol asur mippene shehu beriyya bifne atzmo hare hu chashuv veoser bechol shehu:

Vechen kol baale chayyim chashuvin hen veenam betelin. lefichach shor hanniskal shennitarev beelef shevarim veegla arufa beelef eglot. o tzippor metzora hashshechuta beelef tzipporim o peter chamor beelef chamorim kullan asurin bahanaya. aval shear haddevarim af al pi sheddarkan limmanot hare ellu olin beshiuran:
Ketzad. agudda shel yarak mikkile hakkerem shennitarva bematayim aguddot. o etrog shel arla shennitarev bematayim etrogim. hakkol muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Yerae li shekkol davar shehu chashuv etzel bene makom min hammekomot. kegon egoze perech verimmone bedan beeretz yisrael beotan hazzemannim. shehu oser bechol shehu lefi chashivuto beoto makom uveoto zeman. velo huzkeru ellu ella lefi shehen osrin kol shehen bechol makom. vehu haddin lechol kayyotze bahen bishar mekomot. vedavar barur hu shekkol issurin haellu middivrehem:

Nafal rimmon echad min hattaarovet hazzot lishne rimmonim acherim merimmone bedan. venafal min hashshelosha rimmon echad lerimmonim acherim. hare ellu haacherim muttarin shehare harimmon shel taarovet harishona batel berov. veim nafal min hattaarovet harishona rimmon leelef kullan asurin. lo neemar batel berov ella lehattir sefek sefekan sheim yippol min hattaarovet hashsheniyya lemakom acher eno oser. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Nitpatztzeu egozim ellu shenneesru kullan mippene egoz arla shebbenehen o nitparru harimmonim venitpattechu hechaviyyot venitchattechu haddeluin venitparsu hakkikkarot achar shenneesru hare ellu yaalu beechad umatayim. vehu haddin lachatichat nevela shenniddocha bechol hachatichot venaasa hakkol kemot shehi ole beshishshim:

Veasur liftzoa haegozim ulefarer harimmonim veliftoach hechaviyyot achar shenneesru kede sheyyaalu beechad umatayim sheen mevattelin issur lechattechilla. veim asa ken konsin oto veosrin alav kemo shebbearnu:

Seor shel kile hakkerem veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haissa lo baze kede lechammetz velo baze kede lechammetz uvishnehem kesheyyitztarfu yesh bahem kede lechammetz. otah issa asura leyisrael umutteret lakkohanim. vechen tavlin shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu letoch hakkedera. velo beechad mehen kede letabbel uvishnehem kede letabbel. otah kedera asura leyisrael shehare davar haasur lahem tibbela. umutteret lakkohanim:

Tavlin shehem shenayim o shelosha shemot mimmin echad o shelosha minin mishshem echad mitztarfin letabbel veleesor vechen lechammetz. ketzad. seor shel chittin useor shel seorim hoil veshem seor echad hu enan kemin vesheeno mino. ella hare hen kemin echad umitztaref leshaer bahen kede lechammetz beissa shel chittin im haya taam shenehem taam chittin. o kede lechammetz beissa shel seorin im haya taam shenehem taam seorim:
Shelosha shemot mimmin echad ketzad. kegon karpas shel neharot vecharpas shel afar vecharpas shel ginna af al pi shekkol echad mehen shem bifne atzmo hoil vehem min echad mitztarfin letabbel:

Issa mechummetzet shennafal letochah seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem. vechen kedera metubbelet shennaflu letochah tavlin shel teruma o shel arla veshel kile hakkerem. im yesh basseor kede lechammetz illu hayta haissa matztza. uvattavlin kede letabbel hakkedera illu hayta tefela hare hakkol asur. veim en bahem kede letabbel ulechammetz yaalu beshiuran. teruma beechad umea vearla vechile hakkerem beechad umatayim:

Hatteruma mala et haarla veet kile hakkerem. ketzad. sea teruma shennafla letisha vetishim chullin veachar kach nafal lakkol chatzi sea shel arla o shel kile hakkerem en kan issur arla velo issur kile hakkerem. shehare ala beechad umatayim. veaf al pi shemmiktzat hammatayim teruma:

Vechen haarla vechile hakkerem maalin et hatteruma. ketzad. mea sea shel arla o shel kile hakkerem shennaflu letoch esrim elef shel chullin naaset kol hattaarovet esrim elef umea. veachar kach nafal lechol mea sea sea shel teruma hare hakkol muttar vetaale hatteruma beechad umea. veaf al pi shemmiktzat hammea hammaalin otah arla o kile hakkerem:

Vechen haarla maala et kile hakkerem. vechile hakkerem et haarla. vechile hakkerem et kile hakkerem. vehaarla et haarla. ketzad. matayim sea shel arla o shel kile hakkerem shennaflu learbaim elef chullin. veachar kach nafal lechol matayim sea usea shel arla o shel kile hakkerem hakkol muttar. shekkevan shebbatel haissur shennafal techilla naasa hakkol kechullin hammuttarin:

Beged shetztzevao biklippe arla yissaref. nitarev baacherim yaale beechad umatayim. vechen tavshil shebbishshelo biklippe arla ufat sheafaah biklippe arla o bechile hakkerem yissaref hattavshil vehappat. shehare hanayato nikkeret bahen. nitarvu baacherim yaalu beechad umatayim:
Vechen beged shearag bo melo hassit shetztzevao baarla veen yadua e ze hu yaale beechad umatayim. nitarvu sammane arla besammane hetter yaalu beechad umatayim. me tzeva beme tzeva yibbatel berov:

Tannur shehissiko biklippe arla uvechile hakkerem ben chadash ben yashan yutzan. veachar kach yachem oto baatze hetter. veim bishshel bo kodem sheyyutzan ben pat ben tavshil hare ze asur bahanaya. yesh shevach atze issur befat o betavshil. garaf et kol haesh veachar kach bishshel o afa bechummo shel tannur hare ze muttar shehare atze issur halchu lahen:
Kearot vechosot ukederot utzelochiyyot shebbishshelan hayyotzer biklippe arla hare ellu asurin bahanaa. shehare davar haasur bahanaa asa otan chadash:

Pat shebbishshelah al gabbe gechalim shel atze arla mutteret. kevan shennaasu gechalim halach issuran af al pi shehen boarot. kedera shebbishshel otah biklippe arla o bechile hakkerem uvaatze hetter hare hattavshil asur. veaf al pi shezze veze gorem. shebbeshaa shennitbashshela mechamat atze issur adayin lo bau atze hahetter venimtza miktzat habbishshul baatze hetter umiktzato beissur:

Netia shel arla shennitarva bintiot. vechen aruga shel kile hakkerem baarugot. hare ze loket lechattechilla min hakkol. veim hayta netia bematayim netiot vaaruga bematayim arugot hare kol hannilkat muttar. veim hayu befachot mizze kol hannilkat asur. velamma hittiru lo lilkot lechattechilla vehaya min haddin sheosrin lo hakkol ad sheyyitrach veyotzi hannetia vehaaruga haasura. shehaddavar chazaka sheen adam oser karmo bintia achat veillu haya yodah haya motziah:

Hammaamid gevina bisraf pagge arla. o bekevat tikrovet akkum. o bechometz yayin shel akkum. hare zo asura bahanaya af al pi shehu min besheeno mino veaf al pi shehu kol shehu. shehare haddavar haasur hu hannikkar vehu sheasa otah gevina:
Haarla vechile hakkerem din happerot shellahen sheyyissarfu. vehammashkin shellahen yikkavru mippene shei efshar lisrof hammashkin:

Yayin shennitnassech leakkum shennitarev im hayyayin hakkol asur bahanaya bechol shehu kemo sheamarnu. bamme devarim amurim beshehurak hayyayin hammuttar al tippa shel yen nesech. aval im era yen nesech mitztziltzul katan letoch habbor shel yayin. afillu era kol hayyom kullo rishon rishon batel. era min hechavit ben sheera min hammuttar laasur o min haasur lammuttar hakkol asur mippene shehaammud hayyored mippi hechavit gadol:

Nitarev setam yenam bayyayin hare ze asur bechol shehu bishtiyya veyimmacher kullo leakkum. velokeach deme hayyayin haasur shebbo umashlicho leyam hammelach veyehane bishar hammaot. vechen im nitarva chavit shel yen nesech ben hechaviyyot hakkol asurin bishtiyya umuttarin bahanaya. veyolich deme otah chavit leyam hammelach kesheyyimkor hakkol leakkum. vechen bechavit shel setam yenam:

Mayim shennitarvu beyayin o yayin bemayim benoten taam mippene shehen min besheeno mino. bamme devarim amurim beshennafal hammashke hammuttar letoch hammashke haasur. aval im nafal hammashke haasur letoch hammashke hammuttar rishon rishon batel. vehu sheyyurak mitztziltzul katan shehaya merik veyored meat meat. veheach yihyu hammayim asurim kegon shehayu neevadin o tikrovet akkum:

Bor shel yayin shennafal letocho kiton shel mayim techilla veachar kach nafal letocho yen nesech. roim et yen hahetter keillu eno vehammayim shennaflu meshaarin bahen im yen nesech. im reuyin levattel taam oto yen nesech hare hammayim ravin alav umevattelin oto veyihye hakkol muttar:

Yen nesech shennafal al haanavim yedichem vehen muttarot baachila. veim hayu mevukkaot ben shehaya hayyayin yashan ben shehaya chadash im noten taam baanavim hare ellu asurot bahanaya. veim lav hare ellu muttarot baachila:
Nafal al gabbe teenim hare ellu muttarot mippene shehayyayin pogem betaam hatteenim:

Yen nesech shennafal al hachittim hare ellu asurot baachila umuttarot bahanaya. velo yimkerem leakkum shemma yachazor veyimkerem leyisrael. ella ketzad ose. tochen otan veose mehen pat umochrah leakkum shello bifne yisrael kede shello yikkechu otah yisrael min haakkum shehare pat akkum asura kemo sheyyitbaer. velamma en bodkin et hachittim benoten taam mippene shehen shoavot vehayyayin nivla bahen:

Yen nesech shehechemitz venafal letoch chometz shechar oser bechol shehu mippene shehu bemino sheshshenehen chometz hen. veyayin shennitarev im hachometz ben shennafal chometz layyayin ben shennafal yayin lachometz meshaarin oto benoten taam:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 17: Kedera shel cheres shennotibbashshel bah besar nevela o besar shekatzim uremasim lo yevashshel bah besar shechuta beoto hayyom. veim bishshel bah min basar hattavshil asur. bishshel bah min acher benoten taam:

Velo asra tora ella kedera bat yomah bilvad hoil vaadayin lo nifgam hashshumman shennivla bakkedera. umiddivre sofrim lo yevashshel bah leolam. lefichach en lokchin kele cheres yeshanim min haakkum shennishtammeshu bahen bechammin kegon kederot ukearot leolam. vaafillu hayu shoin baavar. veim lakach uvishshel bahen miyyom sheni vahala hattavshil muttar:

Hallokeach kele tashmish seudda min haakkum mikkele mattachot uchele zechuchit. devarim shello nishtammesh bahen kol ikkar matbilan beme mikve veachar kach yihyu muttarin leechol bahen velishtot. udevarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede tzonen kegon kosot utzelochiyyot vekitoniyyot medichan umatbilan vehen muttarot. udevarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede chammin kegon yorot vekumkemosin umechammeme chammin magilan umatbilan vehen muttarin. udevarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede haur kegon shippudin veaskelaot melabbenan baur ad shettinshar kelippatan umatbilan vehen muttarin:

Ketzad magilan. noten yora ketanna letoch yora gedola umemalle aleha mayim ad sheyyatzufu al hakketanna umartichah yafe yafe. veim hayta yora gedola makkif al sefatah batzek o tit umemalle mayim ad sheyyatzufu hammayim al sefatah umartiach. vechullan shennishtammesh bahen ad shello hirtiach o ad shello hediach vead shello hilbin vead shello hitbil muttar. shekkol hashshumman shebbahen noten taam lifgam hu kemo shebbearnu:

Tevila zo shemmatbilin kele hasseudda hannilkachim min haakkum veachar kach yutteru laachila ushetiyya enan leinyan tuma vetohora ella middivre sofrim. veremez lah <small>(Bamidbar lo 23)</small> "kol davar asher yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh vetaher" umippi hashshemua lamdu sheeno medabber ella betohoratan mide giule akkum lo mide tuma. sheen lecha tuma ola al yede haesh vechol hattemeim bitvila olin mittumatan. vetumat met behazzaa utevila veen sham esh kelal. ella leinyan giule akkum. vechevan shekkatuv vetaher amru chachamim hosef lo tohora achar avirato baesh lehattiro miggiule akkum:

Lo chiyyevu bitvila zo ella kele mattachot shel seudda hannilkachin min haakkum. aval hashshoel min haakkum. o shemmishken haakkum etzlo kele mattachot. mediach o martiach o melabben veeno tzarich lehatebil. vechen im lakach kele etz o kele avanim mediach o martiach veeno tzarich lehatebil. vechen kele charasim eno tzarich lehatebil. aval hashshoin baavar hare hen kichle mattachot utzerichin tevila:

Hallokeach sakkin min haakkum melabbenah baesh o mashchizah barechayim shellah. veim hayta sakkin yafa sheen bah pegimot day lo im neatzah bekarka kasha eser peamim veochel bah tzonen. veim hayu bah pegimot o shehayta yafa veratza leechol bah chammin o lishchot bah melabbenah o mashchizah kullah. shachat bah kodem sheyyetaharenna mediach mekom hashshechita. veim killef hare ze meshubbach:
Sakkin sheshshachat bah terefa lo yishchot bah ad sheyyedichah afillu betzonen o mekannechah bivlayot shel begadim:

Veyesh sham devarim acherim asru otan chachamim veaf al pi sheen leissuran ikkar min hattora gazru alehen kede lehitrachek min haakkum ad shello yitarvu bahen yisrael veyavou lide chatnut. veellu hen. asru lishtot immahen vaafillu bemakom sheen lachush leyen nesech. veasru leechol pittan o bishshulehen vaafillu bemakom sheen lachush legiulehen:

Ketzad. lo yishte adam bimsibba shel akkum. veaf al pi shehu yayin mevushshal sheeno neesar. o shehaya shote mikkelav levaddo. veim haya rov hammesibba yisrael muttar. veen shotin shechar shellahen sheosin min hattemarim vehatteenim vechayyotze bahen. veeno asur ella bimkom mechirato. aval im hevi hashshechar leveto veshatahu sham muttar sheikkar haggezera shemma yisod etzlo:
Yen tappuchim veyen rimmonim vechayyotze bahen muttar lishtotan bechol makom. davar sheeno matzuy lo gazru alav. yen tzimmukim hare hu keyayin umitnassech:

Af al pi sheasru pat akkum. yesh mekomot shemmekillin baddavar velokchin pat hannachtom haakkum bemakom sheen sham nachtom yisrael uvassade mippene shehu sheat haddechak. aval pat baale battim en sham mi shemmore bah lehakel sheikkar haggezera mishshum chatnut veim yochal pat baale battim yavo lisod etzlan:

Hidlik haakkum et hattannur veafa bo yisrael. o shehidlik yisrael veafa akkum. o shehidlik haakkum veafa haakkum uva yisrael venier haesh meat o kevasho laesh hoil venishtattef bimlechet happat hare zo mutteret. vaafillu lo zarak ella etz letoch hattannur hittir kol happat shebbo. sheen haddavar ella lihyot hekker shehappat shellahen asura:

Akkum shebbishshel lanu yayin o chalav o devash o perishin vechayyotze beellu (mikkol) davar hanneechol kemot shehu chay hare ellu muttarin. velo gazru ella al davar sheeno neechol kemot shehu chay. kegon basar vedag tafel uvetza virakot. im bishshelan haakkum mittechilla vead sof velo nishtattef yisrael immo bevishshulan hare ellu asurin mishshum bishshule akkum:

Bamme devarim amurim bedavar shehu ole al shulchan melachim leechol bo et happat. kegon basar uvetzim vedagim vechayyotze bahem. aval davar sheeno ole al shulchan melachim leechol bo et happat kegon turmosin sheshshalku otan akkum af al pi sheenan neechalin chayyin hare ellu muttarin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. sheikkar haggezera mishshum chatnut shello yezammeno haakkum etzlo basseudda. vedavar sheeno ole al shulchan melachim leechol bo et happat en adam mezammen et chavero alav:

Vedagim ketannim shemmelachan yisrael o akkum hare hen kemo shennitbashshelu miktzat bishshul. veim tzelaan akkum achar ken muttarin. vechol shebbishshelo yisrael meat bishshulo ben battechilla ben bassof muttar. lefichach im hinniach haakkum basar o kedera al gabbe haesh vehafach yisrael babbasar vehegis bakkedera o shehinniach yisrael vegamar haakkum hare ze muttar:

Dag shemmelacho akkum uferot sheishshenan ad shehichshiran laachila hare ellu muttarin. maliach eno keroteach bigzera zo vehameeshshan eno kimvushshal. vechen kelayot shel akkum muttarin velo gazru alehem sheen adam mezammen chavero al hakkelayot:

Polin vaafunin vaadashim vechayyotze bahen sheshsholkin otan haakkum umochrin otan asurin mishshum bishshule akkum bemakom sheolin al shulchan melachim mishshum parperet. umishshum giule akkum bechol makom shemma yevashshelu otan im habbasar o bikdera shebbishshelu bah basar. vechen hassufganin shekkolin otan haakkum beshemen asurin af mishshum giule akkum:

Akkum shebbishshel velo nitkavven levishshul hare ze muttar. ketzad. akkum shehitztzit ur baagam kede lehaavir hechatzir venitbashshelu bah chagavim hare ellu muttarin. vaafillu bemakom shehen olin al shulchan melachim mishshum parperet. vechen im charach harosh lehaavir hassear muttar leechol min haddildulin umin rosh aznayim shennitztzelu bishat charicha:
Temarim sheshshalku otan akkum im hayu metukin mittechillatan hare ellu muttarin. veim hayu marin umetakkenin habbishshul hare ellu asurin. hayu benoniyyim hare ellu asurin:
Kali shel adashim shellasho ben bemayim ben bechometz hare ze asur. aval kali shel chittim useorim shellashin otan bemayim hare ze muttar:

Shemen shel akkum muttar. umi sheosro hare ze omed bechet gadol. mippene shemmamre al pi bet din shehittiruhu. vaafillu nitbashshel hashshemen hare ze muttar. veeno neesar lo mippene bishshule akkum mippene shenneechol kemot shehu chay. velo mippene giule akkum mippene shehabbasar pogem et hashshemen umasricho:
Vechen devash shel akkum shennitbashshel veasu mimmennu mine metika muttar mittaam ze:

Kosfan shel akkum shehuchammu chammin ben beyora gedola ben beyora ketanna muttar mippene shennoten taam lifgam hu. vechen kevashin sheen darkan latet letochan chometz o yayin o zetim hakkevushin vachagavim hakkevushin shebbain min haotzar muttarin. aval chagavim uchevashim shemmezallefin alehen yayin asurin. vechen im hayu mezallefin alehen chometz vaafillu chometz shechar asurin:
Umippene ma asru chometz shechar shel akkum mippene shemmashlichin letocho shimre yayin. lefichach hannilkach min haotzar muttar:

Hammureyas bemakom sheddarkan latet letocho yayin asur. veim haya hayyayin yakar min hammureyas muttar. vechaze morin bechol davar shechoshshin lo shemma ervu bo haakkum davar asur. sheen adam mearev davar hayyakar bezol shehare mafsid. aval mearev hazzol beyakar kede lehistakker:

Katan sheachal echad mimmaachalot asurot. o sheasa melacha beshabbat. en bet din metzuvvin alav lehaferisho lefi sheeno ben daat. bamme devarim amurim besheasa meatzmo. aval lehaachilo beyadayim asur vaafillu devarim sheissuran middivre sofrim. vechen asur leharegilo bechillul shabbat umoed vaafillu bidvarim shehen mishshum shevut:

Af al pi sheen bet din metzuvvin lehaferish et hakkatan. mitzva al aviv ligor bo ulehafrisho kede lechannecho bikdushsha. shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 6)</small> "chanoch lannaar al pi darko" vegomer:

Asru chachamim maachalot umashkin shennefesh rov bene adam kiha mehen kegon maachalot umashkin shennitarev bahen ki o tzoa velecha serucha vechayyotze bahen. vechen asru chachamim leechol velishtot bechelim hatztzoim shennafsho shel adam mitonenet mehem. kegon kele bet hakkisse uchele zechuchit shel sapparin sheggorin bahem et haddam vechayyotze bahen:

Vechen asru leechol beyadayim mesoavot mezohamot. veal gabbe kelim meluchlachim. shekkol devarim ellu bichlal <small>(Vayikra 11 43)</small> "al teshakketzu et nafshotechem". vehaochel maachalot ellu makkin oto makkat mardut:

Vechen asur leadam sheyyashhe et nekavav kelal ben gedolim ben ketannim. vechol hammashhe nekavav hare ze bichlal meshakketz nafsho. yeter al cholaim raim sheyyavi al atzmo veyitchayyev benafsho. ella rauy lo leharegil atzmo beittim mezummanim kede shello yitrachek bifne bene adam velo yeshakketz nafsho:

Vechol hannizhar bidvarim ellu mevi kedushsha vetohora yetera lenafsho. umemarek nafsho leshem hakkadosh baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 44)</small> "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani":
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 1:

Shene orot yesh lo lavveshet. hachitzon adom vehappenimi lavan. nikkav haechad mehen bilvad keshera. nikkevu shenehen bechol shehu bemakom harauy lishchita hare zo nevela. uven shennishchata bimkom hannekev ben shennishchata bemakom acher en hashshechita moelet bah. nikkevu shenehem ze shello keneged ze nevela: 
Nikkav havveshet veala bo kerum usetamo en hakkerum kelum vahare hu nakuv keshehaya. nimtza kotz omed bavveshet hare zo sefek nevela shemma nikkav havveshet veala kerum bimkom hannekev veeno nire. aval im nimtza hakkotz learko bavveshet en choshshin lo sherov habbehemot hammidbariyyot ochlot hakkotzim tamid: 
Veshet en lo bedika mibbachutz ella mibbifnim. ketzad. hofcho uvodek. im nimtza alav tippat dam beyadua shehaya nakuv: 
Gargeret shennifsak rov chalala bammakom harauy lishchita hare zo nevela. vechen im nikkeva keisar. nikkeva nekavim ketannim im nekavim sheen bahen chesron hem mitztarfin lerubbah veim nekavim sheyyesh bahem chesron mitztarfin lichisar. vechen im nittela mimmenna retzua mitztarefet lichisar. uveof kol sheillu mekappel hartzua o hannekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron umannichan al pi hakkane im chofe et rubbo nevela veim lav keshera: 
Nikkeva haggargeret nekev mefullash mishshene tzedadeha kede sheyyikkanes isar lerachbo nevela. nisdeka learkah afillu lo nishtayyer min hammakom harauy bah lishchita ella mashshehu lemala umashshehu lematta keshera: 
Gargeret shennikkeva veen yadua im kodem shechita nikkeva o achar shechita nikkeva. nokvin otah atta bemakom acher umedammin hannekev lenekev im nidme lo mutteret. veen medammin ella mechulya gedola lechulya gedola o mikketanna liktanna. aval lo mikketanna ligdola shekkol hakkane chulyot chulyot hu uven kol chulya vechulya chulya achat ketanna mishshetehen verakka:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 4:
Yisrael sheeno yodea chamishsha devarim shemmafsidin et hashshechita vechayyotze bahen mehilchot shechita shebbearnu veshachat beno leven atzmo asur leechol mishshechitato. lo hu velo acherim. vahare zo kerova lisfek nevela vehaochel mimmenna kezayit makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Vaafillu shachat befanenu arba vechamesh peamim shechita keshera vahare shechita zo sheshshachat beno leven atzmo shechita nechona ugemura asur leechol mimmenna. hoil veeno yodea devarim hammafsidim efshar sheyyafsid hashshechita vehu eno yodea kegon sheyyishhe o yidros o yishchot besakkin peguma vechayyotze beellu belo kavvanato: 
Yisrael sheyyodea hilchot shechita hare ze lo yishchot beno leven atzmo lechattechilla ad sheyyishchot bifne chacham peamim rabbot ad sheyyihye ragil vezariz. veim shachat techilla beno leven atzmo shechitato keshera: 
Hayyodea hilchot shechita veshachat bifne chacham ad shennaasa ragil hu hannikra mumche. vechol hammumchin shochatin lechattechilla benan leven atzman. vaafillu nashim vaavadim im hayu mumchin hare ellu shochatin lechattechilla: 
Cheresh shote vekatan veshikkor shennitbalbela dato sheshshachatu shechitatan pesula mippene sheen bahen daat shemma yekalkelu. lefichach im shachatu bifne hayyodea veraa otan sheshshachatu kahogen shechitatan keshera: 
Mi sheeno yadua etzlenu sheshshachat beno leven atzmo shoalin oto. im nimtza yodea ikkere hilchot shechita shechitato keshera: 
Hare sherainu yisreeli merachok sheshshachat vehalach lo velo yadanu im yodea im eno yodea hare zo mutteret. vechen haomer lishlucho tze ushechot li umatza habbehema shechuta veen yadua im shelucho shechatah o acher hare zo mutteret. sherov hammetzuyin etzel shechita mumchin hen: 
Avad lo gedi o tarnegol umetzao shachut babbayit muttar. sherov hammetzuyin etzel shechita mumchim hen. metzao bashshuk asur shemma nitnabbel ulefichach hushlach. vechen im metzao baashpa shebbabbayit asur: 
Mumche shennishtattek vahare hu mevin veshomea vedato nechona hare ze shochet lechattechilla. vechen mi sheeno shomea hare ze shochet: 
Hassuma lo yishchot lechattechilla ella im ken acherim roim oto veim shachat shechitato keshera: 
Akkum sheshshachat af al pi sheshshachat bifne yisrael besakkin yafa vaafillu haya katan shechitato nevela veloke al achilatah min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Shemot 34 15)</small> "vekara lecha veachalta mizzivcho". meachar shehizhir shemma yochal mizzivcho atta lamed shezzivcho asur veeno dome leyisrael sheeno yodea hilchot shechita: 
Vegader gadol gadru baddavar sheafillu akkum sheeno oved avoda zara shechitato nevela: 
Hitchil haakkum lishchot miut simanin vegamar yisrael o hitchil yisrael vegamar haakkum pesula. yeshnah lishchitato mittechilla vead sof. aval im shachat haakkum davar sheeno ose oto nevela kegon sheshshachat chatzi haggargeret bilvad vegamar yisrael hare zo keshera: 
Yisrael mumar laavera min haaverot shehaya mumche hare ze shochet lechattechilla. vetzarich yisrael kasher livdok et hassakkin veachar kach yittenenna lemumar ze lishchot bah mippene shechezkato sheeno toreach livdok. veim haya mumar laavoda zara o mechallel shabbat befarhesya o eppikoros vehu hakkofer battora uvemoshe rabbenu kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva hare hu keakkum ushechitato nevela: 
Mi shehu pasul leedut baavera min haaverot shel tora hare ze shochet beno leven atzmo im haya mumche. sheeno meniach davar muttar veochel devar issur. shezzo chazaka hi al kol yisrael vaafillu harshaim mehen: 
Ellu hatztzedokin vehabbaytosin vetalmidehen vechol hattoim acharehen sheenan maaminim battora shebbeal pe shechitatan asura. veim shachatu befanenu hare zo mutteret. sheen issur shechitatan ella shemma yekalkelu vehem enan maaminin betorat hashshechita lefichach enan neemanin lomar lo kilkalnu: 
Keshehayu yisrael bammidbar lo nitztauu bishchitat hachullin ella hayu nocharin o shochatin veochlin kishar haummot. venitztauu bammidbar shekkol harotze lishchot lo yishchot ella shelamim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 3)</small> "ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 4)</small> "veel petach ohel moed" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "lemaan asher yaviu" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 17 5)</small> "vezavchu zivche shelamim laAdonai" vegomer. aval harotze linchor veleechol bammidbar haya nocher: 
Umitzva zo enah noheget ledorot ella bammidbar bilvad beet hetter hannechira. venitztauu sham shekkesheyyikkansu laaretz teaser hannechira velo yochlu chullin ella bishchita. veyishchatu bechol makom leolam chutz laazara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 20)</small> "ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 12 21)</small> "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha asher natan Adonai elohecha" vegomer. vezo hi hammitzva hannoheget ledorot lishchot veachar kach yeachel:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 5:
Kevar bearnu behilchot issure maachalot shehatterefa haamura battora hi hannota lamut. velo neemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "terefa" ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove kegon shetterafah ari vechayyotze bo ushevarah vaadayin lo meta: 
Veyesh sham cholaim acherim im yeeru lah techashev terefa vehen halacha lemoshe missinay. ushemona mine terefot neemru lo lemoshe besinay veellu hen. derusa. nekuva. chasera. netula. pesuka. kerua. nefula. ushevura: 
Af al pi shekkullan halacha lemoshe missinay hen. hoil veen lecha beferush battora ella derusa hechmiru bah. vechol safek sheyyistappek bidrusa asur. ushear shiva mine terefot yesh bahen sefekin muttarim kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Hadderusa hu sheyyitrof haari vechayyotze bo habbehema veyidros aleha beyado. o yidros hannetz vehannesher vechayyotze bahen al haof. veen derisa bivhema gassa uvechayya gassa ella laari bilvad. uvivhema dakka min hazzeev ulemala. uvigdayim utelaim afillu chatul veshual unemiyya vechayyotze bahen yesh lahen derisa vechol shekken beofot: 
Vehannetz yesh lo derisa vaafillu beof gadol mimmennu. aval shear ofot haddorsim yesh lahen derisa beof shekkemotan. veen lahen derisa beof shehu gadol mehen: 
Veyesh lechulda derisa beofot. vechelev en lo derisa kol ikkar lo beof velo bivhema vechayya. vehannetz yesh lo derisa bigdayim utelaim vehu sheyyikkov betzipparnav levet hechalal: 
En derisa ella beyad hattoref aval beraglav en choshshin lah. veen derisa ella betzipporen aval beshen en choshshin lah ella im ken nikkav ad bet hechalal bodkin shemma nikkav echad min haevarim shennitrefet binkivatan. veen derisa ella bechavvanat hattoref. aval im nafal haddores venishtakkeu tzipparnav bannitraf en zo derisa. veen derisa ella mechayyim. aval im daras veneherag vaadayin yado badderusa velo shamat tzipparnav mimmenna ella achar moto en choshshin lah: 
Vechetzad din hadderusa. kol makom sheamarnu choshshin lah shochatin et hannitraf uvodkin kol hechalal shello mikkaf hayyarech ad hakkadkod. im nimtzet kullah shelema mikkol mine terefot velo nimtza bah roshem hadderisa hare zo mutteret. veim nimtza bah roshem hadderisa hare zo terefa vaasura min hattora: 
E ze hu roshem hadderisa. sheyyadim habbasar keneged bene meayim. veim nimmok habbasar keneged bene meayim ad shennaasa kevasar sheharofe gorro min hachabbura roin oto habbasar keillu chaser uterefa: 
Veim daras bassimanin mishsheyyaadimu terefa uderisatan bemashshehu kevan sheheedim bahen kol shehu mechamat derisa terefa: 
Sefek derusa asura ad shettibbadek kidrusa vaddait. ketzad. ari shennichnas leven shevarim venimtza tzipporen begabbo shel echad mehen choshshin shemma ari deraso. veen omrim shemma bakkotel nitchakkech. vechen shual o nemiyya shennichnas leven haofot vehu shotek vehen mekarkerin choshshin shemma daras. aval im haya hu nohem vehem mekarkerin miyyirato uminnehimato hen mekarkerin. vechen im kata rosh echad mehen hinne nach ragzo. vechen im shatak hu vehem en choshshin sheillu hizzik hayu mekarkerin: 
Safek shennichnas lechan toref o lo nichnas. o sherainu velo noda im ze min hattorfin o eno min hattorfin en choshshin. vechen of shennichnas leven haetzim o leven hakkanim veyatza verosho menattef dam o tzavvaro en choshshin lo shemma nitraf ella omrim shemma baetzim nizzak:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 6: Nekuva ketzad. achad asar evarim hen sheim nikkav echad mehen lachalalo bemashshehu terefa. veellu hen. tarbatz havveshet. ukerum shel moach harosh. vehallev im hakkane shello. vehammara. ukene hakkaved. vehakkeva. vehakkeres. vehemses. uvet hakkosot. vehaddakkin. veharea im hakkane shellah:
Tarbatz havveshet kevar bearnu shiuro veshehu hammakom min havveshet sheeno rauy lishchita lemala min havveshet. im nikkav lachalalo bema shehu terefa:

Shene kerumot yesh lammoach shebbarosh. im nikkav haelyon hassamuch laetzem bilvad hare zo mutteret. veim nikkav hattachton hassamuch lammoach terefa. umishsheyyatchil hammoach lehimmashech lashshidra vehu michutz lappolin shehen techillat haoref yihye likrumo din acher. veim nikkav chutz lappolin muttar:
Hammoach atzmo shennikkav o nitmaech vehakkerum kayyam keshera. veim nishpach kammayim o names kaddonag terefa:

Hallev shennikkav levet chalalo. ben lechalal gadol shebbismol ben lechalal katan shebbeyamin terefa. aval im nikkav besar hallev velo higgia lachalalo muttar. ukene hallev vehu hammizrak haggadol sheyyotze mimmennu larea hare hu kallev veim nikkav lachalalo bemashshehu terefa:
Mara shennikkeva vechaved sotmah mutteret. veim lo nistam hannekev af al pi shehu samuch lakkaved terefa:

Neziyya shennimtzet bammara im hayta kemo garinah shel temara sheen roshah chad mutteret. veim roshah chad kegarinat hazzayit asura. shehare nikkeva otah keshennichnesa. veze shello yerae hannekev mippene shehuglad pi hammakka:

Bene meayim sheyyatzu lachutz velo nikkevu mutteret. veim nithappechu af al pi shello nikkevu terefa. shei efshar sheyyachzeru kemot shehayu achar shennehefchu veenah chayya:

Haof en lo keres velo hemses velo bet hakkosot. aval yesh lo kenegdan zefek vekurkevan. vechol hatterefot shavot hen bivhema chayya vaof. vezefek shennikkav gaggo bemashshehu terefa. vee zehu gaggo shel zefek ze sheyyimmatach im havveshet kesheyyaarich haof tzavvaro. aval shear hazzefek shennikkav muttar:
Shene kisin yesh bakkurkevan. hachitzon adom kemo basar. vehappenimi lavan kemo or. nikkav ze belo ze mutteret ad sheyyinnakvu shenehen bemashshehu. veim nikkevu shenehen ze shello keneged ze muttar:

Haom shel rea shennimtzet semucha laddofen. ben sheheelat tzemachim ben shello heelat choshshin lah shemma nikkeva. vechetzad osin bah. mefarkin otah min haddofen venizharin bah shello tinnakev. im nimtzet nekuva venimtza baddofen makka bimkom hannekev tolin bammakka veomrim achar shechita nikkeva keshennifrak min hammakka. veim en makka baddofen beyadua shennekev ze barea haya kodem hashshechita uterefa:
