Rea shettishshama bah havara keshennofchin otah im nikkar hammakom shemmimmennu tishshama hahavara moshivin alav rok o teven vechayyotze bo. im nitnadned beyadua shehi nekuva uterefa. veim lo nikkar hammakom moshivin otah bemayim poshrin venofchin otah. im bikbek hammayim terefa. veim lav beyadua shekkerum hattachton bilvad nikkav veharuach tenaheg ben shene hakkerumot umippene ze yishshama bah kol demama bishat neficha: 
Ze ikkar gadol yihye beyadcha shekkol rea shennofchin otah befoshrin velo yevakbek hammayim hare hi shelema mikkol nekev: 
Rea shennishpecha kekiton ukerum haelyon shellah kayyam shalem belo nekev. im hassimponot omdim bimkomam velo nimmochu keshera. veim nimmoach afillu simpon echad terefa. ketzad osin. nokvin otah veshofchin otah bichli shehu shoa baavar vechayyotze bo. im nire bah chutin levanin beyadua shennimmokku hassimponot uterefa. veim lav besar harea bilvad hu shennimmok ucheshera: 
Rea shennimtzeu bah avabuot im hayu meleim ruach o mayim zakkim o lecha hannimshechet kidvash vechayyotze bo o lecha yevesha vekasha afillu keeven hare zo mutteret. veim nimtzet bahen lecha serucha o mayim seruchin o achurin hare zo terefa. ucheshemmotzi hallecha uvodek otah tzarich livdok hassimpon shettachteha. im nimtza nakuv terefa: 
Rea shennimtzeu bah shete avabuot semuchot zo lazo terefa. shehaddavar karov harebe sheyyesh nekev benehen veen lahen derech bedika. hayta achat venire kishtayim nokvin haachat. im shafcha lah haacheret achat hi umutteret veim lav terefa: 
Harea shennitmasmesa terefa. ketzad. kegon shennimtzet shelema ucheshettolin otah techatech vetippol chatichot chatichot. rea shennimtzet nekuva bemakom sheyyad hattabbach memashmesh mutteret vetolin beyado veomrin miyyad hattabbach nikkeva achar hashshechita. nimtza hannekev bemakom acher veen yadua im kodem shechita o achar shechita nokvin bah nekev acher umedammin keshem sheosim bivne meayim: 
Veen medammin merea shel behema dakka lerea shel behema gassa ella middakka ledakka umiggassa legassa. nimtza hannekev beechad min haavabuot hare zo terefa veen omrin nikkov avabua acher venaaroch sheen haddavar nikkar: 
Machat shennimtzet barea nofchin otah. im lo yatza mimmenna ruach beyadua shezzot hammachat derech simponot nichnesa velo nikkeva. veim nitchattecha harea kodem neficha venimtzet bah hammachat hare zo asura shehaddavar karov shennikkeva keshennichnesa: 
Tolaat shehayta barea venikkeva veyatza vahare harea nekuva betolaat hare zo mutteret. chezkatah sheachar shechita tikkov vetetze. yesh sham marot sheim nishtanna mare haevar leoto hammare hara hare hu kenakuv sheoto habbasar shennishtannu marav lemare ze kemet hu chashuv ucheillu hu habbasar shennehefach eno eno matzuy. vechen hu omer <small>(Vayikra 13 10)</small> "umichyat basar chay baset" <small>(Vayikra 13 14)</small> "uveyom heraot bo basar chay" mikkelal sheshshear habbasar shennishtanna eno chay: 
Rea shennishtannu mareha. ben mare kulla ben mare miktzatah. im nishtannet lemare hammuttar afillu nishtannet kullah mutteret. veim nishtanna lemare haasur afillu kol shehu terefa. shehammare haasur kenekev hu chashuv kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechamesh marot asurot yesh barea veellu hen. shechora kidyo. o yerukka keen keshut. o keen chelmon betza. o keen charia. o kemare habbasar. vacharia hu hatztzeva shetztzovim bo habbegadim vehu dome lisarot adummot meat venotot lirukka: 
Nimtzet keen charayot shel dekel osrin otah missafek shezze karov lemare haasur. vechol hammarot haellu en osrin bahem ad shennofchim otah umemares bah beyado. im nishtannet lammare hammuttar mutteret. veim amda beenah asura: 
Arba marot muttarot yesh bah veellu hen. shechora kichchol. o yerukka kechatzir. o adumma. o kemare hakkaved. vaafillu hayta harea kullah telaim telaim nekuddot nekuddot mearba marot ellu hare zo mutteret: 
Of shennafal laur vehorik libbo o kevedo o kurkevano o shehedimu hammeayim shello bechol shehu hare zo terefa. shekkol hayerukkim shehedimu o haadummim shehoriku mechamat haur baof hare hen kemi shennittelu uterefa. vehu sheyyaamdu bemare ze achar sheshshalku otan meat umemarsin bahen: 
Kol of shennimtzet hakkaved shello kemare bene meayim. o shennishtannu shear bene meayim veamdu beshinnuyan achar shelika umerisa kemo shebbearnu. beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav uterefa. velo od ella bene meayim shel of shello nimtza bahem shinnuy ucheshennishleku nishtannu vehedimu hayerukkim vehoriku haadummim. beyadua shennafal laur venechmeru bene meav uterefa. vechen havveshet shennimtza haor hachitzon shello lavan vehappenimi adom ben baof ben babbehema hare hu keillu eno uterefa:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 8: Chasera ketzad. shene evarim hen sheim chaser mimminyanam terefa. veellu hen. harea veharaglayim. vechamesh unnot yesh larea kesheyyitle otah adam beyado ufene rea keneged panav. shalosh min hayyamin. ushetayim min hassemol. uvetzad yamin mimmenna kemo ozen ketanna veenah betzad haunnot veyesh lah kemo kis bifne atzmah vehi betoch hakkis. veozen zo ketanna hi hannikra varda mippene shehi doma levered veenah min hamminyan. lefichach im lo nimtzet havvarda mutteret. shekkach hi darkah yesh behemot timmatze bahem veyesh behemot lo timmatze bahem. veim nimtzet nekuva af al pi shehakkis shellah sotem et hannekev hare zo terefa:
Chaser minyan haunnot venimtzet achat min hassemol o shetayim min hayyamin terefa. veim nimtzeu shetayim beyamin vezot havvarda hare zo mutteret:
Nitchallefu haunnot venimtzeu shalosh min semol ushetayim min hayyamin belo vered. o shehaya havvered im hashshalosh betzad semol. hare zo terefa shehi chasera mitztzad hayyamin:

Nitvassefu haunnot beminyanam im hayta haozen hayetera betzad haunnot o millifne harea shehu leummat hallev mutteret. veim hayta al gabbah shehu leummat hatztzelaot hare zo terefa shehayyater kechaser. vehu shettihye kemo ale shel hadas. aval pachot mizze enah ozen umutteret:
Ozen shennimtzet devuka bachavertah hassemucha lah mutteret. veim nismechu shello al hasseder kegon shennismecha rishona lashshelishit terefa:

Nimtzeu shete haunnot keunna achat veenan nirot kishtayim devukot im haya benehen kemo ale hahadas ben beikkaran ben beemtzaan ben besofan kede sheyyukkar shehen shetayim devukot mutteret veim lav hare zo chasera uterefa:

Nimtzet kullah shete arugot veen lah chittuch aznayim terefa. vechen im chaser guf harea af al pi shello nikkeva hare zo kemi shechaser minyan haunnot uterefa. lefichach im nimtza mimmenna makom yavesh ad sheyyipparech betzipporen hare zo kechaser uterefa vaafillu haya kol shehu:
Rea shennimtzet nefucha kemo ikkar charayot shel dekel osrin otah missafek. shezzo tosefet meshunna begufah veshemma hattosefet bagguf kechissaron kemo sheamar beminyan:

Habbehema sheppachada veyara ad shetztzamka harea shellah vekarva lihyot yevesha. im pachada bide shamayim kegon sheshshama kol raam o raata zikkim vechayyotze baze mutteret. veim pachada bide adam kegon sheshshachatu lefaneha behema acheret vechayyotze baze hare zo kachasera uterefa:

Ketzad bodkin otah. moshivin et harea bemayim meet leet. veim haya zeman hakkor moshivin otah bemayim poshrin uvichli sheen hammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo venozlim kede shello yitztzonnu bimhera. veim haya zeman hachom moshivin otah bemayim tzonen bichli shehammayim mitmatztzin miggabbo kede sheyyishshaaru karim. im chazra livriyyatah hare zo bide shamayim umutteret. veim lo chazra bide adam hi uterefa:

Behema shehayta chasera regel bitchillat beriyyatah terefa. vechen im hayta yetera regel. shekkol hayyater kechaser hu. aval im hayu lah shalosh yadayim o yad achat mutteret. lefichach im nechtach hayyad shellah mutteret. nechtach haregel min haarkubba ulemala terefa. min haarkubba ulematta mutteret. bee zo arkubba amru bearkubba shehu sof hayyarech hassamuch lagguf:

Nishbar haetzem lemala min haarkubba im yatza kullo o rubbo lachutz hare ze kema shennechtach venafal uterefa. veim haya habbasar o haor chofe rov avyo verov hekkefo shel etzem shennishbar hare zo mutteret vaafillu nafal miktzat haetzem shennishbar vehalach lo. vegidim harakkim enan chashuvin kevasar:

Tzomet haggidin hen bivhema uvechayya lemala min heakev bemakom shettolin bo hattabbachim habbehema. vehen shelosha gidin levanim. echad ave ushenayim dakkim. umimmakom sheyyatchil vehen kashim ulevanim ad sheyyasur halloven mehen veyatchilu lehitaddem ulehitrakkech hu tzomet haggidim. vehu keorech shesh esre etzbaot beshor:
Uminyan gidim ellu baof shishsha asar gidin. techillatan min haetzem shel matta meetzba yetera ad sof haregel shehu asuy kaskassim kaskassim:

Behema shennechtechu ragleha bimkom tzomet haggidin terefa. veal titma vetomar ketzad tachtoch lemala mitztzomet haggidim vehi mutteret ad shettachtoch lemala min haarkubba haelyona kemo shebbearnu veim nechtach lematta mitztzomet haggidim asura. shebbitrefot tachtoch mikkan vetichye umikkan vetamut. velo neesra behema zo mippene shehi chatuchat regel mimmakom ze ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin shechatichatan mikkelal hatterefot kemo sheyyitbaer:
Netula ketzad. shelosha evarim hen sheim nittelu terefa veaf al pi sheen bahen din nekev velo din chesron. veellu hen. tzomet haggidim. vehakkaved. ulechi haelyon:

Uchevar bearnu shehabbehema shennechtach raglah vechen haof bimkom tzomet haggidim lo naasu terefa ella mippene shennechtechu haggidin. lefichach im nechtechu haggidim levaddam veharegel kayyemet terefa shehare nittela tzomet haggidim:

Nechtach bivhema haechad heave levaddo mutteret. shehare nisharu shenayim. nechtechu hashshenayim haddakkin mutteret shehare haechad heave gedol shenehen vahare lo nittal kol hatztzomet ella miutah. nechtach rubbo shel kol echad mehen terefa. veen tzarich lomar shennechtechu kullan o nittelu kullan:
Uvaof afillu nechtach rubbo shel (kol) echad min hashshishsha asar terefa:
Veof shennishtabberu agappav muttar kivhema shennechtechu yadeha:

Kaved shennittela kullah terefa. veim nishtayyer mimmenna kezayit bemakom shehi teluya bo uchezayit bimkom mara hare zo mutteret. niddaldela hakkaved vahare hi meora battarpash shellah mutteret. nittal mimmenna makom shehi teluya bo umekom hammara veaf al pi shehashshear kayyam kemo shehu terefa:
Nishar bah kezayit bimkom mara uchezayit bemakom shehi teluya bo keshera. aval haya mefuzzar meat bechan umeat bechan o shehaya meruddad o shehaya aroch kirtzua hare zo safek veyerae li shehi asura:
Lechi haelyon shennittal terefa. aval im nittal hattachton kegon shennigmam ad mekom hassimanin velo neekru hare zo mutteret:

Kol evar shenneemar bo sheim haya chaser terefa kach im nittal terefa. aval evar shenneemar bo im nittal terefa enah neeseret ella im nechtach oto evar. aval im nivret chasera oto evar hare zo mutteret. sheim lo tomar ken nimtzet hachasera vehannetula achat. vechol evar shenneemar bo sheim nittal mutteret kal vachomer im chaser mittechillat beriyyatah velo nivra shehi mutteret:
Behema shennittela haem shellah vehu bet harechem o shennittelu hakkelayot hare zo mutteret. lefichach im nivret bechuleya achat o beshalosh kelayot mutteret. vechen im nikkeva hakkuleya mutteret:

Af al pi shehakkuleya shennittela o chasera mutteret im nimtzet ketanna beyoter. vehakketanna bedaka ad kefol uvegassa ad keenav. terefa. vechen im lakta hakkuleya vehu sheyyease besarah kivsar hammet shehivish achar yamim sheim teechoz bemiktzato yitmasmes veyippol vehiggia choli ze ad hallavan shebbetoch hakkuleya hare zo terefa. vechen im nimtzet bakkuleya lecha af al pi sheenah serucha o shennimtza bah mayim achurin o seruchim hare zo terefa. aval im nimtzeu bah mayim zakkim hare zo mutteret:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 9:
Pesuka ketzad. chut hashshidra shennifsak haor hachofe et hammoach terefa. uvilvad sheyyippasek rov hekkefo. aval im nisdak haor learko o nikkav mutteret. vechen im nishbera hashshidra velo nifsak hachut shellah o shennitmaech hammoach shebbetoch hachut venitnadned hoil veoro kayyam hare zo mutteret: 
Humrach hammoach venishpach kammayim o kedonag shennames ad sheyyimmatze hachut keshemmaamido eno omed hare zo terefa. veim eno yachol laamod mippene kavdo hare zo safek: 
Ad hechan chut hashshidra. techillato mibbachutz lappolin shebbitchillat haoref ad sof parasha sheniyya shello yishshaer achareha ella parasha shelishit hassemucha litchillat haalya: 
Veshalosh parashiyyot hen veellu hen. shelosha atzamot devukin ze baze lematta mechulyot shel shidra. vechut hashshidra baof ad ben agappayim. aval lematta mimmekomot ellu en mashgichin al hachut hannimshach lesham ben shennifsak oro ben shennimrach hammoach: 
Kerua ketzad. basar hachofe et rov hakkeres vehu hammakom min habbeten sheim yikkara yetze hakkeres im nikra basar ze terefa. af al pi shello higgia hakkera lakkeres ad shenniret. ella kevan shennikra rov ovi habbasar hazze o nittal terefa. vechamma shiur hakkera bearko orech tefach. veim hayta behema ketanna venikra rov orech habbasar hachofe et hakkeres af al pi sheen beorech hakkera tefach terefa hoil venikra rubbah: 
Nikdar habbasar hazze beiggul o beorech im haya yater mikkesela vehu kede sheyyikkanes bo shalosh garine temara zo betzad zo bedochak hare zo terefa. sheim yimmatach kera ze yaamod al tefach: 
Behema shennifshat haor shealeha kullo ben shennikra bayyad o becholi venimtza basar belo or hare zo terefa. vezo hi shennikret geluda. veim nishar min haor rochav sela al pene kol hashshidra verochav sela al hattabbur verochav sela al rashe evareha hare zo mutteret. veim nittal kerochav sela meal kol pene hashshidra o meal hattabbur o meal rashe evareha ushear kol haor kayyam hare zo safek. veyerae li shemmattirin otah: 
Nefula ketzad. hare shennafla habbehema mimmakom gavoah sheggavho asara tefachim o yeter venitrassek evar meevareha hare zo terefa. vechetzad hu harissuk. sheyyitrotzetz haevar veyechele mechamat hannefila ad shettippased tzurato vetooro. af al pi shello nikkav velo nisdak velo nishbar hare zo terefa. vechen im hikka otah beeven o bematte veritztzetz evar meevareha terefa. bee ze evarim amru beevarim shebbachalal hagguf: 
Behema shennafla min haggag im halcha en choshshin lah. veim amda velo halcha choshshin lah. kaftza mechamat atzmah en choshshin lah. hinnichah lemala umetzaah lematta en choshshin lah shemma nafla: 
Zecharim hamenaggechin ze et ze en choshshin lahen. naflu laaretz choshshin lahen. vechen behema shehayta megareret ragleha en choshshin lah shemma nitrasseku evareha o shemma nifsak hachut shel shidra: 
Gannavim sheggonvin hattelaim umashlichin otan laachore haddir en choshshin lahen mishshum rissuk evarim. mippene sheen mashlichin otan ella bechavvana shello yishtabberu. veim hechezirum vehishlichum laddir mechamat yira choshshin lahen. mechamat teshuva en choshshin lahen. mippene shemmitkavven lehachaziram shelemim veyizzaharu behashelachatan: 
Shor shehirbitzuhu lishchita af al pi shennafal nefila gedola sheyyesh lah kol beet shemmappilin oto en choshshin lo mippene shennoetz tzipparnav umitchazzek ad shemmaggia laaretz: 
Hikka habbehema al roshah vehalcha lah hammakka kelappe zenavah o al zenavah vehalcha lah kelappe roshah vaafillu hikka otah bammatte al kol hashshidra en choshshin lah. veim yesh bammatte chulyot chulyot choshshin lah. veim higgia rosh hammatte lemiktzat hashshidra choshshin lah. vechen im hikka lerochav hashshidra choshshin lah: 
Of shennechbat al davar kashe kegon keri shel chittim o kuppa shel shekedim vechayyotze bahen choshshin lerissuk evarim. veim nechbat al davar rach kegon kesut kefula vehatteven vehaefer vechayyotze bahen en choshshin lo: 
Nidbeku kenafav bedevek bishat tzida venitchabbet. im bechanaf achat neechaz en choshshin lo. veim neechaz bishte kenafav venitchabbet begufo choshshin lo: 
Nechbat al pene hammayim im shat melo komato mimmatta lemala leemmat hammayim en choshshin lo. aval im shat mimmala lematta im hilluch hammayim choshshin lo shemma hammayim hem hammolichin oto. veim kadam leteven o kash shemmehallechin al gabbe hammayim hare zo shat mechamat atzmo veen choshshin lo: 
Kol makom sheamarnu en choshshin lah muttar lishchot miyyad. veeno tzarich livdok shemma nitrassek evar. vechol makom sheamarnu choshshin lah im shechatah tzarich livdok keneged kol hechalal kullo mikkadkod harosh ad hayyarech. im matza bah terefa min hatterefot shemmaninu o shennitrassek evar min haevarim shebbifnim venifseda tzurato hare zo terefa. afillu nitrassek evar min haevarim sheim nittelu keshera kegon techol uchelayot hare zo terefa chutz mibbet harechem sheim nitrassek hare zo mutteret: 
Vehassimanin enan tzerichin bedika bechan sheen hannefila memaechet otan: 
Nafla min haggag velo amda asur lishchot otah ad shettishhe meet leet. veim shachat betoch zeman ze hare zo terefa. uchesheshshochet otah achar meet leet tzericha bedika kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechen mi sheddaras beraglo al haof o shedderasattu behema o shetterafo lakkotel vahare hu mefarkes mashhin oto meet leet veachar kach shochatin oto uvodkin oto kederech shebbearnu: 
Simanim shenniddaldelu rubban terefa vaafillu shello mechamat nefila. vechen im nitkappelu shehare enan reuyin lishchita. aval im nitparek rov tarbatz havveshet min hallechi hare zo mutteret sheen hattarbatz rauy lishchita kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 10: Shevura ketzad hu shennishtabberu rov tzaloteha. vetzalot habbehema hen achat esre mikkan veachat esre mikkan. nishtabberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan o achat esre mikkan veachat mikkan terefa. vehu shennishberu mechetzyan shel mul hashshidra:

Nishberu shesh mikkan veshesh mikkan im hayu tzelaot gedolot sheyyesh bahen moach terefa. veim lav af al pi shehen rov veaf al pi shennishberu kelappe hashshidra mutteret. vechen im neekru rov tzaloteha terefa. veim neekra afillu tzela achat vachatzi chulyatah immah shehatztzela tekua bah hare zo terefa. vechen im neekra min hashshidra chulya achat afillu hayta min hachulyot shellematta min hakkesalim sheen bahen tzelaot hare zo terefa:

Behema shennishmat hayyarech shellah meikkaro veyatza min hakkaf shello im nitakkelu nivav vehen hayetedot shebbeetzem hakkaf sheyyotzet al haetzem hazzachar veochezet oto hare zo terefa. veim lo nitakkelu mutteret:

Vechen baof im nishmat yerecho terefa. nishmat kenafo meikkaro choshshin shemma nikkeva harea shello ulefichach bodkin otah veachar kach yeachel. uvehema shennishmeta yadah meikkarah mutteret veen choshshin lah:
Gulgolet behema o chayya shennittal mimmenna kesela af al pi shello nikkav hakkerum terefa. veim nikkevu nekavim sheyyesh bahen chesron kullan mitztarfin lichsela:

Vechen gulgolet shennechbas rov gavhah verov hekkefah terefa. af al pi shehakkerum shalem velo chaser mimmenna kelum. nechbas rov gavhah vahare rov hekkefah kayyam o shennechbas rov hekkefah vahare rov gavhah kayyam hare zo sefek terefa. veyerae li sheosrin otah:

Of shel mayim kegon avazim im nikkav etzem gulgalto af al pi shello nikkav kerum shel moach terefa mippene shekkerumo rach. of hayyabbasha shehikkattu chulda al rosho o shenniggaf beeven o beetz manniach yado betzad hannekev venoetz o machnis yado letoch piv vedochek lemala. im yatza hammoach min hannekev beyadua shennikkav hakkerum uterefa. veim lav muttar:

Behema sheachazah dam o shehayta meushshenet o metzunnenet o sheachla sam shehoreg habbehema o shatta mayim haraim hare zo mutteret. achla sam shehoreg et haadam o shenneshachah nachash vechayyotze bo mutteret mishshum terefa vaasura mippene sakkanat nefashot:

60) nikra rov habbasar hachofe et hakkeres. 61) niglad haor shealeha. sav) nitrasseku evareha minnefila. 63) niddaldelu hassimanin. sad) nishtabberu rov tzaloteha. 65) neekru rov tzaloteha. 66) neekra tzela achat bechulyatah. 67) neekra chulya achat. sach) nishmat hayyarech meikkaro. 69) chasera haggulgolet kesela. 70) nechbas rov haggulgolet venitrotzetz:

Ellu hashshivim cholayim sheosrin et habbehema veet hachayya mishshum terefa kevar nitbaer kol echad mehen umishpatav. vechol sheefshar mehen sheyyimmatze baof baevarin hammetzuyin laof velabbehema dino bivhema uveof echad hu. chutz mitterefot shebbechuleya veshebbattechol veshebbeunnot harea. mippene shehaof en lo chittuch unnot kivhema. veim yimmatze en lo minyan yadua. utechol haof agol kemo enav veeno kitchol behema. uterefot shebbakkuleya veshebbattechol lo manu otan bivhema kede sheyyihye kenegdan baof ulefichach lo natnu lechuleya shehiktina shiur baof. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Ushete terefot yesh baof yeter al habbehema veaf al pi sheyyesh lah otan haevarim. veellu hen. of shennishtannu mare bene meav mechamat haur. veof hammayim shennikkav etzem rosho:

Veen lehosif al terefot ellu kelal. shekkol sheera livhema o lechayya o leof chutz meellu shemmanu chachme dorot harishonim vehiskimu alehen bevatte dine yisrael efshar shettichye. vaafillu noda lanu midderech harfua sheen sofah lichyot:

Vechen ellu shemmanu veamru shehen terefa af al pi sheyyerae bedarche harfua shebbeyadenu shemmiktzatan enan memitin veefshar shettichye mehen en lecha ella ma shemmanu chachamim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha":

Kol tabbach shehu yodea hatterefot haellu vahare hu bechezkat kashrut muttar lo lishchot velivdok leatzmo velimkor veen baze chashash. sheed echad neeman beissurin ben yesh lo hanaya beeduto ben en lo hanaya beeduto. uchevar bearnu sheen lokchin basar mittabbach sheshshochet uvodek leatzmo bechutza laaretz o beeretz yisrael bazzeman hazze. ella im ken haya mumche. veim yatzat terefa mittachat yado menaddin oto umaavirin oto veeno chozer lechashruto ad sheyyelech lemakom sheen makkirim oto veyachazir aveda bedavar chashuv o yotzi terefa leatzmo bedavar chashuv:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 11:
Kol behema o of shennolod bahen sefek terefot mitterefot ellu. kegon behema shennafla velo halcha. o shennidresa bide chayya veen yadua im heedim basar keneged bene meayim o lo heedim. o shennechbesa gulgaltah veen yadua im rubbah o miutah vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. im haya zachar veshaha shenem asar chodesh hare zo bechezkat shelema kishar kol habbehemot. veim hayta nekeva ad shetteled. uveof bezachar shenem asar chodesh. uvinkeva ad shetteled kol habbetzim shel teina harishona vetiton teina sheniyya veteled: 
Veasur limkor sefek terefa zo lenachri betoch zeman ze shemma yimkerenna leyisrael: 
Kol behema chayya veof bechezkat beriim hem veen choshshin lahem shemma yesh bahen terefa. lefichach kesheyyishachatu shechita keshera enan tzerichin bedika shemma yesh bahen achat min hatterefot. ella hare hen bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivvaled lahen davar shechoshshin lo veachar kach bodkin al oto davar bilvad: 
Ketzad. kegon shennishmat haggaf shel of bodkin et harea shemma nikkeva. nafla habbehema bodkin otah shemma nitrasseku evareha. nitratztzetz etzem harosh bodkin kerum shel moach shemma nikkav. hikka otah kotz o nizrak bah chetz o romach vechayyotze bahen venichnas lachalalah choshshin lah utzericha bedika keneged kol hechalal shemma nikkav echad min haevarin shettittaref binkivatan. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lefichach rea sheheelta tzemachin o shennimtzeu sirchot kemo chutin teluyin mimmenna veladdofen o lallev o letarpash hakkaved choshshin lah shemma nikkeva utzericha bedika. vechen im nimtza bah avabua male lecha choshshin shemma nikkav simpon shettachtav utzericha bedika: 
Min haddin haya al derech zo sheim nimtzet harea teluya besirchot kemo chutin. im hayu min haom shel rea veladdofen o shehayu lallev o letarpash hakkaved shechotchim et hassircha umotziin et harea venofchin otah befoshrin. im nimtzet nekuva terefa. veim lo nitbabea hammayim hare hi shelema mikkol nekev umutteret vesircha zo lo hayta bimkom nekev o shemma nikkav kerum haelyon bilvad. umeolam lo rainu mi shehora kach velo shamanu makom sheosin bo kach: 
Veaf al pi sheellu hen haddevarim hannirin middivre chachme haggemara. hamminhag happashut beyisrael kach hu. kesheshshochatin et habbehema o et hachayya korin et hattarpash shel kaved uvodkin et harea bimkomah. im lo nimtzea teluya besircha. o shennimtzea sircha ben ozen meazne harea velabbasar shebbimkom revitzatah ben basar shebben hatztzelaot ben basar shebbechaze. o shennimtzea sircha meozen leozen al hasseder o min haom laozen hassemucha lah. hare ellu mattirin otah: 
Veim nimtza chut yotze min haom shel rea leeze makom sheyyimmashech vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah: 
Vechen im haya min harea chut mashuch lallev o letarpash hakkaved o lechis hallev o lavvarda. ben shehaya hachut min haom shel rea ben shehaya min haozen vaafillu haya kechut hassaara osrin otah. vechen varda shennimtzet devuka bechisah o chut yotze mimmenna lechisah osrin otah. vechut hayyotze meozen leozen shello al hasseder osrin otah: 
Yesh mekomot shemminhagan im matzu sircha min haozen labbasar velaetzem shebbatztzelaot vehassircha devuka bishtehen osrin otah. veabba mari min haosrin vaani min hammattirin. umiut mekomot mattirin afillu nidbeka baetzem levaddo vaani oser: 
Veyesh mekomot shennofchin harea shemma yesh bah nekev. verov hammekomot en nofchin shehare lo nolad davar sheggorem lachashash. umeolam lo nafachnu rea bisfarad uvammaarav ella im nolad lanu davar shechoshshim lo: 
Udevarim haellu kullan enan al pi haddin ella al pi hamminhag kemo shebbearnu. umeolam lo shamanu bemi shebbadak of ella im nolad lo chashash: 
Mi sheshshachat et habbehema vekara et habbeten. vekodem sheyyivdok et harea ba kelev o akkum venatal et harea vehalach lo. hare zo mutteret. veen omrim shemma nekuva hayta o shemma devuka hayta. sheen machazikin issur. ella hare zo bechezkat hetter ad sheyyivvada bamme nitrefa. ucheshem sheen choshshin likrum moach velashshidra vechayyotze bahen kach lo nachush larea sheavda. veen baze minhag sheddavar sheeno matzuy en bo minhag: 
Ba haakkum o hayyisrael vehotzi harea kodem shettibbadek vahare hi kayyemet nofchin otah veaf al pi sheen anu yodin im hayu sham tzemachin o lo hayu. mippene pishshut hamminhag: 
Yesh mekomot sheim nimtzeu sirchot meduldalot min harea af al pi sheenan devukot lo laddofen velo lemakom acher osrin otah. vedavar ze hefsed gadol hu veibbud mamon leyisrael. umeolam lo nahagu ze lo betzarfat velo bisfarad velo nishma ze bammaarav. veen rauy linhog beminhag ze. ella nofchin otah bilvad. im nimtzet shelema min hannekev hare zo mutteret:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 12: Hashochet oto veet beno beyom echad habbasar muttar baachila vehashshochet loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "oto veet beno lo tishchatu beyom echad". veeno loke ella al shechitat haacharon. lefichach im shachat echad mishshenehen uva chavero veshachat et hashsheni chavero loke:

Issur oto veet beno noheg bechol zeman uvechol makom. bechullin uvemukdashin. ben kadashim hanneechalin ben kadashim sheenan neechalin. lefichach harishon sheshshachat baazara vehashsheni bachutz. o harishon bachutz vehashsheni baazara. ben shehayu shenehen chullin o shenehen kadashim. ben shehaya echad mehen chullin veechad kadashim. ze sheshshachat acharon loke mishshum oto veet beno:

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bishchita bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "lo tishchatu" bishchitat shenehen hu haissur. aval im nachar harishon o nitnabbel beyado muttar lishchot. vechen im shachat harishon venichar hashsheni o nitnabbel beyado patur:
Cheresh shote vekatan sheshshachatu benam leven atzman et harishon muttar lishchot sheni acharehem. lefi sheen shechitatan shechita (kelal):
Hashshochet et harishon vahare hu sefek nevela asur lishchot hashsheni. veim shechato eno loke:

Shechita sheenah reuya laachila shemah shechita. lefichach harishon sheshshachat chullin baazara o terefa o shor hanniskal veegla arufa ufara adumma o sheshshachat leakkum uva haacharon veshachat et hashsheni loke. vechen im shachat harishon et haechad uva haacharon veshachat et hashsheni vahare hu chullin baazara o shor hanniskal o egla arufa ufara adumma hare ze loke:
Shechato leakkum patur mishshum oto veet beno shehare nitchayyev benafsho. veim hitru bo mishshum oto veet beno velo hitru bo mishshum akkum loke:

En issur oto veet beno noheg ella bivhema tehora bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 28)</small> "veshor o se oto veet beno lo tishchatu beyom echad". venoheg bechilayim. ketzad. tzevi shebba al haez veshachat haez veet benah loke. aval haez shebba al hatztzivya asur lishchot otah veet benah. veim shachat eno loke. para uvenah asra tora lo tzivya uvenah:

Hayta bat hatztzivya hazzot nekeva veyalda ben veshachat et hannekeva bat hatztzivya veet benah loke. vechen kilayim habba mimmin keves umimmin ez ben mikkeves im haez ben meez im hakkivsa loke mishshum oto veet beno:
Muttar lishchot et hameubberet. ubbar yerech immo hu. veim yatza haubbar chay achar shechita vehifris al gabbe karka en shochatin oto beyom echad. veim shachat eno loke:
Issur oto veet beno noheg binkevot shezze benah vadday. veim noda vadday shezze hu aviv en shochatin shenehen beyom echad. veim shachat eno loke. shehaddavar safek im noheg bizcharim o eno noheg:

Hashshochet et happara veachar kach shachat shene baneha loke shete malkiyyot. shachat et baneha veachar kach shachat hi loke achat. shechatah veet bittah veet ben bittah loke shetayim. shechatah veet ben bittah veachar kach shachat et habbat loke achat ben hu ben acher:
Shenayim shellakchu shete behemot ze haem veze habbat uvau ledin. ze shellakach rishon yishchot rishon vehashsheni yamtin lemachar. veim kadam hashsheni veshachat zacha veyamtin harishon ad lemachar:

Bearbaa perakim beshana hammocher behema lachavero tzarich lehodio velomar lo kevar macharti immah o bittah leacher lishchot kede sheyyamtin ze haacharon velo yishchot ad lemachar. veellu hen. erev yom tov haacharon shel chag. veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach. veerev atzeret. veerev rosh hashshana:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheraa ze shellakach baacharona nechpaz liknot vehaya besof hayyom shechezkato shehu shochet atta. aval im haya revach bayyom eno tzarich lehodio shemma lo yishchot ella lemachar:
Vehammocher et haem lechatan vehabbat lakkalla tzarich lehodian. shevvadday beyom echad shochatin. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Yom echad haamur beoto veet beno hayyom holech achar hallayla. ketzad. hare sheshshachat rishon bitchillat lel revii lo yishchot hashsheni ad techillat lel chamishi. vechen im shachat harishon besof yom revii kodem ben hashshemashot shochet hashsheni bitchillat lel chamishi. shachat rishon ben hashshemashot shel lel chamishi lo yishchot hashsheni ad lel shishshi. veim shachat beyom chamishi eno loke:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 13:
Halokeach em al habbanim ushichatah. habbasar muttar baachila veloke al shechitat haem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "lo tikkach haem al habbanim". vechen im meta kodem sheyyeshallechenna loke. veim shillechah achar shellekachah patur: 
Vechen kol mitzvat lo taase shennitteka laase chayyav lekayyem ase shebbah. veim lo kiyyemo loke: 
Ba echad vechataf haem miyyado veshillechah o shebbarcha mittachat yado shello middato loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach" ad sheyyeshalleach meatzmo vahare lo kiyyem ase shebbah: 
Natal em al habbanim vekitztzetz agappeha kede shello tauf veshillechah makkin oto makkat mardut. umashhe otah etzlo ad sheyyigdelu kenafeha umeshallechah. veim meta kodem laze o barcha veavda loke shehare lo kiyyem ase shebbah: 
Vechetzad meshalleach haem. ochez bichnafeha umafrichah. shillechah vechazra veshillechah vechazra afillu arba vechamesh peamim chayyav leshalleach shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach": 
Haomer hareni notel et haem umeshalleach et habbanim chayyav leshalleach et haem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "shalleach teshallach et haem": 
Lakach et habbanim vehecheziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehen patur milleshalleach. shilleach et haem vechazar vetzad otah hare ze muttar. lo asra tora ella latzud otah vehi enah yechola lifroach bishvil habbanim shehi merachefet alehen shello yillakchu shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim". aval im hotziah mittachat yado vechazar vetzad otah muttar: 
Shilluach haem eno noheg ella beof tahor sheeno mezumman kegon yone shovach vaaliyya veofot shekkinnenu bappardes shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "ki yikkare". aval hamezumman kegon avazin vetarnegolin veyonim shekkinnenu babbayit eno chayyav leshalleach: 
Hayu haefrochin mafrichin sheenan tzerichin leimman o betzim muzarot eno chayyav leshalleach. hayu efrochin terefot hare ellu kevetzim muzarot ufatur milleshalleach: 
Zachar shemmetzao rovetz al hakken patur milleshalleach. of tame rovetz al betze of tahor o of tahor rovetz al betze of tame patur milleshalleach: 
Hayta rovetzet al betzim sheenan minah vehen tehorin hare ze meshalleach. veim lo shilleach eno loke. hayta haem terefa chayyav leshallechah: 
Shachat miktzat simanin betoch hakken kodem sheyyikkachenna chayyav leshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayta meofefet. im kenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach. veim lav patur milleshalleach. hayta matlit o kenafayim chotztzot ben kenafeha uven hakken hare ze meshalleach. veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayu shene sidre betzim uchenafeha nogot basseder haelyon. o shehayta rovetzet al betzim muzarot vetachtehen betzim yafot. o shehayta em al gabbe em. o shehaya hazzachar al hakken vehaem al hazzachar. hare ze lo yikkach. veim lakach yeshalleach veim lo shilleach eno loke: 
Hayta yoshevet ben haefrochim o ben habbetzim veenah nogaat bahen patur milleshalleach. vechen im hayta betzad hakken uchenafeha nogot bakken mitztziddo patur milleshalleach: 
Hayta al shene badde ilan vehakken benehen roin kol sheillu yinnatlu habbaddin tippol al hakken chayyav leshalleach: 
Hayta rovetzet al efroach echad o al betza achat chayyav leshalleach. hammotze ken al pene hammayim o al gabbe baale chayyim chayyav leshalleach. lo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "efrochim o betzim" velo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 6)</small> "bechol etz o al haaretz" ella sheddibber hakkatuv behove: 
Asur lizkot babbetzim kol zeman shehaem rovetzet alehen. lefichach afillu hayta rovetzet al habbetzim o al haefrochim baaliyyato ushovacho enan mezummanin. velo kana lo chatzero. keshem sheeno yachol lizkot bahen laacherim kach lo tizke lo chatzero bahen. ulefichach chayyav leshalleach: 
Asur littol em al habbanim vaafillu letaher bahen et hametzora shehi mitzva. veim lakach chayyav leshalleach. veim lo shilleach loke. sheen ase doche lo taase vaase. (vaase) velo ase doche ase: 
Hammakdish of levedek habbayit ufarach miyyado vahare hu makkiro umetzao rovetz al haefrochim o al habbetzim lokeach hakkol umevian lide gizbar. sheen shilluach haem noheg bemukdashin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 7)</small> "veet habbanim tikkach lach" veellu enan shellecha: 
Of sheharag et hannefesh patur milleshalleach mippene shehu metzuvve lahavio levet din ladun oto:
Mishneh Torah, Ritual Slaughter 14: Mitzvat ase lechassot dam shichitat chayya tehora o of tahor shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yatzud tzed chayya o of asher yeachel veshafach et damo vechissahu beafar". lefichach chayyav levarech kodem sheyyechasse baruch atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al kissuy haddam:

Kissuy haddam noheg bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. lo neemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yatzud" ella bahove. venoheg bechullin velo bemukdashin. ben kadshe hammizbeach ben kadshe bedek habbayit. veim avar ushechatan eno chayyav lechassot et daman:
Shachat chayya veof veachar kach hikdishan o hikdish et haddam chayyav lechassot:

Kilayim habba mibbehema vechayya vechen beriyya shehi sefek behema o chayya tzarich lechassot veeno mevarech. hashshochet lechole beshabbat chayyav lechassot leachar shabbat. vechen hashshochet safek o kilayim beyom tov mechasse damo leachar yom tov:
Hashshochet ofot umine chayya bemakom echad mevarech beracha achat lechullan vechissuy echad lechullan:

Dam shennitarev bammayim im yesh bo mare dam chayyav lechassot veim lav patur. nitarev beyayin o bedam behema roin otan keillu hem mayim. im efshar sheyerae mare haddam shechayyav lechassoto keshiur ze illu haya mayim chayyav lechassot hakkol veim lav patur:
Kissahu venitgalla eno chayyav lechassoto paam acheret. kissathu haruach eno chayyav lechassot. chazar venitgalla achar shekkissathu haruach chayyav lechassot:
Dam hannittaz vesheal hassakkin im en sham dam ella hu chayyav lechassot:
Shachat venivla haddam bakkarka im rishshumo nikkar chayyav lechassot. veim lav hare ze kemi shekkissathu haruach ufatur millechassot:

En chayyav bechissuy ella dam shechita haruya laachila shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "asher yeachel". lefichach hashshochet venimtzet terefa. o hashshochet chullin baazara. o hashshochet chayya veof shennigmar dinan liskila vehashshochet venitnabbela beyado patur millechassot. vechen cheres shote vekatan sheshshachatu benan leven atzman peturin millechassot dam shechitatan:

Bamme mechassin besid uvegafsit bezevel dak uvechol dak sheen hayyotzer tzarich lechatsho uvishchikat avanim vacharasim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka uvinsoret charasim dakka uvilvena vecharsit umegufa shekketashah shekkol ellu min afar hen. aval im kafa alav keli o kissahu baavanim en ze kissuy shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "beafar":

Lefichach en mechassim bezevel gas vechol gas vekemach vesubbin umorsan ushechikat kele mattachot lefi sheen ellu min afar. chutz mishshechikat hazzahav bilvad shemmechassin bahem mippene shennikra afar shenneemar <small>(Iyov 28 6)</small> "veafrot zahav lo" veomer <small>(Devarim 9 21)</small> "ad asher dak leafar":

Mechassin beshichor vehu piach hakkivshan uvechochal uvenikrat pesilim uveefer ben efer etzim ben efer begadim afillu efer basar shennisraf shehare katuv <small>(Bamidbar 19 17)</small> "meafar serefat hachattat". umuttar lechassot beafar ir hanniddachat:
Hashshochet tzarich litten afar lematta veachar kach yishchot bo veachar kach yechasse beafar aval lo yishchot bichli vichasse beafar:
Umi sheshshachat hu yechasse shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 17 13)</small> "vechissahu beafar". veim lo kissahu veraahu acher chayyav lechassot shezzo mitzva bifne atzmah veenah teluya bashshochet levad:

Ucheshemmechasse lo yechasse beraglo ella beyado o besakkin o bichli kede shello yinhog bo minhag bizzayon veyihyu mitzvot bezuyot alav. sheen hakkavod leatzman shel mitzvot ella lemi shetztzivva bahen baruch hu vehitztzilanu millemashshesh bachoshech vearach otanu ner leyashsher hammaakashshim veor lehorot netivot hayysher. vechen hu omer <small>(Tehillim 119 105)</small> "ner leragli devarecha veor lintivati":
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 1:
Arbaa mine shevuot hen. shevuat bittuy ushevuat shav ushevuat happikkadon ushevuat haedut. shevuat bittuy hu shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "o nefesh ki tishshava levatte visfatayim lehara o lehetiv". vehi nechleket learbaa chalakim. shetayim lehabba. ushetayim lesheavar. kegon shennishba al davar sheavar shennaasa o shello naasa. veal davar sheatid lihyot sheyyease veshello yease: 
Veen shevuat bittuy noheget ella bidvarim sheefshar lo laasotan ben lehabba ben lesheavar. ketzad lesheavar. sheachalti. o shezzarakti even layyam. o sheddibber peloni im peloni. o shello achalti. o shello zarak even layyam. o shello dibber peloni im peloni. ketzad lehabba. sheochal o shello ochal. o sheezrok o shello ezrok even layyam. hare ellu shetayim lesheavar ushetayim lehabba: 
Nishba achat mearba machalokot ellu vehechlif kegon shennishba shello yochal veachal o sheyyochal velo achal o sheachalti vehu lo achal shello achalti veachal hare zo shevuat sheker. veal ze vechayyotze bo neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "lo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker". veim nishba lashsheker bemezid loke. beshogeg mevi karban ole veyored shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "venelam mimmennu vehu yada veashem" vegomer: 
Shevuat shav nechleket learba machalokot. haachat shennishba al davar hayyadua sheen ken. ketzad. kegon shennishba al haish shehu ishsha. veal haishsha shehu ish. veal ammud shel shayish shehu shel zahav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Hashsheniyya shennishba al davar yadua sheen bo safek leadam shehu ken. kegon shennishba al hashshamayim shehu shamayim. veal haeven zo shehi even. veal hashshenayim shehem shenayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze. shezze haddavar en bo safek leadam shalem kede letzaddek haddavar bishvua: 
Shelishit shennishba levattel et hammitzva. ketzad. kegon shennishba shello yitattef betzitzit. shello yilbash tefillin. veshello yeshev bassukka bechag hassukkot. velo yochal matztza belele happesach. o sheyyitanne beshabbatot uveyamim tovim. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Reviit shennishba al davar sheen koach bo laasot. ketzad. kegon shennishba shello yishan shelosha yamim layla vayom retzufim. o shello yitom kelum shiva yamim retzufim. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kol hannishba shevuat shav mearba shevuot ellu over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav". veim haya mezid loke veim haya shogeg patur mikkelum: 
Shevuat happikkadon ketzad. kol mi sheyyesh mamon chavero beyado ben pikkadon ben milve o sheggezalo o ashako o matza lo aveda velo hechezirah vechayyotze baze vetava mimmennu mamon sheyyesh lo beyado vechafar bo hare ze over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 11)</small> "lo techachashu" zo azhara lichfirat mamon. veen lokin al lav ze. veim nishba lo al sheker al mamon shekkafar bo hare ze over belav acher veal ze neemar <small>(Vayikra 19 11)</small> "lo teshakkeru ish baamito" zo azhara lenishba al kefirat mamon. ushevua zo hi hannikret shevuat happikkadon: 
Uma hu chayyav al shevuat happikkadon sheshshikker bah. meshallem et hakkeren shekkafar bo im tosefet chomesh. umakriv asham vadday ben shehaya mezid ben shehaya shogeg shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "vechichesh baamito befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 5 23)</small> "vehaya ki yecheta veashem". velo neemar bo venelam mimmennu, lechayyev mezid keshogeg: 
Vehu sheyyazid befikkadon o bemamon shennitchayyev bo veyada bo bishat shevua. aval im shagag veshachach sheyyesh lo etzlo mamon vechafar venishba veachar kach yada hare ze anus ufatur mikkelum. vechen im lo yada sheasur lishshava lashsheker al kefirat mamon hare ze anus ufatur: 
Im ken heach hi shiggat shevuat happikkadon. kegon shenneelam mimmennu im chayyavin aleha karban im lav veyada shehi asura vesheyyesh lo etzlo mamon zo hi shiggatah. uzedonah sheyyada shechayyavin aleha karban: 
Shevuat haedut ketzad. haedim sheyyadu edut mamon utevaam baal haedut lehaid lo vechafru beedutan velo heidu venishbeu sheenan yodin lo edut zo hi nikret shevuat haedut. vechayyavin al shevua zo karban ole veyored ben shehayu mezidin ben shehayu shoggim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "nefesh ki techeta veshama kol ala vehu ed" velo neemar bah venelam, lechayyev al hazzadon kishgaga: 
Ketzad shiggat shevuat haedut. kegon shenneelam mimmennu shechayyavin aleha karban veyada sheshshevua zo asura veshehi sheker. uzedonah sheyyada shechayyavin aleha karban. aval im lo yada shehi asura o sheshshachchu haedut venishbeu veachar kach noda lahem shehen yodin lo edut veshennishbeu al sheker hare ellu anusin ufeturin af min hakkarban:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 2: Echad hannishba echad mearbaa mine shevuot ellu mippi atzmo. veechad hammushba mippi acherim veana amen. afillu hishbio akkum o katan veana amen chayyav. shekkol haone amen achar shevua kemotzi shevua mippiv. veechad haone amen o haomer davar sheinyano keinyan amen. kegon sheamar hen o mechuyyav ani bishvua zo. kibbalti alay shevua zo. vechol kayyotze baze bechol lashon hare ze kenishba lechol davar ben lechayyevo malkot ben lechayyevo karban:

Echad hannishba. o shehishbio acher bashshem hameyuchad. o beechad min hakkinnuyin kegon shennishba bemi sheshshemo channun uvemi sheshshemo rachum uvemi sheshshemo erech appayim. vechayyotze bahen bechol lashon hare zo shevua gemura. vechen ala vearur hare hen shevua. vehu sheyyazkir shem min hashshemot o kinnuy min hakkinnuyin. ketzad. kegon sheamar beala o arur laAdonai. o lemi sheshshemo channun. o lemi sheshshemo rachum. mi sheyyochal davar peloni vaachalo hare ze nishba lashsheker. vechen bishar mine shevuot:
Vechen haomer shevua baAdonai o bemi sheshshemo channun shello ochal veachal. shezzo ishsha vehu ish. sheen lecha beyadi kelum veyesh lo. sheeni yodea lecha edut vehu yodea. hare ze chayyav:

Amar ala o arur o shevua velo hizkir shem velo kinnuy hare ze asur baddavar shennishba alav. aval eno loke velo mevi karban im avar al shevuato ad sheyyihye bah shem min hashshemot hammeyuchadim o kinnuy min hakkinnuyin kemo shebbearnu:

Velo hashshevua bilvad ella kol kinnuye shevua kishvua. kegon shehayu anshe oto makom illegim vehayu korim lishvua shevutah o shekuka. o shehayu arammiyyim shelleshon shevua bilshonam momta. vehaillegim mechannin otah veomrim moha. kevan sheamar lashon shemmashmao veinyano shevua hare ze chayyav kemi shehotzi leshon shevua:

Vechen haomer lav lav shete peamim derech shevua o hen hen vehizkir shem o kinnuy hare ze kenishba. vechen yamin shevua. usemol shevua. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya sav 8)</small> "nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo". vechen haomer mivta shello eese kach vechach vehizkir shem o kinnuy hare zo shevua:
Amar issar laAdonai o lemi sheshshemo channun sheeese o shello eese hoil vehotzio bilshon shevua hare hi kishvua:
Shama chavero nishba veamar vaani kemotcha hoil velo hotzi shevua mippiv velo hishbio chavero hare ze patur. vezehu matpis bishvua shehu patur:

Vechen im nishba shello ochal basar ze. vechazar veamar vahare happat zo kabbasar hazze hare hu patur al happat. shehare lo hotzi shevua mippiv aleha ella hitpisah. veaf al pi shehu patur min hammalkot o min hakkarban asur lo leechol otah happat shehitpis bishvua:

Mi shennitkavven lishvua vegamar belibbo shello yochal hayyom o shello yishte vesheddavar ze asur alav bishvua velo hotzi visfatav hare ze muttar shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "levatte bisfatayim". en hannishba chayyav ad sheyyotzi inyan shevua bisfatav:

Vechen im gamar belibbo lehishshava vetaa vehotzi bisfatav davar shello haya belibbo hare ze muttar. ketzad. hammitkavvin lehishshava shello yochal etzel reuven ucheshebba lehotzi shevua nishba shello yochal etzel shimon. hare ze muttar leechol im reuven shehare lo hotzio bisfatav. veim shimon shehare lo haya shimon belibbo:

Vechen shear mine shevuot eno chayyav ad sheyyihye piv velibbo shavin. lefichach im nishba echad befanenu shello yochal hayyom veachal. vehitru bo veamar ani lo haya belibbi ella shello etze hayyom vetaa leshoni vehotzi achila shello hayta belibbi hare ze eno loke. ad sheyyode bifne edim kodem sheyyochal sheal achila nishba. o shekkibbel alav hateraa velo taan shettaa beet hateraa af al pi shettaan achar kach en shomin lo. vechen im hitru bo veamar meolam lo nishbati o lo nadarti ella al davar ze veachar sheheidu alav shennishba o nadar amar ken haya aval lo haya pi velibbi shavin o tenay haya belibbi al hanneder en shomin lo veloke:
Kayyotze bo amru lo ishtecha nadra. veamar belibbi haya lehafer lah vehefarti shomin lo. amru lo nadra vehu omer lo nadra vechevan sheraa otam heidu alav amar belibbi haya lehafer en shomin lo:
Gamar belibbo shello leechol pat chittin venishba shello yochal pat setam asur befat chittim sheppat chittim pat shemah:

Mi shennishba veamar shevua shello ochal hayyom veal datechem ani nishba. en ze yachol lomar kach vechach haya belibbi. shello nishba ze al dato ella al daat acherim vechevan shehaya piv velibbam shel acherim shennishba al datam shavim chayyav mippene shellibbam shel ellu bimkom libbo kam. vechen bishar mine shevuot:
Lefichach keshemmashbiin haddayyanin et hannishba omrim lo lo al datecha anu mashbiim otcha ella al datenu:

Mi shennishba vehaya piv velibbo shavin bishvua. veachar shenneesar chazar bo miyyad betoch kede dibbur vehu kede sheyyomar talmid lerav shalom alecha rabbi. veamar en zo shevua o nichamti o chazarti bi vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheinyanam shehittir ma sheasar hare ze muttar veneekra hashshevua shezze dome letoe:

Vechen im amru lo acherim chazor becha o muttar lecha vechayyotze bidvarim ellu vekibbel mehen betoch kede dibbur veamar hen o chazarti bi vechayyotze baze hare ze muttar. veim achar kede dibbur eno yachol lachzor bo:

Nishba vechazar bo betoch kede dibbur belibbo en ze kelum. vechen im amru lo acherim chazor becha o muttar lecha o machul lecha vekibbel divrehem belibbo betoch kede dibbur en ze kelum ad sheyyotzi hachazara befiv kemo hashshevua:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 3:
Kol hannishba shevua mearba mine shevuot ellu beones hare ze patur mikkelum. veechad hannishba mittechillato beones kemo shebbearnu. o shennishba veneenas velo hinnichuhu lekayyem shevuato. o shehishbio annas. lefichach nishbain lacharamin ulehorgin ulemochsin: 
Bee ze moches amru. bemoches haomed meelav shellokeach mamon shello birshut melech hammedina. o shellokeach birshut hammelech aval mosif leatzmo al haddavar hakkatzuv kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gezela: 
Vetzarich hannishba beones lihyot kavvanato belibbo beet hashshevua ledavar happotro. veaf al pi shehaddevarim ellu shebballev enan devarim. hoil veeno yachol lehotzi bisfatav mippene haones. hare ze somech al devarim shebbelibbo: 
Ketzad. kegon shennishba leannas shello yochal basar setam. uvelibbo shello yochal hayyom o shello yochal besar chazir hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Vechen shevuat havay veshel shegagot patur alehen. shevuat (shel) havay ketzad. kegon sheraa chelot gedolot vechoma gevoha venishba sheraiti chel peloni hammelech vehem keyotze mitzrayim. vesheraiti chomat ir pelonit gevoha ad larakia vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. shezze lo gamar belibbo shehaddavar kach belo pachot velo yoter velo nitkavven ella lesapper et gova hachoma o rov haam: 
Shevua shel shegagot ketzad. im shevuat haedut o happikkadon hi kegon sheshshagag befikkadon uveedut shehu patur mikkelum kemo shebbearnu. veim shevuat shav hi kegon shennishba shello yilbash tefillin velo yada shehattefillin mitzva. veim shevuat sheker hi kegon shennishba shello achal venizkar sheachal. o shennishba shello yochal veshachach veachal. o shello tehane ishto lo mippene shegganva kiso o shehikketa et beno venoda shello ganva veshello hikketa. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Im ken e zehu shiggat shevuat bittuy shechayyavin aleha karban ole veyored lesheavar. kegon shennishba shello achal vehu yodea sheachal. vesheshshevuat sheker zo shennishba asura aval lo yada shechayyavin aleha karban. zo hi hashshegaga shechayyavin aleha karban ole veyored bishvuat bittuy lesheavar: 
Vechetzad hi hashshegaga shechayyavin aleha karban lehabba. kegon shennishba shello yochal pat chittim veshagag vedimma shennishba sheyyochal pat chittim vaachalah shezze neelma mimmennu hashshevua heach hayta vahare hu zocher et hachefetz shennishba alav. zo hi shiggat shevuat bittuy lehabba shechayyavin aleha karban: 
Aval im nishba shello yochal pat chittim veachal pat chittim al daat shehu pat seorim hare ze anus ufatur. shehare lo neelma mimmennu shevua velo nelam mimmennu ella chefetz shennishba alav: 
Neelma mimmennu shevua heach hayta venelam mimmennu chefetz shennishba alav hare ze patur min hakkarban. ketzad. kegon shennishba shello leechol pat chittim vedimma shennishba sheyyochal pat chittim veachal pat chittim al daat shehu pat seorim shehare helem shevua vechefetz beyado hare ze keanus ufatur: 
Nishba al kikkar shello yochlennu venitztaer alav vaachalo mippene hatztzaar vehu shogeg shehare dimma shemmuttar lo leachlo mippene hatztzaar hare ze patur min hakkarban lefi sheeno shav midiato ella yada sheasura hi vaachalah betaut:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 4:
Mi shennishba shello yochal hayyom kelum veachal pachot mikkezayit patur. sheen achila pechuta mikkezayit. vahare hu keochel chatzi shiur minnevelot uterefot vechayyotze bahen. veim amar shevua shello ochal davar ze vaachalo chayyav. vaafillu haya haddavar shennishba alav zera chardal echad o pachot mimmennu: 
Nishba shello yitom kelum veachal kol shehu chayyav: 
Mi shennishba shello yochal hayyom veshata chayyav shehashshetiyya bichlal achila. lefichach im achal veshata eno chayyav ella malkot achat im haya mezid o chattat achat im haya shogeg: 
Nishba shello yishte hayyom hare ze muttar leechol. sheen achila bichlal shetiyya. vechamma yishte vihe chayyav. nire li sheeno chayyav ad sheyyishte reviit kishar haissurin: 
Shevua shello ochal hayyom veachal minin harebe. o shevua shello eshte hayyom veshata mine mashkin harebe eno chayyav ella achat. vaafillu amar shevua shello ochal hayyom basar ufat vekitnit veachal hakkol eno chayyav ella achat. vechullan mitztarfin lichzayit: 
Shevua shello ochal veshello eshte veachal veshata chayyav shetayim shehashshetiyya bichlal achila. vehoil uferet veamar veshello eshte gilla dato shello kalal hashshetiyya bichlal haachila venimtza kenishba al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo ulefichach chayyav shetayim: 
Vechen haomer shevua shello ochal pat chittin ufat seorin ufat kussemin vaachalan chayyav al kol achat veachat shello amar pat ufat ufat ella lechallek ulechayyev al kol achat: 
Haya chavero mesarhev bo leechol etzlo veamar lo bo ushete immi yayin vechalav udevash. veamar shevua sheeni shote yayin vechalav udevash veshata mehen chayyav al kol achat veachat bifne atzmo. shehaya lo lomar shevua sheeni shote kelum o ma sheamarta umishshechazar uferet gilla dato shechiyyev atzmo bishvua al kol min umin bifne atzmo. lefichach en mitztarfin ze im ze veeno chayyav ad sheyyochal kashshiur mimmin echad. hoil vehen chalukin lechattaot hare hen kechelev vedam sheenan mitztarfin lichzayit kemo shennitbaer behilchot maachalot asurot: 
Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo o shello ochal otah kevan sheachal mimmenna kezayit chayyav. shevua shello ochalenna eno chayyav ad sheyyochal et kullah. amar shevua shello ochal kikkar zo shevua shello ochalenna vaachalah eno chayyav ella achat: 
Vechen im amar shevua shello ochal hayyom vechazar venishba al hakkikkar shello yochalenna vaachalah kullah beoto hayyom eno chayyav ella achat. vechen kol kayyotze baze. sheen shevua chala al shevua. aval im nishba al hakkikkar shello yochalenna vechazar venishba shello yochal kelum. o shello yochal kikkar zo vaachalah kullah chayyav shetayim. shebbeshaa shennishba battechilla shello yochlenna eno chayyav ad sheyyochal kullah. ucheshechazar venishba shello yochal [kelum] o shello yochal otah mishsheyyochal mimmenna kezayit yitchayyev uchesheyyochal kullah yitchayyev bishvua rishona: 
Shevua shello ochal teenim. vechazar venishba al hatteenim veal haanavim. chayyav al hatteenim shetayim shehare kalal hatteenim shenneesru bishvua rishona im haanavim shehayu muttarin umittoch shechala shevua sheniyya al haanavim chala al hatteenim venitchayyev bishte shevuot kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot: 
Shevua shello ochal shemone. shevua shello ochal tesha. shevua shello ochal eser. ben sheachal shemone ben sheachal tesha ben sheachal eser eno chayyav ella achat: 
Shevua shello ochal eser. shevua shello ochal tesha. shevua shello ochal shemone. im achal eser chayyav shalosh al kol shevua ushevua achat. vechen im achal tesha chayyav shetayim. achal shemone chayyav achat: 
Shevua shello ochal teenim vechazar venishba shello yochal teenim vaanavim keachat. veshagag veachal teenim vehifrish karban. veachar kach shagag veachal anavim eno chayyav al haanavim mippene shehen kachatzi shiur veen meviin karban al chatzi shiur: 
Vechen hannishba shello yochal eser vechazar venishba shello yochal eser vetesha veachal eser vehifrish karban vechazar veshagag veachal tesha hare ze kachatzi shiur. veen meviin karban al chatzi shiur. sheinyan shevua acharona shello yochal tesha veeser: 
Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo haggedola im ochal kikkar zo hakketanna veshachach tenay ze beet sheachal hakketanna veachal achar kach haggedola bemezid chayyav: 
Achal et hakketanna vehu zocher hattenay veyodea shebbaachilatah teaser haggedola veshachach veachal et haggedola vechimdumme lo sheadayin lo neesra patur. achal shetehen bishgaga patur. shetehen bemezid ben sheachal haggedola battechilla o baacharona chayyav: 
Vechen im telaan zo bazo venishba veamar shevua shello ochal achat mehem im achalti haacheret veshachach hattenay veachal achat mehen veachal hashsheniyya bezadon chayyav: 
Achal harishona bezadon vehashsheniyya bishgaga patur. shetehen bezadon chayyav: 
Shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom veavar hayyom velo achalah. beshogeg mevi karban ole veyored. bemezid eno loke shehare lo asa maase veaf al pi sheavar al shevuat sheker: 
Umippene ma loke im nishba sheachal vehu lo achal o shello achal vehu achal veaf al pi shello asa maase. mippene shemmeet shevuato lashsheker nishba. aval im nishba sheyyaase vehu lo asa enah shevuat sheker mishsheat shevua: 
Mi sheamar lachavero shevua lo ochal lecha o shevua sheeni ochel lecha o shehaya mesarhev bo leechol etzlo vehu nimna venishba veamar shevua sheochal lecha. vechen haomer lo shevua lo ochal lecha. kol ellu asurin vahare nishba shello yochal etzlo. veim amar kol halleshonot haellu veavar veachal eno chayyav ella achat:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 5:
Mi shennishba shezzarak ish peloni tzeror layyam vehu lo zarak. o shello zarak vehu zarak. hare ze chayyav bishvuat bittuy. veaf al pi sheeno bilhabba shehare eno yachol lehishshava sheyyizrok veshello yizrok ish peloni. vechol mi shennishba al acherim sheyyaasu kach vechach o lo yaasu afillu hayu banav o ishto eno chayyav bishvuat bittuy. shehare en beyado lo lekayyem velo levattel. umakkin oto makkat mardut shehare en beyado lekayyem shevua zo venimtza gorem lishvuat shav: 
Velamma eno loke mishshum shevuat shav shehare efshar leotan acherim sheyyishmeu mimmennu vetitkayyem shevuato. venimtza keshemmatrim bo beet shennishba hateraat safek sheen lokin aleha ella im ken haya lav shebbo meforash battora kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin. veen otan acherim nizkakin lekayyem divre ze hannishba ella im ken anu amen kemo shebbearnu: 
Veim kiyyemu devarav hare ellu meshubbachin shello hirgilu lehotzi shevua lashshav: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshennishba al davar sheeno birshuto. kegon shennishba reuven al shimon shello yelech bischora o shello yochal basar vechayyotze baze. aval im nishba reuven shello yikkanes shimon beveto veshello yehane minnechasav veavar shimon venichnas leveto shel reuven venehena minnechasav shello middaat reuven reuven patur shehare hu anus veshimon chayyav sheavar al davar haasur lo laasoto. shello nishba ze ella al davar shehu birshuto. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shevua shello ochal veachal ochalin sheenan reuyin laachila veshata mashkim sheenan reuyin lishtiyya patur. achal devarim haasurin min hattora baachila kegon sheachal kezayit nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim patur mishshum shevuat bittuy. shevua sheochal veachal ochalin sheenan reuyim laachila veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya o sheachal nevelot uterefot vechayyotze bahen patur mishshevuat bittuy shehare yatza yede achila meachar shehen chashuvin etzlo achilatan shemah achila: 
Shevua shello achalti vehu achal devarim sheenan reuyin laachila o nevelot uterefot chayyav sheachilatan shemah achila shekkevar hen chashuvin etzlo shehare achalan. aval lehabba shennishba shello yochal venikra mikre vaachalan enah achila kemo shebbearnu: 
Shevua shello ochal kol shehu minnevelot uterefot veachal pachot mikkezayit chayyav bishvua shehare eno mushba al chatzi shiur mehar sinay: 
Shevua sheochal pachot mikkezayit nevela uterefa chayyav bishvuat bittuy. shevua shello ochal afar vechayyotze bo middevarim sheenan reuyin laachila im achal kezayit chayyav. achal pachot mikkezayit hare ze safek shemma yitchayyev bechol shehu mippene sheen ze darko laachila kede lehatzericho shiur: 
Vechen hannishba shello leechol chartzan veachal mimmennu pachot mikkezayit hare ze safek. haya hannishba nazir shehu asur bechartzan bichzayit veachal mimmennu pachot mikkezayit eno chayyav bishvuat bittuy. shehare en dato bishvuato ella al (kol) kezayit shehu mushba alav veen shevua chala alav. lefichach im peresh veamar shevua shello ochal chartzan echad vaachalo chayyav: 
Shevua shello ochal temarim unevelot uterefot veachal kezayit nevela o terefa chayyav af mishshum shevuat bittuy shehare kalal devarim haasurin im devarim hammuttarin. umittoch shechala shevua al hattemarim chala al devarim haasurim kemo shebbearnu: 
Aval im nishba shello yochal nevela uterefa vechayyotze bahen ben achal ben lo achal en kan chiyyuv shevua kelal lo shevuat bittuy velo shevuat shav: 
Nishba sheyyochal nevela uterefa vechayyotze bahen meissure tora hare ze loke mishshum shevuat shav ben achal ben lo achal: 
Shevua sheochal kikkar zo shevua shello ochalenna hashsheniyya shevuat shav shehare mitzva alav leachlah veloke al shevua sheniyya ben achal ben lo achal. veim lo achalah chayyav af bishvuat bittuy: 
Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo shevua sheochalenna. hashsheniyya shevuat shav shehare zo asura alav leachlah veloke al shevua sheniyya zo ben achalah ben lo achalah. veim achalah loke af mishshum shevuat bittuy. vechen kol hannishba levattel et hammitzva velo bittel patur mishshevuat bittuy veloke mishshum shevuat shav veose hammitzva shennishba levattelah: 
Ketzad. kegon shennishba shello yaase sukka veshello yilbash tefillin veshello yitten tzedaka. vechen hannishba lachavero shello aid lecha edut zo sheani yodah o shello aid lecha im eda lecha edut hare ze loke mishshum shevuat shav mippene shehu metzuvve lehaid. vechen haomer lachavero shevua shello eda lecha edut hare zo shevuat shav sheen beyado shello yeda lo edut. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nishba lekayyem et hammitzva velo kiyyem patur mishshum shevuat bittuy. ketzad. kegon shennishba sheyyaase lulav o sukka o sheyyitten tzedaka leani o sheyyaid lo im yeda lo edut velo asa velo natan velo heid hare ze patur mishshum shevuat bittuy. sheen shevuat bittuy chala ella al divre harshut sheim ratza ose veim lo ratza eno ose shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "lehara o lehetiv". lefichach kol hannishba lehara laacherim patur mishshevuat bittuy kegon shennishba sheyyakke et peloni o yekallelennu o yigzol mamono o yimserennu beyad annas mippene shehu metzuvve shello laasot. veyerae li shehu loke mishshum shevuat shav: 
Nishba lehara leatzmo kegon shennishba sheyyachavol beatzmo af al pi sheeno rashshay shevua chala alav. veim lo hera leatzmo chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy. nishba lehetiv laacherim hatava shebbeyado laasotah kegon sheyyedabber alav lashshilton o yechabbedennu shevua chala alav. veim avar velo asa chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy: 
Nishba shello yochal matztza shana o shenatayim. hare ze asur leechol matztza belele happesach veim achal chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy. veen ze shevuat shav shehare lo nishba shello yochal matztza belele happesach ella kalal ittim sheachilat matztza bahem reshut im et sheachilatah bo mitzva umittoch shechala shevua al shear hayyamim chala al lel happesach. vechen kol kayyotze baze. kegon shennishba shello yeshev betzel sukka leolam o shello yaale alav beged shana o shenatayim: 
Nishba sheheniach tefillin hayyom o lo heniach. shennitattef betzitzit o lo nitattef. hare ze shevuat bittuy lesheavar. shezze maggid davar shennaasa velo nishba al hammitzva lo lekayyemah velo levattelah: 
Nishba shello yishan sheloshet yamim. o shello yochal kelum shivat yamim vechayyotze baze shehi shevuat shav. en omrin yeor ze ad sheyyitztaer veyatzum ad sheyyitztaer velo yihye bo koach lisbol veachar kach yochal o yishan. ella malkin oto miyyad mishshum shevuat shav veyishan veyochal bechol et sheyyirtze: 
Nishba sheraa gamal poreach baavir. amru lo heach nishbata lashshav veamar of gadol raiti umiggadlo kerativ gamal vechach haya bedati en ze kelum. sheen kol adam korin gamal ella legamal uvatla dato etzel kol adam veloke. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Davar yadua etzel hachachamim baale sechel umadda shehashshemesh gedola min haaretz mea veshivim peamim. nishba echad min haam shehashshemesh gedola min haaretz eno loke mishshum shevuat shav sheaf al pi shehaddavar ken hu en davar ze galuy veyadua lechol haam ella ligdole hachachamim bilvad. veeno chayyav ella im ken nishba al davar sheggaluy veyadua lishlosha bene adam mishshear haam kegon ish shehu ish veeven shehu even. vechen im nishba shehashshemesh ketanna min haaretz eno loke. veaf al pi sheen haddavar ken mippene sheen ze yadua lechol adam veeno kemi shennishba al haish shehu ishsha shehare lo nishba ella al reiyyat enav shehare hu roe otah ketanna. vechen kol kayyotze baze middivre cheshbon tekufot mazzalot vegimatriyyaot vechayyotze bahen middivre chachma sheen nikkarin ella laanashim acherim:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 6:
Mi shennishba shevuat bittuy venicham al shevuato veraa shehu mitztaer im yekayyem shevua zo venehpecha dato ledaat acheret. o shennolad lo davar shello haya bedato bishat hashshevua venicham biglalo. hare ze nishal lechacham echad o lishlosha hedyotot bemakom sheen sham chacham umattirin lo shevuato. veyihye muttar laasot davar shennishba shello laasoto. o shello laasot davar shennishba laasoto. vezehu hannikra hetter shevuot: 
Vedavar ze en lo ikkar kelal battora shebbichtav. ella kach lamdu mimmoshe rabbenu mippi hakkabbala shezze hakkatuv <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" shello yechallel hu beatzmo derech kallut rosh bishat nefesh kainyan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "vechillalta et shem elohecha". aval im nicham vechazar bo chacham mattir lo: 
Veen adam yachol lehattir shevuat atzmo. veen adam rashshay lehattir shevua o neder bemakom sheyyesh gadol mimmennu bechachma. uvemakom sheyyesh bo rabbo asur lo lehattir ella middaat rabbo: 
Ze shennishba hu sheyyavo lifne hechacham lehattir lo ben ish ben ishsha. veeno ose shaliach lehishshael lo al nidro. vehabbaal naase shaliach lacharatat ishto umattirin lah uvilvad sheyyihyu hashshelosha mekubbatzim aval lo yekabbetz otan lehattir lah lechattechilla. veeno naase shaliach lehattir neder leishto: 
Ketzad mattirin. yavo hannishba lechacham hammuvhak o lishlosha hedyotot im en sham mumche. veomer ani nishbati al kach vechach venichamti. veillu hayiti yodea sheani mitztaer bedavar ze ad ko o sheera li kach vechach lo hayiti nishba veillu hayta dati beet hashshevua kemo atta lo hayiti nishba. vehechacham o gedol hashshelosha omer lo uchevar nichamta. vehu omer lo hen. chozer veomer lo sharuy lecha o muttar lecha o machul lecha vechol kayyotze beinyan ze bechol lashon. aval im amar lo mufar lecha o neekra shevuatcha vechol kayyotze beinyan ze lo amar kelum. sheen mefer ella habbaal o haav aval hechacham eno omer ella leshon hattara umechila: 
Hakkerovim kesherim lehattir nedarim ushevuot. umattirin ballayla umeummad. sheen hahetter hazze din. lefichach nishalin lishvuot velindarim beshabbat im hayu letzorech hashshabbat. kegon sheyyattiru lo shevuato kede sheyyochal veyishte hayyom. vaafillu haya lo penay lehattir shevuato o nidro meerev shabbat hare ze mattir beshabbat hoil vehu letzorech hashshabbat: 
Reuven shehishbia leshimon veana amen. o kibbel hashshevua venicham shimon al shevuato venishal aleha. en mattirin lo ella bifne reuven shehishbio. vechen im nishba reuven o nadar shello yehane mishshimon o shello yehane bo shimon venicham venishal lechacham en mattirin lo ella bifne shimon shennadar mimmennu hanaya. vaafillu haya shimon katan o akkum en mattirin lo ella befanav kede sheyyeda hanniddar shehittir ze nidro o shevuato ulefichach yehane mimmennu o yahane lo: 
Echad hannishba beno leven atzmo veechad hannishba barabbim. vaafillu nishba bashshem hameyuchad baAdonai elohe yisrael venicham hare ze nishal al shevuato umattirin lo. nishba al daat rabbim o shennadar al daat rabbim en mattirin lo leolam ella lidvar mitzva: 
Ketzad. nishba vetala shevuato bedaat rabbim shello yehane bifloni leolam vehutzrechu bene otah hair lilmod tora o lemi sheyyamul et benehem o sheyyizbach lahem velo nimtza ella ze bilvad hare ze nishal lechacham o lishlosha hedyotot umattirin lo shevuato veose lahem mitzvot ellu venotel secharo meotan haanashim shennishba shello yehane mehem: 
Mi shennishba velo nicham al shevuato uva levet din lekayyem shevuato. im rau haddayyanin shehetter shevua zo gorem lemitzva uleshalom ben ish leishto ben adam lachavero veshekkiyyum shevua zo gorem laavera veliktata potchin lo petach venosin venotnin immo baddavar umodiin lo devarim sheggoremet shevuato ad sheyyitnachem. im nicham bedivrehem mattirin lo veim lo nicham veamad bemiryo hare ze yekayyem shevuato: 
Ketzad. nishba sheyyegaresh et ishto o shello yehane yisrael minnechasav o shello yochal basar veshello yishte yayin sheloshim yom vechayyotze baze omrim lo beni im tegaresh et ishtecha atta motzi laaz al banecha veomrim haam mippene ma nitgarsha imman shel ellu ulemachar korim lahem bene gerusha veshemma tinnase leacher vei atta yachol lehachezirah vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. vechen ze shennishbata shello yehane yisrael minnechasecha lemachar yitztarech ze vetihye over al <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "veche achicha immach" <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "vehechezakta bo" o <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> <small>(Devarim 15 11)</small> "patoach tiftach" vechayyotze bahen. veze shennishbata shello tochal basar veshello tishte yayin sheloshim yom hare atta pogea baregel umevattel simchat yom tov veoneg shabbat. im amar illu hayiti yodea ze lo hayiti nishba mattirin lo veim amar af al pi chen lo nichamti verotze ani bechol ze en mattirin lo: 
En potchin benolad. ketzad. nishba shello yehane bifloni venaasa sofer hair. hoil velo nicham al shevuato en potchin lo bedavar ze. vaafillu amar hu meatzmo illu hayiti yodea lo hayiti nishba en mattirin lo hoil vaadayin lo nicham ella retzono shello yehane lo veshello yease ze sofer. aval im nicham hu meatzmo mippene hannolad venehefcha dato mattirin lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shennishba al davar venishba shello yattir shevua zo venicham. hare ze nishal al hashshevua haacharona techilla shennishba shello yattir veachar kach yishal al harishona: 
Nishba shello yedabber im peloni venishba achar kach sheim yishal al shevua zo veyattirah yihye asur lishtot yayin leolam venicham. hare ze nishal al hashshevua harishona umattirah. veachar kach yishal al hashsheniyya. sheen mattirin neder o shevua sheadayin lo chalu. lefichach im haya omed benisan venishba shello yochal basar sheloshim yom merosh chodesh iyyar venicham eno nishal ad sheyyikkanes iyyar: 
Nishba shello yehane lifloni veshello yehane lechacham sheyyishal lo al shevua zo. nishal al harishona veachar kach yishal al hashsheniyya: 
Nishba shello yehane lifloni vahare hu nazir im yishal al shevua zo. yishal al shevuato techilla veachar kach al neziruto. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shevua shello ochal hayyom shevua shello ochal hayyom shevua shello ochal hayyom. o sheamar al kikkar zo shevua shello ochalenna shevua shello ochalenna shevua shello ochalenna. venishal al shevua rishona vehuttera hare ze chayyav mishshum shevua sheniyya. vechen im nishal al hashsheniyya chayyav mishshum shelishit. nishal al hashshelishit bilvad chayyav mishshum rishona usheniyya. nishal al hashsheniyya chayyav mishshum rishona [ushelishit]. im ken mippene ma amru en shevua chala al shevua. sheim lo nishal vaachalah eno chayyav ella achat kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennishba shevuat bittuy lehabba veshikker bishvuato. kegon shennishba shello yochal pat zo vaachalah veachar sheachalah kodem sheyyavi karbano im haya shogeg o kodem sheyyilke im haya mezid nicham venishal lechacham vehittirah lo. hare ze patur min hakkarban o min hammalkot. velo od ella afillu kefatuhu lilkot venishal vehittiru lo kodem sheyyatchilu lehalekoto hare ze patur:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 7:
Hattovea chavero bemamon sheim hoda bo yihye chayyav leshallem vechafar venishba. o shehishbio hattovea vechafar. hare ze hannitba hu chayyav bishvuat happikkadon af al pi shello ana amen. shebbishvuat happikkadon echad hannishba mippi atzmo veechad shehishbio acher vechafar af al pi shello ana amen chayyav. shekkefirato achar shehishbio hattovea kaaniyyat amen: 
Tevao bemamon sheim yode lo veyomar ken haddavar lo yihye chayyav leshallem. kegon shettevao biknas sheen adam meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. vechafar venishba. hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy: 
Vechen im tevao bekarka o beeved o bishtar vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker: 
Velamma niftar mishshum shevuat happikkadon vahare ze illu hoda chayyav haya umeshallem ma shekkafar. lefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "befikkadon o vitsumet yad o begezel o ashak et amito" <small>(Vayikra 5 22)</small> "o matza aveda" hakkol mittaltelin sheim yode bahen yotzi mamon mittachat yado. veyatzu karkaot sheen mittaltelin vahare hen lifne baalehen uvechezkatan. veyatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot. veyatzu shetarot sheen gufan mamon: 
Echad hannishba achar shettevao baal hammamon. o hannishba meatzmo af al pi shello tevao. ketzad. kegon shekkadam veamar lamma atta holech acharay kelum yesh lecha beyadi mamon shevua sheen lecha beyadi mamon. hare ze chayyav bishvuat happikkadon hoil vechafar venishba veaf al pi shello tevao ze: 
Echad hannishba levaal hammamon atzmo o lishlucho habba behareshaato. sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto: 
Veeno chayyav bishvuat happikkadon ad sheyyashbio belashon shehu makkirah: 
Hannishba shevuat happikkadon bemezid af al pi shennishba lashsheker vehitru bo edim bishat shevuato eno loke ella mevi ashamo bilvad. shehare hakkatuv motzio mikkelal chayyave malkot vechiyyevo asham ben bezadon ben bishgaga kemo shebbearnu: 
Kafar venishba arba o chamesh peamim. o shehishbio hattovea arba vechamesh peamim vehu kofer al kol achat veachat ben bevet din ben shello bevet din hare ze chayyav karban asham al kol shevua ushevua. sheillu hoda achar shekkafar haya chayyav leshallem af al pi shekkafar bevet din venimtza poter atzmo bechol kefira uchefira min hattashlumin. lefichach chayyav al kol shevua ushevua: 
Hayu chamishsha tovin oto veomrin lo ten lanu pikkadon sheyyesh lanu beyadcha. shevua sheen lachem beyadi eno chayyav ella karban echad. shevua sheen lecha beyadi lo lecha velo lecha velo lecha chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Amar lo chavero ten li pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda sheyyesh li beyadcha. shevua sheen lecha beyadi eno chayyav ella achat. vaafillu haya lo peruta achat mikkullan hare ellu mitztarfin vechayyav: 
Shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon tesumet yad gezel vaaveda chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Ten li chittim useorim vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha. shevua sheen lecha beyadi eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittim useorin vechussemin chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Hayu chamishsha tovin oto veomrin lo ten lanu pikkadon gezel vaaveda utesumet yad sheyyesh lanu beyadcha. veamar laechad mehen shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon vegezel vaaveda utesumet yad velo lecha velo lecha velo lecha hare ze chayyav al kol taana vetaana lechol echad veechad venimtza ze chayyav esrim asham: 
Taan sheavad happikkadon o kafar bo venishba veachar kach hoda. vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda. meshallem hakkeren harishon vechomesh echad al kol shevua ushevua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 24)</small> "vachamishitav". hattora ribbeta chomashin harebe al keren echad. ketzad. haya hakkeren arbaa vechafar venishba vehoda vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vehoda meshallem shiva. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Pachot mipperuta eno mamon lefichach hattovea chavero befachot mipperuta o befachot mishsheve peruta vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 8: Haggonnev shoro shel chavero utevacho o mecharo. tevao baal hashshor veamar lo ganavta shori vetavachta o macharta vehu omer ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti venishba hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda meatzmo shettavach o machar lo haya meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha mippene shehu kenas kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot geneva. venimtza ze kemo shello kafar mamon ulefichach patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker shello tavach vehu tavach:

Vechen haomer lachavero hemit shorcha et avdi vechafar venishba vehaeved shettava rabbo veamar hippalta shinni vesimmeta eni vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda lo haya meshallem mippene shehu kenas. aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hattovea et chavero bedavar sheyyesh bo kenas sheeno meshallem oto al pi atzmo kemo shebbearnu. veyesh bo mamon shehu meshallem oto al pi atzmo. vechafar bechol davar venishba hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat happikkadon. ketzad. tevao veamar lo anasta o pittita bitti vehu amar lo anasti velo pitteti venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon. sheaf al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo illu hoda haya meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo. vechen haomer lachavero ganavta shori vehu omer lo ganavti venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon sheaf al pi sheeno meshallem kefel behodaato meshallem hu et hakkeren behodaato:
Haomer lachavero asita bi chabbura vehu omer lo asiti. hemit shorcha et shori vehu omer lo hemit venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon sheillu hoda haya chayyav leshallem:

Natan shoro leshomer chinnam umet hashshor. tevao veamar lo hechan shori shehifkadti etzlecha amar lo lo hifkadta etzli kelum o sheamar lo hifkadta venignav o avad venishba hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda veamar haddavar keshehaya lo haya chayyav leshallem mamon mippene shehu shomer chinnam. aval chayyav hu mishshum shevuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hishil shoro lachavero utevao veamar lo hechan shori sheshshaalta mimmenni vahare hashshor met. veamar lo hashshoel nignav o avad venishba al ze hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare lo patar atzmo min hattashlumin bichfirato. umikkol makom chayyav hu leshallem ben met o nignav o avad o nishba mippene shehu shoel kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. aval chayyav hu mishshum shevuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ze hakkelal kol sheeno poter atzmo min hattashlumin ella bichfira zo venishba ben mippi atzmo ben shehishbio hattovea vechafar hare ze chayyav bishvuat happikkadon af al pi shello ana amen velo hotzi shevua mippiv:

Haggonev shor chavero utevao veamar lo shori ganavta vehu omer lo ganavti. ma tivo etzlecha atta hifkadto etzli venishba. chayyav bishvuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda sheggenavo haya chayyav leshallem deme hashshor mikkol makom veachshav sheamar pikkadon hu hare patar atzmo bichfira zo min haggeneva umin haaveda sheim nignav hashshor o avad achar hodaa zo haya patur milleshallem:

Vechen im taan shessecharo venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo min hashshevura umin hammita. vechen im taan veamar hishalto li venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo min hammita bishat hammelacha kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot hashsheela:

Lefichach im amar lo ganavti aval atta hifkadto etzli o sechartani leshamro o hishaltihu li vahare shorcha lefanecha kachehu venishba al ze hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare hoda bakkeren velo patar atzmo bichfira zo mikkelum:

Vechen im amar lo atta mecharto li vaadayin lo natatti damav im tirtze kach damav o hare shellecha lefanecha. o sheamar lo atta netatto li bischar melacha sheeese lecha im tirtze sheeese lecha o kachennu valech. toe badderech metzativ velo yadati shehu shellecha achshav sheyyadati kachennu valech. o sheamar achar parati ratz vahare hu lefanecha. venishba al kol taana meellu patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare lo patar atzmo mikkelum. vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker:

Mi shehaya chayyav mamon lishne shuttafin utevao echad mehen vechafar bo venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare kafar mamon. tevauhu shenehem vehoda bakkol leechad mehem veamar lo laviti ella mizze levaddo venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare lo patar atzmo mikkelum. aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy:
