Vechen mi shehayta alav milve bishtar vechafar bah venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare bishtar nishtabed hakkarka venimtza ze kechofer bekarka. uchevar bearnu shehakkofer bekarka patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker:

Hayta alav milve beedim bilvad vechafar venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo bichfirato milleshallem atta. veaf al pi shekkesheyyavou haedim yitchayyev leshallem venimtza shello hoila lo kefirato. hare hoila beittah veshemma lo yavou haedim o yavou velo titkayyem edutan o yippaslu ulefichach chayyav:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 9:
Hattovea edav lehaid lo edut sheyyitchayyev hannitba beedutan levaddah litten letovea ze mamon hammittaltel. vechafru beedutan venishbeu. ben shennishbeu bevet din ben shennishbeu chutz levet din hare ellu chayyavin mishshum shevuat haedut. shehare hifsiduhu mamon bichfiratam. vechen im hishbiam hattovea vechafru bo af al pi shello nishbeu hen velo anu amen achar shevuato kevan shekkafru hare ellu chayyavin. vehu sheyyashbiem bevet din: 
En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu beedutan bevet din. ben shennishbeu o hishbian bevet din ben shennishbeu o hishbian chutz levet din. vehakkefira bevet din bilvad. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "im lo yaggid venasa avono" makom sheyyaggid veyoil hu sheim lo yaggid sham yitchayyev: 
Tevaan beedut sheenah mechayyevet mamon o beedut karkaot o avadim o shetarot vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheen chayyavin ella al kefirat edut mamon sheddoma lefikkadon utesumet yad vegezel vaaveda sheppertan hakkatuv bapparasha shehen mittaltelin sheggufan mamon uchesheyyaidu laze yitten ze: 
Vechen hammashbia ede kenas vechafru peturin mishshevuat haedut. mippene sheim kadam hannitba vehoda biknas yippater milleshallem veaf al pi shebbau haedim achar ken veheidu. nimtzeu haedim lo chiyyevu ze beedutan levaddah ella edutan im kefirat hannitba hi hamechayyevet otan vehoil veim hoda lo toil edutan im kafru bah venishbeu peturin: 
Mashbiachem ani shettavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechafru. chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene hakkeren shehu mamon lo mippene hakkefel shehu kenas. vechen im hishbiam sheyyaidu lo sheanas peloni o pitta bitto vechafru chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene habboshet vehappegam sheim hoda bahem hannitba meshallem lo mippene hakkenas. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu veyishshavu achar teviat baal din atzmo o shelucho. aval im kadmu venishbeu kodem sheyyitbaem peturin mishshevuat haedut: 
Ketzad. rau hattovea holech acharehen amru lo lamma atta ba acharenu shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut mippene shello tevaan hattovea ella hem kadmu venishbeu bitviat atzman. vechen im hishbiam hannitba sheim tedu laze shettovea oto edut shettavou vetaidu lo vechafru hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut ad sheyyashbiem hattovea. veen tzarich lomar im hishbiam sheyyavou veyaidu sheyyesh lifloni beyad peloni mamon vechafru shehen peturin sheen ze hattovea baal din atzmo. vechen im kadma shevua laedut hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "veshama kol ala vehu ed". shekkadma edut lishvua lo shekkadma shevua leedut: 
Ketzad. mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut shettavou uteiduni veamru amen veyadu lo edut achar ken utevaam lehaid vechafru bo hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut: 
En haedim chayyavim bishvuat haedut ad sheyyeyached otam hattovea veyashbiem o yishshavu. ketzad. amad bevet hakkeneset veamar mashbia ani kol mi sheyyeda li edut sheyyavo veyaid li veanu kullam amen veedav bichlalam veachar kach tava edav vechafru bo hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut. mippene shello yiched edav bishvua bifne atzman. aval im amar mashbia ani kol haomdim kan sheim yedu li edut sheyyavou veyaidu li vehayu edav bichlalam vechafru hare ellu chayyavin bishvuat haedut shehare yichadam bichlal acherim: 
Vechen im amar laedim bou vehaidu li sheyyesh li mane beyad peloni. veachar kach amad bevet hakkeneset vehishbia kol mi sheyyodea lo edut yavo veyaid velo bau velo heidu hare ellu chayyavin. shehare tevaan techilla. vehu sheyyihyu az bevet hakkeneset veyihye sham bet din. aval im lo hayu bifne bet din im anu amen chayyavin bishvuat haedut kesheyyichperu beedutan bevet din veim lo anu amen enan chayyavin: 
Echad hammashbia edav bishvua. o sheamar lahen metzavve ani alechem bishvua oserchem ani bishvua hare ellu chayyavin. vehu sheyyashbiem beshem o bechinnuy min hakkinnuyim kemo shebbearnu: 
Veen haedim chayyavin ad sheyyashbiem belashon shehem makkirin otah: 
Hinne lamadta sheen haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ella al pi asara devarim. veellu hen. sheyyitbaem hattovea. veshettihye edut mamon. vesheyyihye mamon hammittaltel. vesheyyitchayyev hannitba leshallem beedutan levad im heidu. vesheyyichperu achar shettevaan hattovea. vesheyyichperu bevet din. veshettihye sham shevua beshem o bechinnuy. veshettikdam yediat haedut lashshevua. vesheyyeyached edav beet hashshevua o beet hattevia. veshettihye hashshevua belashon shehen makkirin otah: 
Kol makom sheamarnu patur. patur mishshevuat haedut aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy vehu shennishba o sheana amen im hishbio acher shehare nishba al sheker. aval hamechuyyav bishvuat haedut af al pi shehu nishba al sheker veaf al pi shehu mezid eno chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy ella mishshum shevuat haedut bilvad. shehare hakkatuv hotzi shevuat haedut mikkelal shevuat bittuy lechayyev hammezid bah keshogeg bekarban aval lo bemalkot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 4 5)</small> "leachat meelle". bemin echad mimmine shevuot atta mechayyev hannishba vei atta mechayyevo bishne minin ad sheyyihye chayyav bedin shevuat haedut uvedin shevuat bittuy: 
Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut enan chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda chayyavin al kol achat veachat: 
Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni chittim useorim vechussemin. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut enam chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodim lecha edut sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni chittim useorim vechussemin chayyavin al kol achat veachat: 
Vechen im tavu otan rabbim lehaid lahem veamru shevua sheen anu yodin lachem edut enan chayyavin ella achat. lo lecha velo lecha velo lecha chayyavin al kol achat veachat kederech shebbearnu bishvuot happikkadon: 
Hannishba lachavero shehu yodea lo edut venimtza sheeno yodea lo edut hare ze patur veen kan lo shevuat haedut velo shevuat bittuy. mippene sheshshevuat bittuy enah ella bedavar sheyyesh bo lav vehen. veim yomar shevua sheeni yodea lecha edut en ze shevuat bittuy ella shevuat haedut. hoil velav ze sheyyesh bah enah shevuat bittuy. kach hen shebbah shehu hannishba sheyyodea lo edut eno shevuat bittuy: 
Davar barur hu shehannishba lachavero sheheid lo vehu lo heid o shello heid lo vehu heid hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy veen kan shevuat edut kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 10:
Hayu edav o echad mehen pasul o karov vaafillu mippesule edut shel divrehem. o shehaya hammelech echad meedav sheeno rauy lehaid. o shehayu ed mippi ed vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheillu (hodu) heidu lo hayu mechayyevin beedutan mamon: 
Mashbia ani alechem shettavou vetaidu li sheamar ish peloni sheyyitten li matayim zuz velo natan vechafru hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheim heidu bedavar ze lo yitchayyev hannitba mamon baamirato. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Tevaan lehaid lo shehu kohen o levi o sheeno ben gerusha o ben chalutza vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheen kan edut mamon: 
Tevaan sheyyaidu lo shechaval bo beno veshehidlik peloni gedisho beshabbat vesheanas peloni o pitta bitto hameorasa vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheim heidu edut zo yitchayyev hannitba mitat bet din veeno chayyav tashlumin kemo shebbearnu behilchot naara. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haya ed echad vechafar vehishbio patur mishshevuat haedut sheen edut ed echad mechayyevet mamon: 
Tava et shene edav sheyyaidu lo shezzinneta ishto vechafru venishbeu hare ellu chayyavin bishvuat haedut. sheillu heidu hayu mafsidin lah ketubbatah veyippater ze shettevaan vahare kafru beedut mamon: 
Tava ede kinnuy o ede setira vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheillu heidu en chiyyuv mamon kan ella lehashekotah bilvad. veaf al pi sheedut zo goremet lah shettafsid ketubbatah im lo tishte davar sheggorem lemamon eno kemamon shehare efshar shettishte velo tishbor ketubbatah: 
Hare shekkinne leishto venistera beedim vezanta beed echad achar hakkinnuy vehassetira vehishbia ed ze sheyyavo veyaid vechafar chayyav bishvuat haedut sheaf al pi shehu ed echad illu heid edut zo hayta yotza belo ketubba kemo shebbearnu behilchot sota: 
Vechen kol ed echad shemmechayyev mamon beeduto im kafar venishba o shehishbio bevet din vechafar chayyav mishshum shevuat haedut: 
Ketzad. kegon shehaya hattovea vehannitba chashudin al hashshevua sheen mashbiin otam vehishbia leed echad sheyyavo veyaid lo sheyyesh lo beyad ze mane vechafar hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat haedut sheillu heid haya hannitba hazze meshallem mamon beeduto kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haishsha shehishbia ed echad sheyyaid lah bemitat balah vechafar chayyav bishvuat haedut sheillu heid hayta nisset venotelet ketubbatah: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya lah ligbot ketubbatah min hammittaltelin. aval im en lah ligbot ketubbatah ella min hakkarka hare ze patur mishshevuat haedut. vechen im hayu shenayim. shehammashbia ede karka peturin kemo shebbearnu: 
Hishbia edav bevet din vechafru shenehem keachat kegon shehitchil hashsheni lichpor betoch kede dibburo shel chavero shenehem chayyavin bishvuat haedut vechol echad veechad mevi chattato al shevuato. kafar harishon veshaha haed hashsheni yoter mikkede dibbur veachar kach kafar. harishon chayyav bishvuat haedut vehashsheni patur mishshevuat haedut. sheillu hoda ze hashsheni lo hayta eduto mechayyevet mamon: 
Hoda echad vechafar echad hakkofer chayyav ben shekkafar battechilla ben shekkafar bassof. kafru shenehem keachad vekadam haechad vehoda betoch kede dibbur hare ze patur vehaomed bichfirato chayyav bishvuat haedut: 
Hishbia shete kitte edim ushetehen reuyot lehaid. vechafra kat rishona veachar kach kafra kat sheniyya. harishona petura mishshevuat haedut mippene shehen somchin al edut sheniyya veefshar lehotzi hammamon beedut hakkat haacheret venimtza ze hannitba eno chayyav leshallem beedut ellu shekkafru levaddah. hayta hakkat hashsheniyya kerovin lattovea o lannitba binshotehen vahare hen gossot af harishona chayyevet. shehare hashsheniyya beet kefirat harishona lo hayta reuya lehaid veaf al pi shebbimhera yihyu reuyin kesheyyamutu ellu haggossot. veim kafra hashsheniyya achare shemmetu neshotehen chayyavin bishvuat haedut: 
Hattovea et haedim lehaid lo vechafru vehishbian veanu amen vehishbian arba vechamesh peamim vehen onin achar kol shevua ushevua chutz levet din ucheshebbau levet din hodu veheidu hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut kemo shebbearnu. veim bau levet din veamdu bichfiratan chayyavin al kol achat veachat meotan hashshevuot shechutz levet din: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheanu amen. aval im lo anu amen ella kafru al kol shevua ushevua hoil velo hotziu shevua mippihem velo anu amen hare ellu peturim ad sheyyashbiem bevet din veyichperu bo sham kemo shebbearnu: 
Hishbian bevet din vechafru vechazar vehishbian arba vechamesh peamim vehen kofrin al kol achat veachat ben chutz levet din ben bifne bet din vaafillu anu amen o nishbeu mippi atzman paam achar paam enan chayyavin mishshum shevuat haedut ella achat mippene sheachar shekkafru bevet din im chazru vehodu en edutan moelet kelum: 
Nimtzeta lamed shekkol hashshevuot shennishbeu achar shekkafru bevet din hen al kefirat edut sheenah mechayyevet mamon shehen peturin aleha mishshevuat haedut vechayyavin bishvuat bittuy kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 11:
Keshem sheshshevuat shav vesheker belo taase. kach mitzvat ase sheyyishshava mi shennitchayyev shevua bevet din bashshem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 13)</small> <small>(Devarim 10 20)</small> "uvishmo tishshavea" zo mitzvat ase. shehashshevua bishmo haggadol vehakkadosh middarche haavoda hi vehiddur vekiddush gadol hu lehishshava bishmo: 
Veasur lehishshava bedavar acher im shemo. vechol hameshattef davar acher im shem hakkadosh baruch hu bishvua neekar min haolam. sheen sham mi sherauy lachlok lo chavod shennishbain bishmo ella haechad baruch hu: 
Umuttar leadam lehishshava al hammitzva laasotah kede lezarez et atzmo veaf al pi shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 119 106)</small> "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha": 
Shevua zo shemmashbiin haddayyanim lemi shennitchayyev shevua hi hannikret shevuat haddayyanin. ben shehaya chayyav bishvua zo min hattora ben shehaya chayyav bah middivre sofrim: 
Shelosha mine shevuot hen shechayyavin bahen min hattora. veellu hen. mi shetteano chavero mittaltelin vehoda bemiktzatan vechafar bemiktzatan. umi shekkafar bechol hammittaltelin shetteano veed echad meid alav umachchisho hare ellu shete shevuot al yede taanat vadday uchefira. vechen shomer shettoen sheavad davar shehifkidu etzlo o nignav o met vechayyotze baze hare ze nishba missafek. sheen baal happikkadon yodea im emet toen ze hashshomer o sheker. vehu nishba min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem": 
Kol shevua shemmashbiin otah haddayyanin chutz mishshelosha mine shevuot ellu hare hi middivre sofrim vegam hi hannikret shevuat haddayyanin. vegam shevuot ellu middivrehem shene mine shevuot hen. yesh mehen shevuot al yede taanat vadday uchefira kegon shevuat sachir ufogem shetaro vechayyotze bahen. veyesh mehen shevuot betaanat safek kegon shevuat hashshuttafin vehaarisin vechayyotze bahen. uvedine mamonot yitbaer chiyyuv kol achat veachat meellu hashshevuot vedinehem: 
Veyesh sham shevua acheret vehi takkanat chachme haggemara vehi hannikret shevuat hesset. veaf al pi shebbet din mashbiin otah [hayyom] enah nikret shevuat haddayyanin: 
Ushevuat haddayyanin ben shehayta shel tora o shel divre sofrim ben al taanat vadday ben al taanat safek kach hi. hannishba ochez sefer tora bizroo vehu omed venishba beshem o bechinnuy bishvua o beala mippiv o mippi haddayyanin. vehoru rabbotay sheen mashbiin shevuat haddayyanin ella bilshon hakkodesh: 
Ketzad mippiv. kegon sheyyomar hareni nishba baAdonai elohe yisrael o bemi sheshshemo channun o bemi sheshshemo rachum sheeni chayyav laze kelum. vechen im amar hare hu arur laAdonai o arur lemi sheshshemo channun im yesh laze etzli kelum: 
Vechetzad mippi haddayyanin. kegon sheamru lo mashbiin anu otcha baAdonai elohe yisrael o bemi sheshshemo channun sheen laze beyadcha kelum vehu one amen. o sheamru hare peloni ben peloni arur laAdonai elohe yisrael o lemi sheshshemo channun im yesh lifloni etzlo mamon velo yode lo vehu one amen zo hi shevuat haddayyanin: 
Haddayyanin shehishbiu belo nekitat chefetz beyado hare ellu toim. vechozer venishba vesefer tora beyado. veim achaz tefillin beyado vehishbiuhu eno chozer venishba shehare achaz tora beyado uchemo sefer hen. hishbiuhu meyushshav eno chozer venishba: 
Talmid chacham lechattechilla mashbiin oto meyushshav utefillin beyado veeno tzarich littol sefer tora ella tefillin bechappo chefetz hu venishba bilshon hakkodesh kemo shebbearnu: 
En ben shevuat hesset lishvuat haddayyanin ella nekitat chefetz. sheen hannishba shevuat hesset ochez sefer tora ella mashbiin oto beshem o bechinnuy bishvua o beala mippiv o mippi bet din kemo shevuat haddayyanin. uchevar nahagu hakkol lihyot sefer tora beyad chazzan hakkeneset o shear haam beet shemmashbiin shevuat hesset kede leayyem alav: 
Haddayyanin shehishbiu et hannishba bechol lashon shehu makkir hare zo kemitzvatah vechen horu haggeonim. aval rabbotenu horu sheen mashbiim ella bilshon hakkodesh. veen rauy lismoch al horaa zo. veaf al pi shennahagu bechol batte dinin lehishshava bilshon hakkodesh tzarich lehodia et hannishba ad sheyyehe makkir leshon hashshevua. sheshshevuat haddayyanin hi shevuat happikkadon beatzmah. veaf shevuat hesset nahagu kol haam lehashebia otah bilshon hakkodesh: 
Kol mi sheyyitchayyev shevuat haddayyanin shehi al yede taanat vadday uchefira ben shehayta middivre tora ben shehayta middivrehem meayyemin alav kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol mi sheyyitchayyev bah betaanat safek ben min hattora ben middivrehem eno tzarich iyyum: 
Vechetzad meayyemin al hannishba. omrin lo heve yodea shekkol haolam kullo nizdaazea beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav. vechol averot shebbattora neemar bahen venakke vechan neemar <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "lo yenakke". kol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto shemmechappin al ze. velo od ella gorem lehippara missonehem shel yisrael shekkol yisrael arevin ze baze shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 4 2)</small> "alo vechachesh veratzoach" vegomer vechatuv acharav <small>(Hoshea 4 3)</small> "al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah". kol averot shebbattora tolin lo shenayim ushelosha dorot im yesh lo zechut vechan nifrain miyyad shenneemar <small>(Zecharya 5 4)</small> "hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot uvaa el bet haggannav veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker". hotzetiha miyyad. uvaa el bet haggannav ze haggonev daat habberiyyot veen lo mamon al chavero vetoano bechinnam umashbio. el bet hannishba bishmi lashsheker kemashmao. <small>(Zecharya 5 4)</small> "vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav" devarim sheen esh umayim mechallin otan shevuat sheker mechalla otan: 
Veinyan haiyyum hazze kullo belashon shehen makkirin omrim lahem kede sheyyavinu baddevarim veyachzor hachote lemutav. amar eni nishba potrin oto venoten ma shettaano chavero. vechen im amar hattoen eni mashbio ufetaro holchin lahen: 
Amar hareni nishba vachavero tovea. haomdim sham omrim ze laze <small>(Bamidbar 16 26)</small> "suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim" vegomer. veomrin lo lo al datecha anu mashbiin otcha ella al datenu veal daat bet din: 
Af al pi sheen meayyemin iyyum ze bishvuat taanat safek kemo shebbearnu velo bishvuat hesset. tzerichin haddayyanin liftzor bevaale dinin ulay yachzeru bahen ad shello tihye sham shevua kelal: 
Davar barur vegaluy shekkol hannishba shevuat haddayyanin o shevuat hesset besheker sheyyehe chayyav mishshum shevuat happikkadon shekkevar nitbaaru mishpateha veeno loke veaf al pi shehu mezid venitchayyev leshallem ma shennishba alav betosefet chomesh shehu revia hakkeren ad sheyyihye hu vechumsho chamishsha. umevi karban asham im yesh sham bet (din) kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 12:
Af al pi shelloke hannishibba lashshav o lashsheker vechen hannishba shevuat haedut o shevuat happikkadon mevi karban. en mitkapper lahen avon hashshevua kullo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "lo yenakke Adonai" en laze nikkayon middin shamayim ad sheyyitpara mimmennu al hashshem haggadol shechillel. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "vechillalta et shem Adonai elohecha ani Adonai". lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher meavon ze yoter mikkol haaverot: 
Avon ze min hachamurot hu kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva. af al pi sheen bo lo karet velo mitat bet din yesh bo chillul hashshem hamekuddash shehu gadol mikkol haavonot: 
Mi shennishba bashshamayim uvaaretz uvashshemesh vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen kavvanato ella lemi shebberaam en zo shevua. vechen hannishba benavi min hanneviim o bichtav mikkitve hakkodesh af al pi sheen kavvanato ella lemi sheshshalach navi ze o lemi shetztzivva bichtav ze en zo shevua. veaf al pi sheen ellu shevuot meayyemin alehen umelammedin et haam shello yinhagu kallut rosh bechach umarin beenehem shezzo shevua. ufotchin lahem petach umattirin lahem: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishar kitve hakkodesh. aval hannishba battora. im nishba bema shekkatuv bah dato al hahazkarot. veim nishba bah setam dato al haggevil veen kan shevua. netalah beyado venishba bah hare ze kemi shennishba bema shekkatuv bah veasur: 
Vehannishba battora setam im talmid chacham hu eno tzarich sheela lechacham. veim am haaretz hu tzarich sheela lechacham kede shello yinhag kallut rosh bishvuot: 
Eved shennishba en rabbo tzarich lichpoto. vahare hu achar shennishba kekodem shennishba. lefi sheen gufo kanuy lo kede shettachul alav shevuato veneemar bishvuot <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lesor issar al nafsho" mi shennafsho birshuto yatza eved shehu birshut acherim. venimtza ze kemo shennishba al nichse acher: 
Ketannim shennishbeu vehen yodin taam hashshevua af al pi sheenan chayyavin. kofin otan laamod bedivrehen. kede lechannechan uleayyem alehem kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bishvuot. veim haya haddavar shennishbeu alav davar sheen hakkatan yachol laamod bo ella im ken nizzak. kegon shennishba sheyyatzum o shello yochal basar zeman merubbe. makke oto aviv o rabbo vegoer bo umarin lo shehuttera shevuato kede shello yihye ragil lehakel rosh bishvuot: 
Tzarich lehizzaher bakketannim harebe ulelammed leshonam divre emet belo shevua kede shello yihyu regilim lehishshava tamid keakkum. veze haddavar kemo chova al avotehem veal melammede tinokot: 
Hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero lashshav o shennishba lefanav lashsheker o shebberech beracha sheenah tzericha shehu over mishshum nose shem Adonai lashshav kemo shebbearnu behilchot berachot hare ze chayyav lenaddoto. veim lo niddahu hu beatzmo yehe benidduy. vetzarich lehattir oto miyyad kede shello yehe michshol laacherim shehare eno yodea shennidduhu. veim tomar yodio nimtzeu kol haolam benidduy shehare limdu leshonam haave ushevua tamid: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hannishba hazze o hamevarech levattala mezid. aval im haya shogeg velo yada shezze asur eno chayyav lenaddoto. vaani omer sheasur lenaddoto shello anash hakkatuv shogeg ella mazhiro umatre bo shello yachzor: 
Velo shevua lashshav bilvad hi sheasura ella afillu lehazekir shem min hashshemot hameyuchadin levattala asur veaf al pi shello nishba. shehare hakkatuv metzavve veomer <small>(Devarim 28 58)</small> "leyira et hashshem hannichbad vehannora". uvichlal yirato shello yazkiro levattala. lefichach im taa hallashon vehotzi shem levattala yemaher miyyad vishabbeach vifaer vihadder lo kede shello yizzacher levattala. ketzad. amar Adonai, omer baruch hu leolam vaed o gadol hu umehullal meod vechayyotze baze, kede shello yehe levattala: 
Af al pi shemmuttar lehishshael al hashshevua kemo shebbearnu veen baze dofi. umi shellibbo nokfo bedavar ze eno ella shemetz minut. af al pi chen rauy lehizzaher bedavar ze. veen nizkakin lehattir ella mippene devar mitzva o mippene tzorech gadol. vetova gedola hi leadam shello yishshava kelal. veim avar venishba sheyyitztaer vayyaamod bishvuato shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 15 4)</small> "nishba lehara velo yamir" vechatuv acharav <small>(Tehillim 15 5)</small> "ose elle lo yimmot leolam": seliku lehu hilchot shevuot besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Vows 1: Hanneder nechlak lishte machalokot. hachelek harishon hu sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim lo kegon sheyyomar perot medina pelonit asurin alay kol sheloshim yom o leolam. o min peloni mipperot haolam o perot ellu asurin alay. bechol lashon sheyyeesor hare ze neesar bahen. veaf al pi sheen sham shevua kelal velo hazekarat shem velo kinnuy. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lesor issar al nafsho". sheyyeesor al atzmo devarim hammuttarim. vechen im amar hare hen alay issar hare ellu asurin vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre issar:

Vehachelek hashsheni hu sheyyechayyev atzmo bekarban sheeno chayyav bo. kegon sheyyomar hare alay lehavi ola. o hare alay lehavi shelamim o mincha. hare behema zo ola o shelamim. vehaomer [hare] alay hu hannikra neder. vehaomer hare zo hu hannikra nedava. vehannedava vehanneder mimmin echad hu ella shehannedarim chayyavin beacharayutan unedavot en chayyavin beacharayutan. veal ze neemar battora <small>(Devarim 12 17)</small> "unedarecha asher tiddor venidvotecha" vegomer. vechelek ze hu sheani kore oto nidre hekdesh:
Vedine hachelek harishon veinyano hem sheanu mevaarim bahalachot ellu. aval dine nidre hekdesh umishpetehem kullam yitbaaru bimkomam behilchot maase hakkarbanot:

Mitzvat ase shel tora sheyyekayyem adam shevuato o nidro ben shehaya minnidre issar ben shehaya minnidre hekdesh. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 24)</small> "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta" veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase":

Haoser al atzmo min mimmine maachol kegon sheamar teenim asurin alay o teenim shel medina pelonit asurim alay o teenim ellu asurin alay vechayyotze beellu veachal mehen kol shehu loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro". sheen lindarim shiur. shekkol hannoder middavar hare ze kimfaresh kol shehu. amar achila mipperot medina pelonit asurin alay o achila mipperot ellu eno loke ad sheyyochal kezayit:
Asar al atzmo achila min hatteenim vaachila min haanavim ben beneder echad ben bishne nedarim hare ellu mitztarfin lichzayit. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer perot ellu alay karban o sheamar hare hem kekarban o sheamar lachavero kol ma sheochal immecha alay karban o kekarban o hare hen alay karban. hare ellu asurin alav mippene sheefshar sheyyiddor adam karban veyaase behema shehayta chol karban veteaser:

Aval haomer perot ellu alay o min peloni alay o ma sheochal im peloni alay kivsar chazir o keakkum o kinvelot uterefot vechayyotze beellu hare ellu muttarin veen kan neder. shei efshar sheyyaase davar sheeno besar chazir kivsar chazir:
Ze hakkelal kol hammesim devarim hammuttarim kaddevarim haasurim im oto davar haasur yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu asurim. veim eno yachol laasoto beneder hare ellu muttarin:

Hachattat vehaasham af al pi sheenan bain beneder unedava kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo efshar lannoder lehavi otam mechamat nidro. shehannoder benazir mevi chattat veim nitma mevi asham kemo sheyyitbaer. lefichach haomer perot ellu alay kechattat o keasham o sheamar hare hen chattat o hare hen asham hare ellu asurin. veen tzarich lomar beomer hare hen ola o shelamim o mincha o toda shehen asurin shekkol ellu bain beneder unedava:
Aval haomer perot ellu alay kechallat aharon o kitrumato hare ellu muttarin sheen sham derech lehavi ellu beneder unedava:
Haomer hare happerot haellu alay kenotar kefiggul kevasar tame shel kadashim hare ellu asurin shehare asaan kivsar karban mikkol makom:

Haomer hare hen alay kemaasar behema hare ellu asurin hoil ukedushshato bide adam. hare hen alay kivchor hare ellu muttarin sheen kedushshato bide adam veeno yachol lehatepiso beneder shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 27 26)</small> "lo yakdish ish oto":

Amar hare hen alay kecherme shamayim hare ellu asurin. shecherme shamayim levedek habbayit. hare hen alay kitrumat hallishka kitmidim kedirim keetzim keishshim kemizbeach o keachad mimmeshammeshe hammizbeach. kegon sheamar hare hen alay keyaim kemizrakot kemizlagot vechayyotze bahen. vechen haomer hare hen alay kehechol kirushalayim hare ellu asurin. veaf al pi shello hazekir shem karban. shekkol devarim ellu inyanam keomer hare hen alay karban:

Haya lefanav besar kodesh afillu haya besar shelamim achar zerikat damim shehu muttar lazzarim veamar hare hen alay kevasar ze hare ellu asurin. shello hitpis ella beikkaro shehaya asur. aval im haya besar bechor im lifne zerikat damim hare ze asur veim leachor zerikat damim hare ze muttar:

Yesh mekomot sheanshehem illegim umafsidin et hallashon umechannin al davar bedavar acher holchin sham achar hakkinnuy. ketzad kol kinnuye karban kekarban. haomer hare hen alay konam konach konaz hare ellu kinnuyin lekarban. cherek cheref cherech hare ellu kinnuyin lecherem. vechen kol kayyotze baze holchin achar leshon kelal haam beoto makom uveoto zeman:
Ucheshem sheoser atzmo bechinnuyin kach im hikdish bechinnuyin hare ze hekdesh. vechinnuye hakkinnuyin muttarin ben benidre issar ben benidre hekdesh:

Haomer lachavero ma sheochal immecha lo yehe chullin o lo yehe kasher o lo yehe dechi o lo yehe tahor hare ze kemi sheamar lo kol ma sheochal immecha yehe karban shehu asur. vechen im amar lo kol ma sheochal immecha tame o notar o piggul hare ze asur:

Haomer lachavero lo chullin lo ochal lecha hare ze kemi sheamar lo ma sheochal lecha lo yehe chullin ella karban. vechen im amar hakarban sheochal lecha karban sheochal lecha kekarban sheochal lecha hare ze asur. aval haomer hakkarban lo ochal lecha o kekarban lo ochal lecha o lekarban lo ochal lecha o karban lo ochal lecha o lo karban lo ochal lecha kol ellu muttarim. sheen mashma devarim ellu ella shennishba bekarban shello yochal laze vehannishba bekarban eno kelum o shennadar shello yochal lo karban:
Chullin sheochal lecha hachullin sheochal lecha kechullin sheochal lecha chullin shello ochal lecha hachullin shello ochal lecha kechullin shello ochal lecha hare ze muttar:
Aval haomer lo tame sheochal lecha lo notar sheochal lecha lo piggul sheochal lecha asur. shemmashmao shel davar davar sheochal hu sheyyihye piggul o tame lefichach lo ochal lecha:

Bahechol sheochal lecha hechol sheochal lecha lo hechol sheochal lecha asur. hechol shello ochal lecha kehechol shello ochal lecha lo hechol shello ochal lecha muttar. shezze kemi shennishba bahechol shello yochal. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haomer lachavero muddar ani mimmecha mashma davar ze shello yedabber immo. mufrash ani mimmecha mashmao shello yissa veyitten immo. meruchak ani mimmecha mashmao shello yeshev bearba ammotav. vechen im amar lo menudde ani lecha o meshammatna mimmecha. aval im amar lo muddar ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha. o mufrash ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha o meruchak ani mimmecha shello ochal lecha hare ze asur leechol. veim achal kezayit mikkol nechasav loke mishshum <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro":
Amar lo menudde ani lecha shello ochal lecha eno ochel lo veim achal eno loke. amar lo nadina mimmecha hare ze asur lehanot:

Haomer lachavero hare alay kenidre reshaim im ochal lecha shemminnidrehem nazir vekarban ushevua veachal chayyav bechullan. vechen haomer hare alay kindavot kesherim shemminnidvotam nazir vekarban hare ze chayyav:

Amar hare alay kenidre reshaim o kindavot kesherim sheochal lecha o im ochal lecha hare ze asur af al pi shello peresh. amar kenidre kesherim lo nitchayyev bichlum sheen hakkesherim nodrim bederech issur vachaas. amar kenidre reshaim hareni vehaya nazir over lefanav chayyav binzirut. kenidre reshaim alay chayyav karban. kenidre reshaim shello ochal mimmennu chayyav bishvua:
Hannoder battora kegon sheamar perot ellu alay kazo lo amar kelum veeno tzarich sheela lechacham. ella im ken haya am haaretz. kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim:
Nadar bema shekkatuv bah hare ze asur shehare katuv bah issar veneder. netalah beyado venadar bah hare ze kemi shennadar bema shekkatuv bah:
Haomer lachavero nashkim venishne perek. alav lehashekim velikrot shezze kemo neder hu veaf al pi shello hotzio bilshon neder:

Haomer leishto hare at alay keimmi o kaachoti o kearla o kechile hakkerem hare ze keomer al happerot hare ellu kivsar chazir. keshem shehu muttar leachlan kemo shebbearnu kach muttar beishto. aval im amar lah hareni muddar mimech hanaya o hanaat tashmishech asura alay hare zo asura alav kemo sheyyitbaer:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 2:
Echad hannoder mippi atzmo o shehiddiro chavero veamar amen o davar sheinyano keinyan amen shehu kabbalat devarim: 
Veen hannoder neesar bedavar sheasar al atzmo ad sheyyotzi bisfatav veyihye piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot. aval hammitkavven lindor benazir venadar bekarban. bekarban venadar benazir. bishvua venadar. o shennitkavven lindor venishba. o shennitkavven lomar teenim veamar anavim. hare ze muttar bishnehem veen kan neder: 
Hannoder al daat acherim hare ze kenishba al daat acherim. vechen hannoder vechazar bo betoch kede dibbur o shemmichu bo betoch kede dibbur vekibbel hare ze muttar. vedin kol ellu haddevarim bindarim kedinan bishvuot: 
Mi shehitna kodem sheyyiddor veamar kol neder sheeddor mikkan vead eser shanim hareni chozer bahen o hare hen betelim vechayyotze baddevarim ellu veachar kach nadar. im haya zocher hattenay beshaa shennadar hare nidro kayyam shehare bittel hattenay beneder ze. veim lo zachar hattenay ella achar shennadar af al pi shekkibbel hattenay belibbo vekiyyemo hare hanneder batel. veaf al pi shello hotzi atta hachazara befiv kevar hikdim hachazara lanneder vehotziah befiv mikkodem. veyesh shemmore lehachemir veomer vehu sheyyizkor hattenay achar shennadar betoch kede dibbur: 
Mi shehikdim et hattenay leshana o leeser veachar kach nadar venizkar beshaa shennadar sheyyesh lo tenay veshachach al e ze davar hitna vechetzad haya hattenay. im amar al daat rishona ani ose en nidro neder shehare bittelo. veim lo amar al daat rishona ani ose kevar bittel hattenay vekiyyem hanneder shehare zachar bishat hanneder sheyyesh sham tenay veaf al pi chen nadar: 
Yesh mehaggeonim sheomrim en kol ellu haddevarim nohagin ella bindarim bilvad lo bishvuot. veyesh mi shemmore sheddin hannedarim vehashshevuot beinyanot ellu echad hem. vechi yesh lo lehakedim tenay lishvuato kederech sheamru bindarim: 
Setam nedarim lehachemir. uferushan yesh bo lehakel ulehachmir. ketzad. haomer hare happerot haellu alay kevasar maliach ucheyen nesech. omrin lo ume haya belibbecha. im peresh veamar kevasar maliach shel karban ucheyayin shennitnassech al hammizbeach haya belibbi hare ze asur. veim amar lo haya belibbi ella tikrovet akkum veyayin shennitnassech lah hare ze muttar. veim nadar setam hare ze asur: 
Vechen haomer hare happerot haellu alay cherem. im kecherem shel bedek habbayit asur. veim kecherme hakkohanim muttar. mippene shehen mamon shellahem veen bah issur. veim setam asur: 
Hare hen alay kemaaser. im kemaasar behema asur mippene shehu karban shehikdisho beyado kemo shebbearnu. veim kemaasar dagan muttar veim setam asur: 
Hare hen alay kitruma. im litrumat hallishka nitkavven hare ze asur. veim litrumat haggoren nitkavven muttar. veim setam asur. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom shemmashma kol echad meellu sham shene inyanot. aval makom sheddarkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme bedek habbayit bilvad veamar sham hare hen alay cherem hare ze asur. vechen im haya darkan sheen korim cherem setam ella lecherme kohanim hare ze muttar. vechen kol kayyotze baze sheen holchin bindarim ella achar leshon anshe oto makom beoto zeman: 
Hannoder becherem veamar lo haya belibbi ella chermo shel yam shehi hammichmoret. nadar bekarban veamar lo haya belibbi ella bekarbenot melachim. amar lachavero hare atzmi alecha karban veamar lo haya belibbi ella leasro beetzem shehinnachti li lihyot noder bo derech sechok. nadar shello tehane lo ishto veamar lo haya belibbi ella ishti rishona sheggerashtiha. vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim shemmashmaan lechol haam issur vehu omer lo nitkavvanti ella lechach ulechach. im haya hannoder talmid chacham hare ze muttar veen tzarich sheela lechacham. veim haya am haaretz marin beenav shezze neder veshehu asur ufotchim lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo. uven shehaya talmid chacham o am haaretz goarin bahen umelammedin otan shello yinhagu minhag ze bindarim velo yihyu nodrin derech sechok vehittul: 
Vechen haomer leishto hare at alay keimmi o haomer perot ellu alay kivsar chazir sheen kan neder kemo shebbearnu. im haya haomer talmid chacham eno tzarich sheela lechacham. veim haya am haaretz tzarich sheela lechacham umarin beenav sheishto asura vesheotan happerot asurin ufotchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim: 
Hahefker af al pi sheeno neder hare hu kemo neder sheasur lo lachzor bo. uma hu hahefker hu sheyyomar adam nechasim ellu hefker lakkol. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot. vechetzad din hahefker. kol hakkodem vezacha bo kanahu leatzmo venaasa shello. vaafillu ze shehifkir dino bo kedin kol adam im kadam vezacha bo kanahu: 
Hammafkir laaniyyim aval lo laashirim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir lakkol kishmitta. vhammafkir avadav haggedolim kanu atzman. vehakketannim kol hakkodem vehechezik bahen zacha kishar hammittaltelin: 
Hammafkir et hakkarka kol hakkodem vehechezik bah zacha. din tora afillu hifkir bifne echad hare ze hefker veniftar min hammaasrot kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. aval middivre sofrim eno hefker ad sheyyafkir bifne shelosha kede sheyyihye echad zoche im ratza vehashshenayim meidim. vehaomer hare ze hefker veze. hare hashsheni sefek hefker veim amar veze kemo ze o sheamar vegam ze hare hitpis hashsheni veyihye hefker vadday: 
Hammafkir et sadehu velo zacha bah adam kol shelosha yamim yachol lachzor bo. achar shelosha yamim eno yachol lachzor bo ella im ken kadam vezacha bah hare hu kezoche min hahefker ben hu ben acher: 
Haomer sade zo mufkeret leyom echad leshabbat achat lechodesh echad leshana achat leshavua echad ad shello zacha bah hu o acher yachol lachzor bo. umishshezzacha bah ben hu ben acher eno yachol lachzor bo. umippene ma yesh lo lachzor kan ad sheyyizku bah mippene shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu sheen adam mafkir lizman katzuv: 
Davar hammufkar shebba echad ushemaro vehaya mabbit bo shello yittelennu adam lo kanahu behabbata ella ad sheyyagbiho im haya mittaltelin o yachazik bakkarka kederech shekkonin hallakochot:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 3: Arbaa devarim yesh ben nedarim lishvuat bittuy. shebbishvuat bittuy en shevua chala al shevua. uvindarim yachul neder al neder. hammatpis bishvua patur uvindarim chayyav. en shevuat bittuy chala ella al divre harshut. unedarim chalot al divre mitzva kedivre harshut. shevuat bittuy chala al davar sheyyesh bo mammash veal davar sheen bo mammash. unedarim enan chalin ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash:
Ketzad yachul neder al neder. haomer hare alay karban im achalti kikkar zo. hare alay karban im ochalenna vaachalah chayyav al kol achat veachat. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ketzad hammatpis bindarim chayyav. shama chavero shennadar veamar vaani kemotcha betoch kede dibbur hare ze asur bema shenneesar bo chavero. shama hashshelishi ze sheamar vaani veamar vaani afillu hayu mea vechol echad mehen omer vaani betoch kede dibburo shel chavero hare kullan asurin:

Vechen haomer habbasar hazze alay asur vechazar veamar afillu achar kamma yamim vehappat hazzot kabbasar hazze hare happat nitpesa veneesra. chazar veamar udevash ze kappat hazzot veyayin ze kidvash ze afillu hen mea kullan asurin:

Hare shemmet aviv o rabbo hayyom venadar sheyyatzum oto hayyom vetzam. uleachar shanim amar hare yom ze alav keyom shemmet bo aviv o rabbo hare ze asur leechol bo kelum shehare hitpis yom ze vaasaro kayyom haasur lo. vechen kol kayyotze beellu:

Ketzad chalim hannedarim al divre mitzva kedivre harshut. haomer hare hammatztza belele happesach asura alav. hare yeshivat hassukka bechag hassukkot asura alav vahare hattefillin asurot bintila alav hare ellu asurin alav. veim achal o yashav o natal loke. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veen tzarich lomar bemi sheamar hare alay karban im ochal matztza belele happesach shehu chayyav bekarban. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Umippene ma nedarim chalim al divre mitzva ushevuot en chalot al divre mitzva. shehannishba oser atzmo al davar shennishba alav. vehannoder oser haddavar hannadur al atzmo. nimtza hannishba levattel mitzva oser atzmo uchevar atzmo mushba mehar sinay veen shevua chala al shevua. vehaoser davar ze beneder ze haddavar hu shenneesar veoto haddavar eno mushba mehar sinay:

Kesheatta mitbonen bakkatuv timtza shehaddevarim marin ken kemo shekkibbelu chachamim mippi hashshemua. shehare omer bishvuat bittuy <small>(Vayikra 5 4)</small> "lehara o lehetiv" bedivre harshut kemo shebbearnu. sheyyochal veyishte hayyom o sheyyatzum vechayyotze bahen. uvindarim hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase" velo chillek ben divre mitzva ledivre harshut:

Hannoder sheyyatzum beshabbat o beyom tov chayyav latzum. shehannedarim chalim al divre mitzva kemo shebbearnu. vechen hannoder sheyyatzum yom rishon o yom shelishi kol yamav ufaga bo yom ze vahare hu yom tov o erev yom hakkippurim hare ze chayyav latzum veen tzarich lomar rosh chodesh. paga bo chanukka ufurim yiddache nidro mippene hayyamim haellu hoil veissur hatztzom bahem middivre sofrim hare hen tzerichin chizzuk veyiddache nidro mippene gezerat chachamim:

Ketzad en hannedarim chalim ella al davar sheyyesh bo mammash. haomer dibburi alecha karban eno asur milledabber immo shehaddibbur en bo mammash. vechen im amar lo dibburi asur alecha en ze keomer perotay asurin alecha o perotay karban alecha shehen asurin alav. lefichach haomer lachavero karban sheeni medabber immecha o sheeni ose immecha o sheeni mehallech immecha. o sheamar karban sheeni yashen sheeni medabber sheeni mehallech. o sheamar leishto karban sheeni meshammeshech en hanneder chal bechol ellu. vahare ze keomer dibburi vehilluchi vaasiyyati veshimmushi karban shehen devarim sheen bahen mammash:

Aval haomer yeaser pi ledibburo veyaday lemaasehen veraglay lehilluchan veenay lishnatan hare hanneder chal alehen. lefichach haomer lachavero karban pi milledabber immecha veyaday millaasot immecha veraglay millehallech immecha hare ze asur. vechen haomer hare alay karban im adabber im peloni o im lo adabber immo veavar al devaro chayyav bekarban. vechen im nadar dibbarti velo dibbarti vechayyotze bahen sheen ellu nidre issar sheanu mevaarin mishpetehem ella nidre hekdesh:

Hannoder bidvarim sheen bahem mammash vaasaran af al pi sheen hanneder chal alehem en morim lo sheyyinhog bahen hetter hoil veasar atzmo bahen uvedato shehanneder chal alehen. ella potchin lo petach mimmakom acher umattirin lo nidro af al pi shello neesar kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bindarim:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 4:
Nidre onasin venidre shegagot venidre havay hare ellu muttarim kederech shebbearnu bishvuot. hare shehiddiruhu haannasin vehammochsin veamru lo nedor lanu shehabbasar asur alecha im yesh immecha davar shechayyav bemeches. venadar veamar hare happat vehabbasar vehayyayin asurin alay hare ze muttar bakkol veaf al pi shehosif al ma shebbikkeshu mimmennu. vechen im bikkeshu mimmennu sheyyiddor shello tehane ishto lo venadar shello tehane lo ishto uvanav veechav kullan muttarin. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Uvechol hannedarim haellu tzarich sheyyitkavven belibbo ledavar hammuttar. kegon sheyyasim belibbo sheyyihyu asurin alav oto hayyom bilvad o otah shaa vechen kayyotze baze vesomech al devarim shebbelibbo hoil vehu anus veeno yachol lehotzi bisfatav venimtza beshaa sheyyiddor lahen en piv velibbo shavin kemo shebbearnu bishvuot: 
Vechen nidre zeruzin muttarin. ketzad. kegon shehiddir chavero sheyyochal etzlo venadar ze shello yochal mippene sheeno rotze lehateriach alav. ben achal ben lo achal shenehen peturin. vechen hammocher shennadar shello yimkor chefetz ze ella besela vehallokeach nadar shello yikkachennu ella beshekel veratzu bishlosha dinarin shenehen peturin. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefi shekkol echad mehem lo gamar belibbo velo nadar ella kede lezarez et chavero velo gamar belibbo: 
Uminnayin sheafilu arbaa mine nedarim ellu shehen muttarim sheasur lo leadam lihyot noder bahen al menat levattelan. talmud lomar <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lo yachel devaro" lo yaase devarav chullin: 
Mi shennadar venicham al nidro hare ze nishal lechacham umattiro. vedin hetter nedarim kedin hetter shevuot sheen mattir ella chacham muvhak o shelosha hedyotot bemakom sheen chacham. uvelashon shemmattirin hashshevua mattirin hanneder. vechen shear hainyanot shepperashnu bishvuot kullan bindarim kederech shehen bishvuot: 
Veen mattirin hanneder ad sheyyachul kishvua: 
Ucheshem shennishalim al nidre haissar umattirin oto. kach nishalim al nidre hekdesh umattirin oto. ben nidre kadshe bedek habbayit ben kadshe mizbeach. veen nishalin al hattemura: 
Ucheshem shehaav o habbaal mefer nidre issar kach mefer nidre hekdeshot haddomin lenidre haissar: 
Mi shennadar veshama chavero veamar vaani veshama shelishi veamar vaani venishal harishon al nidro vehuttar hutteru kullan. nishal haacharon vehuttar haacharon muttar vechullan asurin. nishal hashsheni vehuttar hashsheni veshel acharav muttarin veharishon asur: 
Vechen hammatpis devarim harebe beneder kegon shennadar al happat vehitpis habbasar venishal al happat vehuttar bah huttar habbasar. nishal al habbasar vehuttar bo lo huttar happat: 
Hannishba o hannoder sheeni nehene lechullechem venishal al nidro o al shevuato al echad mehem vehittiro hutteru kullam. shehanneder shehuttar mikkelalo huttar kullo. amar sheeni nehene laze velaze velaze huttar harishon hutteru kullan. huttar acharon haacharon muttar vechullan asurin. sheeni nehene laze laze laze tzerichin petach lechol echad veechad. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Nadar benazir uvekarban uvishvua o shennadar veen yadua bee ze mehen nadar petach echad lechullan: 
Hannoder meanshe hair venishal lechacham shebbair. o shennadar miyyisrael vahare hu nishal lechacham shebbeyisrael hare nidro muttar: 
Haomer perot ellu asurin alay hayyom im elech lemachar lemakom peloni. hare ze asur leachlam hayyom gezera shemma yelech lemachar leoto makom. veim avar vaachalan hayyom vehalach lemachar loke veim lo halach eno loke: 
Amar hare hen asurin lemachar im elech hayyom lemakom peloni hare ze muttar lelech hayyom leoto hammakom veyeasru alav otan happerot lemachar. vechen kol kayyotze baze. mippene sheadam zahir bedavar haasur shello laasoto veeno zahir bitnay sheggorem leesor davar hammuttar: 
Hannoder latzum asara yamim bee ze yom sheyyirtze vehaya mitanne beyom echad mehem vehutzrach lidvar mitzva o mippene kevod adam gadol hare ze ochel uforea yom acher shehare lo kava hayyamim bitchillat hanneder. nadar sheyyatzum hayyom veshachach veachal mashlim latzum. nadar sheyyatzum yom echad o shenayim ucheshehitchil latzum shachach veachal ibbed taanito vechayyav latzum yom acher:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 5:
Reuven sheamar leshimon hareni alecha cherem o hare atta asur bahanayati neesar al shimon sheyyehane biruven. veim avar venehena eno loke shehare lo amar shimon kelum. umuttar liruven lehanot beshimon shehare lo asar atzmo bahanayato: 
Amar leshimon hare atta alay cherem o hareni asur bahanayatcha hare neesar reuven millehanot beshimon veim nehena loke shehare chillel devaro veshimon muttar bahanayat reuven. amar lo hareni alecha cherem veatta alay o hareni asur bahanayatcha veatta asur bahanayati shenehem asurin ze baze. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Reuven sheamar leshimon hare perot peloni asurin alecha. o hare atta asur bahanayat peloni en ze kelum. sheen adam oser chavero bedavar sheeno shello ella im ken ana shimon amen kemo shebbearnu: 
Haomer lachavero kikkari zo asura alecha af al pi shennetanah lo bemattana hare zo asura alav. met venafla lo birushsha o shennetanah lo acher bemattana hare zo mutteret shello amar lo ella kikkari vahare enah atta shello: 
Amar lo perot ellu asurin alecha velo amar lo perotay. af al pi shemmecharan o shemmet venaflu leacher hare ellu asurin alav. shehaoser davar shehu shello al chavero af al pi sheyyatza mershuto hare hu beissuro omed. ella im ken amar nechasay o beti o perotay vechayyotze bilshonot ellu shehare lo asaran ella kol zeman shehen birshuto: 
Haomer livno hare at asur bahanayati. o shennishba shello yehane bo. im met yirashennu. shezze keomer nechasay alecha asurin. asar alav hanayato uferesh ben bechayyay ben bemoti im met lo yirashennu. shezze kemi sheamar lo nechasim ellu asurin alecha: 
Asar beno bahanayato veamar im yihye ben beni ze talmid chacham yikne beni ze nechasay kede lehakenotan livno hare ze muttar. veyihye habben asur benichse haav uven habben muttar bahen im yihye talmid chacham kemo shehitna: 
Ze habben haasur birushshat aviv im natan yerushshat aviv leechav o levanav hare ze muttar. vechen im peraam bechovo o bichtubbat ishto. vetzarich lehodian sheellu nichse avi sheasaran alay. shehannishba shello yehane bo chavero muttar lo lifroa et chovo kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Mi shenneesar alav min mimmine maachol ben beneder ben bishvua venitbashshel im minim acherim o nitarev immahen hare ze muttar bamminim hammuttarim af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam hammin haasur. veim neesar beferot ellu venitarvu baacherim im yesh bahen taam davar haasur asurin veim lav muttarin: 
Ketzad. neesar bevasar o beyayin hare ze muttar leechol marak virakot shennitbashshelu im habbasar veim hayyayin af al pi sheyyesh bahen taam habbasar o taam hayyayin. veeno asur ella baachilat basar bifne atzmo o lishtot yayin bifne atzmo: 
Neesar bevasar ze o beyayin ze venitbashshel im hayyarak. im yesh bayrakot taam basar o taam hayyayin asurin veim lav muttarin. shezze habbasar veze hayyayin naasa kemo besar nevelot ushekatzim vechayyotze bahen. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach haomer basar ze asur alay hare ze asur bo uvammarak shebbo uvattavlin shebbo: 
Nitarev yayin ze sheasaro al atzmo beyayin acher afillu tippa bechavit neesar hakkol. mippene sheyyesh lo lehishshael al nidro naasa kedavar sheyyesh lo mattirin sheeno batel bemino kemo shebbearnu behilchot maachalot asurot: 
Haomer perot haellu karban alay o karban hen lefi. o karban hen al pi. hare ze asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehem. veen tzarich lomar bammashkin hayyotzin mehen: 
Nadar o nishba sheeni ochel otam o sheeni toem otam. im haya davar shezzaro kale kesheyyizzara kegon chitta useora hare ze muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. veim haya haddavar sheen zaro kale baaretz kesheyyizzara kegon betzalim veshumin afillu giddule giddulin asurin. uven kach uven kach mashkin hayyotzin mehen safek. lefichach im shata mehen eno loke: 
Vechen haomer leishto maase yadayich alay karban o karban hen lefi o karban hen al pi. asur bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. sheeni toem sheeni ochel im hayu perot maase yadeha davar shezzaro kale muttar bechillufehen uvegiddulehen. veim haya davar sheen zaro kale afillu giddule giddulin asurin. velamma lo yibbatel haikkar haasur baggiddulin sherabbu alav. shehare hen davar sheyyesh lo mattirin sheeno batel berov kemo shebbearnu: 
Haoser perotav al chavero ben beneder ben bishvua hare giddulehen vechillufehen safek. lefichach chavero asur begiddule perot ellu uvechillufehen. veim avar venehena nehena:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 6:
Haomer lachavero hanaa hammevia lide maachalcha asura alay. o hanaa hammevia lide maachali asura alecha. hare ze hanneesar lo yishal min haasur lo nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur vechol davar sheosin bahen ochel nefesh. aval mashilo nezamim vetabbaot vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. veasur lishl mimmennu sak lehavi bo perot vachamor lehavi alav perot: 
Makom sheddarkan sheen mashilin kelim ella besachar. asur lishl mimmennu af kelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. hare shehayu bemakom sheen notlin sachar veshaal mimmennu kelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh kede leheraot bahen bifne acherim ad sheyyehane mehem. o shebbikkesh laavor beartzo kede sheyyelech bemakom sheyyehane bo hare ze asur missafek. lefichach im avar eno loke: 
En ben muddar hanaa mechavero lemuddar mimmennu hanayat maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh bemakom shemmashilin otam sham bechinnam: 
Reuven shenneesra alav hanayat shimon ben beneder ben bishvua muttar lo sheyyitten shimon al yado machatzit hashshekel sheruven chayyav bah. vechen porea chov shealav shehare lo higgia leyad reuven kelum ella mana mimmennu hattevia. umeniat hattevia enah bichlal issur hanaya. lefichach muttar lo lazun et ishto veet banav vaavadav afillu hakkenaanim. af al pi shehu chayyav bimzonotam. aval lo yazun et behemto ben temea ben tehora shekkol shemmosif bivsarah hi hanaya shehiggia leyad reuven: 
Haya shimon kohen hare hu muttar lehakeriv karbenot reuven. shehakkohanim sheluche shamayim hem veenam sheluche baal hakkarban. umassi shimon bitto habbogeret liruven middatah. aval im hayta naara shehare adayin hi birshuto asur. shezze kemoser lo shifcha leshammesho: 
Vetorem shimon terumat reuven umafrish lo maasrotav middato. ketzad middato. kegon sheamar reuven kol harotze litrom yavo veyitrom. aval lo yomar leshimon litrom lo shehare ose oto shaliach veze hanaya lo: 
Umelammedo tora shebbeal pe shehare asur littol aleha sachar. aval lo tora shebbichtav shennotlin aleha sachar. veim en darkan sham littol sachar al tora shebbichtav hare ze muttar. uven kach uven kach muttar lelammed et beno: 
Chala reuven nichnas shimon levakkero. uvemakom shennotel sachar mi sheyyashav im hachole letzevet lo lo yeshev shimon ella mevakkero veomed. umuttar lo lerappeoto beyado shezzo mitzva hi: 
Chalta behemat reuven lo yerappe otah shimon. aval omer lo ase lah kach vechach. verochetz immo beambeti gedola aval lo biktanna mippene shemmehannehu beshaa shemmagbiah alav hammayim. veyashen immo bammitta bimot hachamma. aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shemmechammemo. umesev immo al hammitta. veochlin al shulchan echad. aval lo mikkeara achat velo meevus shellifne happoalim. shemma yanniach shimon chaticha achat tova velo yochal otah kede sheyyochal otah reuven o yekarev otah lefanav venimtza mehannehu. vechen beferot shebbaevus. aval im achal shimon mikkeara shehu yodea shekkesheyyachazirenna levaal habbayit yachzor baal habbayit veyannichenna lifne reuven hare ze muttar. veen choshshin shemma hinniach netach tov bishvilo: 
Umuttar reuven lishtot kos shel tanchumin miyyado shel shimon mishshel reuven vechen kos shel bet hammerchatz. sheen baze hanaya: 
Veasur reuven begachalto shel shimon umuttar beshalhevet shello: 
Haya leshimon merchatz o bet habbad muskarim bair. im haya leshimon bahen tefisat yad kegon shehinniach mehen kol shehu leatzmo velo secharo. afillu hinniach bammerchatz ambeti achat uvevet habbad akkal echad. asur liruven lehikkanes leotah merchatz velidroch baggat. veim lo hinniach leatzmo kelum ella sachar hakkol hare ze muttar: 
Veasur liruven leechol mipperot sede shimon vaafillu bashsheviit shehakkol hefker. shehare lifne sheviit nadar. aval im nadar bashsheviit ochel min happerot hannotot chutz lassade. aval lo yikkanes lassade af al pi shehakkarka hefker. gezera shemma yishhe sham achar sheyyochal. velo hifkira otah tora ella kol zeman shehapperot betochah: 
Bamme devarim amurim kesheamar lo hanayat hannechasim haellu asurin alecha. aval im amar lo hanayat nechasay asurin alecha. o shennishba reuven o shennadar minnichse shimon. kevan shehiggia sheviit ochel mipperot sadehu shehare yatzu mershut shimon. aval lo yikkanes lesadehu min hattaam shebbearnu: 
Neesra al reuven hanayat maachal shimon bilvad. im lifne sheviit neesra ben beneder ben bishvua hare ze yored letoch sadehu aval eno ochel mipperotav. veim bishviit neesra yored veochel mipperotav. sheen perot ellu shel shimon ella shel hefker hen: 
Veasur liruven lehasheil leshimon gezera shemma yishal mimmennu vahare hu asur bahanaato. vechen asur lehalevoto gezera shemma yilve mimmennu. velo yimkor lo gezera shemma yikkach mimmennu: 
Nizdammena lo melacha immo kegon shehayu kotzrim keechad. ose berachok mimmennu gezera shemma yesayyeennu. hammaddir et beno mippene sheeno osek battora veneesar bahanayat aviv. hare haav muttar lemalleot lo chavit shel mayim ulehadlik lo et hanner velitzlot lo dag katan. sheen kavvanato ella lahanaa gedola udevarim ellu legabbe habben enan chashuvin: 
Mi shennishba o nadar shello yedabber im chavero hare ze muttar lo lichtov bichtav uledabber im acher vehu shomea hainyan sheyyirtze lehashemio. vechaze horu haggeonim:
Mishneh Torah, Vows 7: Shennayim shenneesra hanaat kol echad mehen al chavero ben beneder ben bishvua hare ellu muttarin lehachezir aveda ze laze mippene shehu mitzva. uvemakom sheddarkan shennotel sachar hammachazir et haaveda yippol hassachar lahekdesh. sheim yittol sachar nimtza nehene veim lo yittol nimtza mehanne:

Umuttarin bidvarim shehem beshuttafut kol yisrael. kegon har habbayit (vehalleshachot) vehaazarot vehabbeer shebbeemtza hadderech. vaasurin bidvarim shehem beshuttafut kol anshe hair kegon harchava shebbair vehammerchatz uvet hakkeneset vehatteva vehassefarim:

Vechetzad yaasu kede sheyyihyu muttarin bidvarim ellu. kol echad veechad mishshenehem kotev chelko lannasi o leechad mishshear haam umezakke lo bechelko al yede acher. venimtza kol echad mehem kesheyyikkanes lammerchatz shehu lechol anshe hair o levet hakkeneset eno nichnas lirshut chavero ella lirshut acherim shehare kol echad mehem nistallek mechelko shebbemakom ze unetano bemattana:

Hayu shenehem shuttafin bechatzer. im yesh bah din chaluka hare ellu asurin lehikkanes lah ad sheyyachaloku veyikkanes kol echad lechelko. veim en bah din chaluka kol echad veechad nichnas leveto vehu omer betoch shelli ani nichnas. uven kach uven kach shenehem asurim lehaamid rechayim vetannur ulegaddel tarnegolin bechatzer zo:

Shenayim shehayu shuttafin bechatzer venadar echad mehen shello yehanne bo hashsheni kofin et hannoder limkor chelko. nadar shello yehane hu bashsheni hare ze muttar lehikkanes leveto mippene shebbirshuto hu nichnas. aval eno yachol lehishtammesh bachatzer kemo shebbearnu:
Haya echad min hashshuk asur bahanaat echad mishshenehem. hare ze muttar lehikkanes lechatzer. mippene shehu omer lo letoch shel chavercha ani nichnas eni nichnas letoch shellecha:

Mi sheasar hanayat umma min haummot al atzmo. hare ze muttar likkach mehen beyoter velimkor lahen befachot. asar hanayato alehem im shomin lo sheyyikkach mehen befachot veyimkor beyoter muttar. veen gozrin kan shello yimkor gezera shemma yikkach. shehare lo nadar meish echad kede shennigzor alav [ella] meumma kullah. sheim i efshar lo lissa velitten im ze yissa veyitten im acher. lefichach im asar hanayatan alav hare ze mashilan umalve otan. aval lo yishal mehem velo yilve mehen:
Asar hanayato alehen vahanayatan alav lo yissa veyitten immahem. vechen lo yisseu hen veyittenu immo velo yashil lahen velo yilve mehem velo yalve otan:
Asar al atzmo hanayat bene hair asur lehishshael al nidro lechacham mibbene otah hair (hahi). veim nishal vehittir lo hare nidro muttar kemo shebbearnu:
Mi sheasar hanayat habberiyyot alav hare ze muttar lehanot beleket shichcha ufea umaasar ani hammitchallek bogoranot aval lo betoch habbayit:

Mi sheasar hanayato al hakkohanim veal haleviyyim hare ellu bain venotlin mattenotehem al karcho. veim amar kohanim ellu uleviyyim ellu hare ellu asurin. veyitten terumotav umaasrotav lechohanim uleviyyim acherim. vehu haddin bemattenot aniyyim im haaniyyim:

Mi shehayta hanayato asura al chavero veen lachavero ma yochal. holech etzel hachenvani veomer ish peloni asur bahanayati veeni yodea ma eese. im halach hachenvani venatan lo uva venatal mizze hare ze muttar:

Haya beto livnot gedero ligdor sadehu liktzor vehalach etzel poalim veamar ish peloni asur bahanayati veeni yodea ma eese. vehalchu hen veasu immo uvau laze venatan lahen secharan hare ze muttar. shennimtza ze sheppara lo chovo. uchevar bearnu shezze muttar lifroa lo chovo:

Hayu mehallechin badderech veen lo ma yochal. noten leacher mishshum mattana vehalla muttar bah. veim en immahem acher manniach al hassela veomer hare hen mufkarin lechol mi sheyyachpotz vehalla notel veochel:

Natan leechad mattana veamar lo hare seudda zo netuna lecha mattana veyavo peloni shehu asur bahanayati veyochal immanu hare ze asur. velo od ella [afillu] im natan lo setam vechazar veamar lo retzoncha sheyyavo peloni veyochal immanu. im hochiach sofo al techillato shello natan lo ella al menat sheyyavo peloni veyochal asur. kegon shehayta seudda gedola vehu rotze sheyyavo aviv o rabbo vechayyotze bahen leechol misseudato. shehare seudato mochachat alav shello gamar lehakenot lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol mattana sheim hikdishah lo tihye mukdeshet enah mattana. vechol hannoten laze mattana al menat lehakenotah leacher hare ze haacher kana beet sheyyakne lo harishon. veim lo hikna lo harishon leoto acher lo kana lo harishon velo hashsheni:

Mi shenneesra hanayato al baal bitto vehu rotze latet levitto maot kede shettihye nehenet bahen umotzia otan bachafatzeha. hare ze noten lah veomer lah hare hammaot haellu netunin lach bemattana uvilvad shello yehe levaalich reshut bahen ella yihyu lema sheat notenet lefich o lema shettilbeshi vechayyotze baze. vaafillu amar lah al menat sheen levaalich reshut bahen ella ma shettirtzi asi bahen lo kana habbaal uma shettirtze taase bahen. aval im natan lah mattana veamar lah al menat sheen levaalich reshut bahen velo peresh shettihye hammattana hazzot lechach ulechach o lema shettirtze taase bahen hare kana otah habbaal leechol peroteha. vedavar ze asur shehare hu asur bahanayat chotno:
